title: Challenges in AI based tumor board case summarization and recommendations
zh_title: 肿瘤多学科会诊病例摘要与建议生成的AI挑战
summary: npj Digital Medicine 基于四家机构数据，用专家评估检验多款大模型在肿瘤会诊摘要、方案生成与结局预测上的表现。
key_points: 四家机构数据，约9600条参考文本、1.6万条专家判断
摘要子任务与临床对齐相关性约0.2，建议生成约0.6
reason: 多中心数据集与大规模专家人工评估，属有外部评估的重要档
abstract: Tumor boards, recurring meetings at hospital institutions, assemble cancer specialists (e.g., medical oncology and pathology) to discuss patient care. In this work, we formally define tumor board case summarization, options generation, and meeting outcome prediction as AI tasks. We study datasets from four medical institutions and evaluate state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) from the DeepSeek, GPT, Gemini, and Qwen families using expert human assessment. Medical oncologists created ~9.6k reference texts and 16k human judgments across tasks. Clinicians rated LLM-generated case summaries 3.57–4.59 out of 5.0 across institutions, but recommendation generation remained more challenging, with average scores of 2.0–3.6. Clinical alignment analyses showed modest correlations of ~0.2 for case summarization subtasks and higher correlations of ~0.6 for recommendation generation using LLM-as-Judge metrics. Our proposed TBFact metrics were competitive with LLM-as-Judge approaches in longer prose free-text settings, suggesting a promising direction toward explainable evaluation. This study, to our knowledge the largest expert-grading study of tumor board tasks with both granular and direct assessments, found that criterion-level scores and overall judgments are related nonlinearly. Experts also frequently assigned high ratings to responses that differed substantially from their reference texts, challenging assumptions underlying reference-based automatic evaluation metrics.
zh_abstract: 肿瘤委员会是医院机构内定期召开的会议，汇集癌症专科医生（例如肿瘤内科和病理科）讨论患者诊疗。在本研究中，我们将肿瘤委员会病例摘要、方案选项生成和会议结局预测正式定义为AI任务。我们研究来自四家医疗机构的数据集，并使用专家人工评估来评价DeepSeek、GPT、Gemini和Qwen系列的最先进大语言模型（LLM）。肿瘤内科医生创建了约9.6k参考文本和跨任务的16k人工判断。各机构临床医生对LLM生成的病例摘要评分为5.0分中的3.57–4.59分，但推荐生成仍更具挑战性，平均评分为2.0–3.6分。临床一致性分析显示，使用LLM-as-Judge指标时，病例摘要子任务的相关性约为0.2，推荐生成的相关性较高，约为0.6。我们提出的TBFact指标在较长散文式自由文本设置中与LLM-as-Judge方法具有竞争力，提示了通向可解释评估的有前景方向。据我们所知，本研究是规模最大的针对肿瘤委员会任务的专家评分研究，同时包含细粒度评估和直接评估；研究发现标准级评分与总体判断之间呈非线性关系。专家还经常对与参考文本存在显著差异的回答给予高评分，这挑战了基于参考的自动评估指标所依据的假设。

title: Rapid comparative evaluation of 2 ambient artificial intelligence applications in a learning health system.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA

summary: JAMIA 发表学习型健康系统评估，用集群随机交叉设计在100名医生中比较 Abridge 与 Nabla 两款AI记录系统。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To evaluate ambient Artificial Intelligence (AI) scribe systems (AAS) across multiple domains using a rapid learning health system (LHS) approach, including provider satisfaction, efficiency, documentation quality, usability, and patient sentiment. This LHS evaluation compared 2 AAS systems (Abridge and Nabla) among 100 providers over 90 days. Evaluation incorporated a cluster randomized crossover comparison, analysis of use and EHR-based workflow outcomes, and standardized simulated encounters to assess documentation quality and safety. Outcomes included provider satisfaction, efficiency, note quality, usability, and patient sentiment. In standardized simulated encounters, both systems achieved 76% note element accuracy with minimal risk for harm. In the randomized crossover comparison, Abridge demonstrated higher usability scores (78.5 vs 73) and was preferred 3:1 over Nabla, which had higher automated speech recognition error rates. Across 16 479 clinical encounters, AAS was used in 35.7% of visits. Total EHR time decreased by approximately 5 minutes per day; same-day chart closure increased by approximately 5% during the initial crossover period, but this effect was attenuated. Provider experience was positive (Net Promoter Score [NPS] 53). Both systems demonstrated comparable documentation accuracy and modest efficiency gains while improving clinician satisfaction. Despite similar performance, clinicians reported differences in usability and preference. Adoption below 40% reflected the trade-off between documentation support and verification burden. Rapid, multidimensional evaluation within a LHS can assess AAS across domains of implementation, efficiency, clinician experience, and documentation quality and safety. Ongoing monitoring of efficiency, documentation quality, and use patterns is essential.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 采用快速学习型健康系统（LHS）方法，在多个领域评估环境式人工智能（AI）记录系统（AAS），包括提供者满意度、效率、文档质量、可用性和患者感受。本LHS评估在100名提供者中比较了2种AAS系统（Abridge和Nabla），为期90天。评估包括整群随机交叉比较、使用情况和基于电子健康记录（EHR）的工作流程结局分析，以及标准化模拟接诊以评估文档质量和安全性。结局包括提供者满意度、效率、病历质量、可用性和患者感受。在标准化模拟接诊中，两种系统均达到76%的病历要素准确性，且危害风险极低。在随机交叉比较中，Abridge表现出更高的可用性评分（78.5 vs 73），并且相较Nabla以3:1被偏好；Nabla的自动语音识别错误率更高。在16 479次临床接诊中，AAS在35.7%的就诊中被使用。每日EHR总时间减少约5分钟；在初始交叉期间，当日病历关闭率增加约5%，但该效应减弱。提供者体验积极（净推荐值[NPS] 53）。两种系统均表现出相当的文档准确性和有限的效率提升，同时改善了临床医生满意度。尽管性能相似，临床医生报告了可用性和偏好方面的差异。采用率低于40%反映了文档支持与核验负担之间的权衡。在LHS内进行快速、多维度评估可评估AAS在实施、效率、临床医生体验以及文档质量与安全等领域的表现。持续监测效率、文档质量和使用模式至关重要。

title: AI-assisted chest CT scan analysis of body composition at ICU admission and 6-month mortality
zh_title: AI分析ICU入院胸部CT体成分与6个月死亡率
summary: 单中心前瞻队列用开源AI分割胸部CT体成分，分析其与ICU患者6个月生存的关联。
key_points: 单中心前瞻队列纳入475例ICU患者
开源AI分割量化胸部CT体成分
体成分风险评分与6个月生存相关，AUC 0.68–0.73
reason: 单中心前瞻队列且有临床结局，但仅内部验证、样本约500，未达外部验证档。
abstract: Abnormal body composition at intensive care unit (ICU) admission is associated with worse survival, but it is rarely measured in practice because manual CT analysis is labor-intensive. We conducted a secondary analysis of a single-center prospective cohort of 509 patients who underwent chest CT within 24 h of ICU admission, of whom 475 were included in the final analysis. Open-source AI segmentation was used to quantify body composition, and the resulting features were related to 6-month survival. Risk scores derived from body composition were significantly associated with 6-month survival ( p < 0.001, log-rank test). In five-fold cross-validation, the AUC for discriminating survivors from non-survivors was 0.73; when feature selection was accounted for, the AUC was 0.68 by nested cross-validation and 0.69 by bootstrap optimism correction. The study shows that the automated AI-based analysis of admission chest CT yields body composition scores significantly associated with 6-month mortality after ICU admission.
zh_abstract: 重症监护病房（ICU）入院时身体成分异常与较差的生存相关，但在实践中很少测量，因为手动 CT 分析劳动强度大。我们对一个单中心前瞻性队列进行了二次分析，该队列包括 509 例在 ICU 入院后 24 小时内接受胸部 CT 的患者，其中 475 例纳入最终分析。使用开源 AI 分割量化身体成分，并将所得特征与 6 个月生存相关联。由身体成分得出的风险评分与 6 个月生存显著相关（p < 0.001，log-rank 检验）。在五折交叉验证中，区分生存者与非生存者的 AUC 为 0.73；当考虑特征选择时，AUC 在嵌套交叉验证中为 0.68，在 bootstrap 乐观校正中为 0.69。该研究表明，基于 AI 的入院胸部 CT 自动分析产生的身体成分评分与 ICU 入院后 6 个月死亡率显著相关。

title: Multimodal AI-enabled repurposing and prioritization of ferroptosis-targeting drug combinations in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
zh_title: 多模态AI筛选胰腺癌铁死亡联合用药
summary: 研究提出FeNetDP多模态AI框架，整合转录组、蛋白组、单细胞、空间与生存数据，优先筛选胰腺导管腺癌铁死亡相关可再利用药物组合，并报告了候选化合物的实验验证。
key_points: 构建FeNetDP框架，融合多组学与临床生存数据
定义与预后不良相关的八基因铁死亡抑制模块
候选药物组合经前瞻性实验验证
reason: 同行评审、方法新颖且有实验验证，但无临床外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) lacks scalable and mechanism-informed computational strategies for prioritizing repurposable drug combinations. Here, we developed FeNetDP, a multimodal AI-guided framework that integrates transcriptomic, proteomic, single-cell, spatial, and clinical survival data to enable biologically grounded drug repurposing and combination prioritization in PDAC. FeNetDP combines gene-level network proximity analysis with a biologically constrained neural ranking model to identify candidate compounds and drug pairs linked to a disease-relevant ferroptosis suppressor program. Using this framework, we defined an eight-gene ferroptosis suppressor module enriched in ductal cells and associated with poor prognosis, and prioritized candidate repurposable compounds and combinations targeting this network state. Prospective experimental validation identified panobinostat plus sorafenib as a synergistic combination that suppresses tumor growth and promotes ferroptosis in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, the combination impaired ferroptosis resistance through coordinated disruption of glutathione-dependent antioxidant defense and AIFM2 (FSP1)-associated glutathione-independent protection. Together, these findings establish FeNetDP as a multimodal and experimentally grounded framework for computational repurposing and mechanism-informed therapeutic prioritization in cancer.
zh_abstract: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）缺乏可扩展且基于机制的计算策略来优先筛选可重新利用的药物组合。在此，我们开发了 FeNetDP，一个多模态 AI 引导框架，整合转录组、蛋白质组、单细胞、空间和临床生存数据，以在 PDAC 中实现有生物学依据的药物重定位和组合优先级排序。FeNetDP 将基因水平网络邻近分析与受生物学约束的神经排序模型相结合，以识别与疾病相关铁死亡抑制程序相关的候选化合物和药物对。利用该框架，我们定义了一个八基因铁死亡抑制模块，该模块在导管细胞中富集并与不良预后相关，并优先筛选了靶向该网络状态的候选可重定位化合物和组合。前瞻性实验验证确定 panobinostat 联合 sorafenib 是一种协同组合，可在体外和体内抑制肿瘤生长并促进铁死亡。在机制上，该组合通过协同破坏谷胱甘肽依赖性抗氧化防御和 AIFM2（FSP1）相关的非谷胱甘肽依赖性保护，削弱了铁死亡抵抗。总之，这些发现确立了 FeNetDP 作为一个多模态且经实验支持的框架，用于癌症中的计算药物重定位和基于机制的治疗优先级排序。

title: Generative fundus angiography from misaligned handheld images for non-invasive screening of infantile retinal diseases
zh_title: 扩散模型从手持眼底彩照生成荧光血管造影
summary: npj Digital Medicine 刊发 InfantAngio，用扩散模型把对位不佳的婴儿手持眼底彩照合成为荧光血管造影图像，以无创方式近似血管成像。
key_points: 面向婴儿视网膜疾病的无创血管成像筛查
处理手持相机的角度与视野错配导致的弱空间对应

reason: 同行评审新方法研究，摘要未显示外部验证或临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Infantile retinal diseases are a leading cause of childhood blindness, and vascular findings that guide screening and management are often poorly visible in color fundus photography (CFP). Fundus fluorescein angiography (FFA) provides angiographic visualization of retinal vascular abnormalities, but its invasive nature and reliance on fluorescein dye limit routine use in vulnerable infants. Generative synthesis may provide non-invasive angiographic approximations. However, infant imaging often relies on manually operated handheld contact fundus cameras, with variations in probe angle, contact pressure, and field of view between separate CFP and FFA acquisitions contributing to weak spatial correspondence between modalities. In this paper, we present InfantAngio, a diffusion-based framework that reformulates CFP-to-FFA synthesis as a deterministic latent transport trajectory. Developed and evaluated using 83,950 registration-derived image-pair records from 259 infants, InfantAngio showed favorable performance across quantitative image-quality benchmarks, while ophthalmologists distinguished real from synthesized FFA images with near-chance accuracy of 49.8% in blinded assessment. Adding synthesized FFA to CFP improved both downstream classifier performance and overall diagnostic accuracy in a retrospective ophthalmologist reader study. These results support synthesized FFA as a potentially useful non-invasive adjunct for screening high-risk infants, with the possibility of reducing reliance on dye-based procedures in real-world clinical scenarios.
zh_abstract: 婴儿视网膜疾病是儿童失明的主要原因之一，而指导筛查和管理的血管征象在彩色眼底摄影（CFP）中往往显示不佳。眼底荧光素血管造影（FFA）可对视网膜血管异常提供血管造影可视化，但其侵入性及对荧光素染料的依赖限制了其在脆弱婴儿中的常规使用。生成式合成可能提供无创的血管造影近似。然而，婴儿成像通常依赖手动操作的手持接触式眼底相机，单独的 CFP 与 FFA 采集之间在探头角度、接触压力和视野上的差异导致两种模态之间的空间对应关系较弱。本文提出 InfantAngio，一种基于扩散的框架，将 CFP 到 FFA 的合成重新表述为确定性潜在传输轨迹。InfantAngio 使用来自 259 名婴儿的 83,950 条配准衍生图像对记录进行开发和评估，在多项定量图像质量基准上表现出良好性能；在盲法评估中，眼科医生区分真实与合成 FFA 图像的准确率为 49.8%，接近随机水平。在一项回顾性眼科医生阅片研究中，将合成 FFA 添加到 CFP 后，既改善了下游分类器性能，也提高了总体诊断准确性。这些结果支持将合成 FFA 作为一种可能有用的无创辅助手段用于高危婴儿筛查，并有可能在真实临床场景中减少对基于染料操作的依赖。

title: VoxelSlicer: Adaptive Voxel-wise Slicer for Deformable Image Registration.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: VoxelSlicer：可变形配准的自适应体素切片器
summary: 提出VoxelSlicer模块，用体素级自适应滤波改进可变形图像配准中的局部不连续与消息传递。
key_points: 现有配准方法难处理大幅形变和复杂运动

abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Recent progress in neural networks has accelerated deformable image registration (DIR) by amortizing iterative optimization, offering faster results and potential accuracy gains with label supervision. However, existing methods struggle with highly deformed structures (e.g., inter-subject abdominal or intra-subject cardiac scans) and fail to handle complex motions like sliding or respiratory dynamics. This limitation arises from isotropic diffusive pair-wise regularization, which leads to inefficient message passing and oversmoothed boundaries. We propose VoxelSlicer, a novel neural network module inspired by the traditional bilateral grid but enhanced with learnable adaptive filtering. VoxelSlicer enables voxel-wise adaptive filtering, addressing local discontinuities in displacement fields and performs more efficient message passing. This design enables adaptive displacement-cost propagation with a compact parameter footprint and a favorable accuracy-complexity trade-off. Experiments on four realistic datasets and two synthetic datasets with different modalities and input constraints demonstrate VoxelSlicer's competitive registration performance together with favorable accuracy-complexity and accuracy-smoothness trade-offs.

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in clinical text processing, but their role in emergency departments (EDs) and ED-adjacent emergency care remains unclear because ED electronic health records (EHRs) are heterogeneous, time-critical, and safety-sensitive. This study aims to synthesize peer-reviewed evidence on LLM applications to real-world ED EHR data and ED-adjacent emergency care data, focusing on clinical tasks, technical strategies, evaluation practices, and workflow integration. We conducted a PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses)-guided systematic review of PubMed and Web of Science (January 1, 2022, to November 14, 2025). We included peer-reviewed English-language studies applying LLM strategies to ED and ED-adjacent EHR data. We extracted dataset characteristics, model families, task formulations (classification, summarization, and information extraction), adaptation strategies (prompting, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic/hybrid workflows), evaluation metrics, and ED workflow phase. Two reviewers also independently completed a design-matched methodological quality and risk-of-bias appraisal. Thirty-one studies met our inclusion criteria. Many relied on single-center datasets (n=12), relatively small sample sizes (<10,000 encounters; n=20), and English-language unstructured text alone or mixed EHR inputs combining text with structured or semistructured fields. Overall, 22 (71%) studies were classified as technical-performance-only evaluations; clinical utility was empirically assessed in only 3 (9.7%) studies, and prospective deployment in 4 (12.9%). abstract: [Nature cell biology] The subcellular organization of proteins carries important information on cell state and gene function, yet there are limited technologies that enable routine measurements of protein localization at scale. Here we develop pooled endogenous protein tagging using prime editing to image subcellular localizations for many proteins in parallel within a heterogeneous cell pool. We constructed three prime editing libraries comprising 17,280 prime editing guide RNAs (pegRNAs) to exhaustively tag 60 endogenous proteins spanning diverse localization patterns and explore a broad space of genomic and pegRNA design parameters. We integrate pegRNA features into a predictive computational model for tagging efficiency to constrain the search space of effective pegRNAs for large-scale peptide knock-in. Last, we show that combining in situ pegRNA sequencing with deep learning image analysis enables scalable exploration of subcellular organization, setting the stage for systematic studies of proteome dynamics across cell types and perturbations.

abstract: Pathology foundation models underpin a growing number of histology-based cancer biomarkers, but sensitivity to slide scanner-specific image signatures degrades cross-center reliability and reproducibility. We developed a foundation model fine-tuning method that improved consistency in head-and-neck cancer human papillomavirus (HPV) prediction, colorectal cancer microsatellite instability (MSI) identification, prostate cancer grading and breast cancer phenotyping. This tempering method decreased cross-scanner prediction differences by 67.5% for HPV (95% CI 59.0-73.9%), 69.3% for MSI (95% CI 51.9-76.5%) and 63.4%-81.2% for breast signatures. Cross-scanner prostate grade agreement rose from 42.5% to 92.7%. Under full scanner-HPV confounding during training, AUROC fell from 0.80 to 0.68 with original model features but only from 0.86 to 0.84 with tempering. Unlike post hoc feature calibration, tempering used only public data yet matched or exceeded on-site calibration. These findings support tempering to reduce scanner dependence of pathology foundation models.

abstract: Artificial intelligence systems for computed tomography (CT) remain largely restricted to specific anatomical regions, examination types or predefined abnormalities, limiting their ability to provide comprehensive and spatially grounded interpretations. Here we present FORA, a general-purpose CT model that recognizes and spatially localizes 1,028 hierarchically organized radiological concepts and generates reports across the 28 CT protocols represented in our cohort. Trained on 304,962 routine CT examinations supervised by their accompanying reports, FORA learns to localize abnormalities without manually annotated lesions. Its architecture combines multiple-instance learning with an interpretable concept bottleneck that connects spatial evidence, radiological findings and report generation. We first developed and benchmarked the architecture on chest radiographs, achieving state-of-the-art performance, before training a separate model on three-dimensional CT examinations. On 36,619 held-out CT examinations, FORA achieved a macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.918 for radiological concept recognition, exceeding the strongest of 18 existing CT models by 0.21. FORA also ranked first on three public benchmarks, outperforming Merlin on its own test set without training on that institution's data (AUROC 0.907 versus 0.826). On independent localization benchmarks for pulmonary emboli, renal masses and rib fractures, FORA's strongest spatial evidence fell within annotated lesions at rates up to 348 times greater than chance. FORA achieved more than threefold higher macro-averaged finding recall than the strongest existing report generator. These results show that a single model can combine broad abnormality recognition, spatial localization and report generation across 12 CT examination types, using routine reports without lesion-level supervision.
zh_abstract: 用于计算机断层扫描（CT）的人工智能系统在很大程度上仍局限于特定解剖区域、检查类型或预定义异常，限制了其提供全面且具空间定位解释的能力。在此，我们提出 FORA，一种通用 CT 模型，可识别并空间定位 1,028 个按层级组织的放射学概念，并针对我们队列中出现的 28 种 CT 协议生成报告。FORA 在 304,962 次常规 CT 检查上训练，以这些检查的伴随报告作为监督，学习定位异常而无需人工标注病灶。其架构将多示例学习与可解释的概念瓶颈相结合，连接空间证据、放射学发现和报告生成。我们首先在胸部 X 线片上开发并基准测试该架构，达到最先进性能，然后在三维 CT 检查上训练一个单独模型。在 36,619 次留出 CT 检查上，FORA 在放射学概念识别方面取得宏平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）0.918，超过 18 个现有 CT 模型中最强者 0.21。FORA 还在三个公共基准上排名第一，在其自身测试集上优于 Merlin，且未在该机构数据上训练（AUROC 0.907 对 0.826）。在肺栓塞、肾脏肿块和肋骨骨折的独立定位基准上，FORA 最强的空间证据落在标注病灶内的比率最高达到随机概率的 348 倍。FORA 的宏平均发现召回率超过现有最强报告生成器的三倍以上。这些结果表明，单一模型可以在 12 种 CT 检查类型中结合广泛的异常识别、空间定位和报告生成，使用常规报告而无需病灶级监督。

abstract: [Journal of cancer education : the official journal of the American Association for Cancer Education] Patients and caregivers increasingly consult large language model (LLM) chatbots for glioma-related information. Explaining glioma requires discussion of tumor classification, molecular pathology, treatment, and prognosis, making accurate patient education challenging. However, the quality of glioma-related information generated by LLMs has not been systematically evaluated. To compare the quality, transparency, and readability of glioma-related information generated by four publicly accessible LLM chatbots and assess whether their responses meet recommended readability standards for patient education. In this cross-sectional study, Google Trends was used to identify commonly searched glioma-related topics. Seventeen patient-oriented questions derived from 19 search terms were submitted to ChatGPT 5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Microsoft Copilot, and Perplexity. Two independent reviewers assessed response quality using DISCERN, Ensuring Quality Information for Patients (EQIP), the Journal of the American Medical Association (JAMA) benchmark criteria, and the Global Quality Score (GQS). Readability was evaluated using six validated indices. Group differences were analyzed with the Kruskal-Wallis test followed by Dunn-Bonferroni post hoc comparisons. Significant differences were observed among the four chatbots for DISCERN (P = 0.001), EQIP (P < 0.001), JAMA (P < 0.001), and GQS (P = 0.022). Copilot achieved the highest DISCERN and EQIP scores, whereas ChatGPT received the highest GQS. Copilot and Perplexity demonstrated better transparency than ChatGPT and Gemini, although overall transparency remained limited. None of the chatbots met recommended readability standards for patient education. Publicly accessible LLM chatbots can provide structured glioma-related information, but performance varies across platforms. Limited transparency and poor readability restrict their suitability as stand-alone patient education tools. Improvements in evidence attribution, guideline-based retrieval, uncertainty communication, and plain-language adaptation are needed before routine use in neuro-oncology.
zh_abstract: [《Journal of cancer education : the official journal of the American Association for Cancer Education》] 患者和照护者越来越多地使用大型语言模型（LLM）聊天机器人获取胶质瘤相关信息。解释胶质瘤需要讨论肿瘤分类、分子病理、治疗和预后，这使得准确的患者教育具有挑战性。然而，LLM 生成的胶质瘤相关信息的质量尚未得到系统评估。比较四个公开可访问的 LLM 聊天机器人生成的胶质瘤相关信息的质量、透明度和可读性，并评估其回答是否满足患者教育推荐的阅读难度标准。在这项横断面研究中，使用 Google Trends 识别常被搜索的胶质瘤相关主题。将源自 19 个搜索词的 17 个面向患者的问题提交给 ChatGPT 5.5、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Microsoft Copilot 和 Perplexity。两名独立评审者使用 DISCERN、确保患者信息质量（EQIP）、美国医学会（JAMA）基准标准和全球质量评分（GQS）评估回答质量。使用六个经过验证的指数评估可读性。组间差异采用 Kruskal-Wallis 检验，随后进行 Dunn-Bonferroni 事后比较。四种聊天机器人在 DISCERN（P = 0.001）、EQIP（P < 0.001）、JAMA（P < 0.001）和 GQS（P = 0.022）方面观察到显著差异。Copilot 获得最高的 DISCERN 和 EQIP 评分，而 ChatGPT 获得最高的 GQS。Copilot 和 Perplexity 表现出比 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 更好的透明度，尽管总体透明度仍然有限。没有聊天机器人满足患者教育推荐的阅读难度标准。公开可访问的 LLM 聊天机器人可以提供结构化的胶质瘤相关信息，但不同平台的表现存在差异。有限的透明度和较差的可读性限制了其作为独立患者教育工具的适用性。在神经肿瘤学中常规使用之前，需要在证据归属、基于指南的检索、不确定性沟通和通俗语言改编方面进行改进。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Baqiyatallah Medical Sciences University; conditions: Post-Intensive Care Syndrome-Family (PICS-F), Post-Traumatic Stress, Psychological Distress; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 1000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The ASSIST trial evaluates whether an AI-assisted smartphone application can reduce post-traumatic stress symptoms and other psychological distress in family members of critically ill patients. Admission to an intensive care unit (ICU) places a severe psychological burden on families, often leading to post-intensive care syndrome-family (PICS-F). Current support is mostly reactive and rarely available after the patient is discharged. This study is a three-center randomized controlled trial involving 1000 family members. Participants will be randomly assigned to receive either standard care or standard care plus the ASSIST smartphone platform. During the ICU stay, the platform uses an artificial intelligence model to simplify clinical information (approved by a clinician) and helps families prepare questions for the medical team. After the patient is discharged, the platform monitors the family member's mood daily. If a risk of anxiety or depression is detected, it provides a brief digital cognitive behavioral therapy module. The main goal is to see if the ASSIST platform reduces post-traumatic stress over a 12-month period compared to standard care alone. Secondary goals include evaluating its effects on acute stress, decisional conflict, anxiety, depression, and caregiver burden. The study will also include qualitative interviews to understand the family members' lived experiences using the platform

title: Beyond the Chatbot: Agentic Artificial Intelligence and the Future of Infectious Disease Practice.
source: PubMed · Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America
zh_title: 智能体AI与感染病实践的未来
summary: 观点文章提出预测式、对话式、智能体三级框架，讨论智能体AI在感染病六个实践领域的潜在影响。

提出预测—对话—智能体三级框架
单个组件已有价值，但整合系统尚待验证
reason: 同行评审观点文章，框架清晰但明确称整合系统未验证，按观点档取5分
abstract: [Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America] Artificial intelligence (AI) discourse in infectious disease (ID) has focused on benchmarking large language model chatbots against clinicians, a useful but narrowing inquiry. Agentic AI is a different paradigm: goal-directed systems that pursue clinical objectives over time, integrating data, invoking tools, monitoring results, and adapting without repeated prompting. This Viewpoint defines the anatomy of an agent, situates it within a 3-level framework (predictive, conversational, agentic), and examines how agents could transform 6 domains of ID practice: clinical care, antimicrobial stewardship, clinical microbiology, infection prevention and control, research, and epidemiology and pandemic preparedness. Individual components have proven value; integrated systems remain untested. No validated agentic system has been deployed in clinical ID; error propagation, algorithmic bias, cost, absent validation frameworks, undefined liability, and consequences for the workforce and its training must be addressed first. The ID community has a narrow window to shape these systems before decisions are made without it.
zh_abstract: [Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America] 传染病（ID）中的人工智能（AI）讨论一直集中于将大型语言模型聊天机器人与临床医生进行基准比较，这是一项有用但范围日益狭窄的探究。智能体式 AI（Agentic AI）是一种不同的范式：目标导向系统，随着时间的推移追求临床目标，整合数据、调用工具、监测结果并在无需反复提示的情况下进行适应。本观点文章定义了智能体的解剖结构，将其置于一个 3 级框架（预测型、对话型、智能体型）中，并探讨了智能体如何改变 ID 实践的 6 个领域：临床护理、抗菌药物管理、临床微生物学、感染预防与控制、研究以及流行病学和大流行防范。单个组件已被证明有价值；集成系统仍未经测试。尚无经过验证的智能体系统部署在临床 ID 中；错误传播、算法偏差、成本、缺乏验证框架、未定义的责任以及对该劳动力及其培训的后果必须首先得到解决。ID 社区有一个狭窄的窗口来塑造这些系统，以免在没有它的情况下做出决定。

title: AI-Driven Clinical Decision Support in Reproductive Medicine: Fertility Oriented Expert (FOX) System.
zh_title: 生殖医学AI临床决策支持系统FOX的评估
summary: 同行评审研究评估基于RAG的FOX系统，以32个辅助生殖临床问题及三个典型病例考察其决策支持表现。
key_points: 知识库为3,998篇开放获取生殖医学文献（2000–2025）
用32个覆盖ART全流程的问题比较不同FOX模型
以三个含关键诊断线索的病例检验识别与管理建议

abstract: [Reproductive sciences (Thousand Oaks, Calif.)] Can an AI-driven clinical decision support system reliably support clinical decision making across all steps of assisted reproductive technology (ART) work-up?. This study evaluates Fertility Oriented Expert (FOX), an AI-driven system designed for all steps of ART. FOX incorporates 3,998 full-text, open-access reproductive medicine publications (January 2000 - September 2025) with commercial large language models (LLMs) using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Thirty-two clinical questions covering ART pathway were used to evaluate the system. Responses generated by different FOX models were compared. Three common clinical cases with key diagnostic clues were presented to the FOX-GPT-5 to analyze further if the system could identify these clues and recommend a management plan. Finally, the responses generated by traditional GPT models were compared with the ones generated by FOX. Performance was assessed using G-score and semantic score, with statistical comparison via the Friedman rank-sum. Median G-scores showed no statistically significant differences between the models (0.8 for FOX-GPT-5, 0.8 for FOX-GPT-4o, and 0.95 for FOX-GPT-o1; P = 0.21). Median semantic scores were also similar (0.89 for FOX-GPT-5, 0.89 for FOX-GPT-4o, and 0.9 for FOX-GPT-o1; P = 0.56. For clinical cases, FOX recommended appropriate treatment options, achieving high G-scores and semantic scores (G-score: 1-1; semantic score: 0.88-0.93). GPT models achieved high G-scores and semantic scores based on FOX model answers (G-score: 0.8-1; semantic score: 0.75-0.99) without statistically significant differences between the different GPT models (G-score P = 0.36; semantic score P = 0.65). FOX provides evidence-based information, covering ART pathway, providing clinical decision-making support for fertility specialists.
zh_abstract: [Reproductive Sciences（Thousand Oaks, Calif.）] 人工智能驱动的临床决策支持系统能否在辅助生殖技术（ART）检查评估的所有步骤中可靠地支持临床决策？本研究评估Fertility Oriented Expert（FOX），这是一个为ART所有步骤设计的AI驱动系统。FOX利用检索增强生成（RAG）将3,998篇全文开放获取的生殖医学文献（2000年1月至2025年9月）与商业大语言模型（LLMs）结合。使用32个涵盖ART路径的临床问题评估该系统。比较不同FOX模型生成的回答。向FOX-GPT-5呈现3个带有关键诊断线索的常见临床病例，以进一步分析该系统能否识别这些线索并推荐管理方案。最后，将传统GPT模型生成的回答与FOX生成的回答进行比较。使用G-score和语义评分评估性能，并通过Friedman秩和检验进行统计比较。中位G-score显示模型间无统计学显著差异（FOX-GPT-5为0.8，FOX-GPT-4o为0.8，FOX-GPT-o1为0.95；P = 0.21）。中位语义评分也相似（FOX-GPT-5为0.89，FOX-GPT-4o为0.89，FOX-GPT-o1为0.9；P = 0.56）。对于临床病例，FOX推荐了适当的治疗方案，获得较高的G-score和语义评分（G-score：1-1；语义评分：0.88-0.93）。GPT模型基于FOX模型答案获得较高的G-score和语义评分（G-score：0.8-1；语义评分：0.75-0.99），不同GPT模型之间无统计学显著差异（G-score P = 0.36；语义评分 P = 0.65）。FOX提供循证信息，覆盖ART路径，为生育专科医生提供临床决策支持。

title: FermiLink: An Agent Harness for Multidomain Scientific Simulations.
source: PubMed · Journal of chemical theory and computation
zh_title: FermiLink：多领域科学模拟智能体框架
summary: 开源智能体框架 FermiLink 通过分离软件包知识库与模拟工作流，在高性能计算集群上实现多步骤、多日无人干预的科学模拟。

四层渐进披露统一多软件包操作

abstract: [Journal of chemical theory and computation] Artificial intelligence (AI) agent harnesses have been developed for autonomous scientific simulations, but most current agent harnesses are tested on a single or a small set of software packages. Herein, FermiLink, an extensible open-source agent harness, is introduced for multidomain scientific simulations. Its key design principle is the separation of package knowledge bases from simulation workflows, so that simulation workflows in FermiLink, from figure-level simulations to full-paper-level research on high-performance computing clusters, operate uniformly among supported packages via a four-layer progressive disclosure mechanism. This agent harness is specifically optimized for high-performance computing (HPC) clusters, enabling multiday, multistep scientific simulations in the absence of human intervention. Using OpenAI Codex as the agent provider, the capabilities of FermiLink are demonstrated across approximately 50 scientific software packages spanning nine research domains from chemistry to engineering. Systematic benchmarks on 132 real-world figure-level reproduction tasks with 44 packages show that FermiLink reproduces 74 (56.1%) of published figures with simulations, among which 30 (22.7%) achieve high-fidelity agreement and 35 reach qualitative agreement with the target figures. A smaller set of human expert-guided reproduction benchmarks with 10 packages in physics and chemistry further highlights the importance of expert insights for improving the simulation fidelity. Beyond reproduction, a single-blinded study demonstrates that FermiLink can produce research-grade results on unpublished polariton physics problems when provided with sufficiently detailed research objectives. Overall, FermiLink provides a scalable research infrastructure that may accelerate the path from scientific questions to computational results across diverse domains.
zh_abstract: [Journal of chemical theory and computation] 人工智能（AI）智能体框架（agent harness）已被开发用于自主科学模拟，但当前大多数智能体框架仅在单一或少量软件包上测试。本文介绍FermiLink，一个用于多领域科学模拟的可扩展开源智能体框架。其关键设计原则是将软件包知识库与模拟工作流分离，从而使FermiLink中的模拟工作流——从图表级模拟到高性能计算集群上的整篇论文级研究——通过四层渐进式披露机制在受支持的软件包之间统一运行。该智能体框架专门针对高性能计算（HPC）集群优化，能够在无人干预的情况下开展多日、多步骤的科学模拟。使用OpenAI Codex作为智能体提供方，FermiLink的能力在约50个科学软件包上得到展示，这些软件包涵盖从化学到工程的九个研究领域。使用44个软件包的132个真实世界图表级复现任务的系统基准测试表明，FermiLink通过模拟复现了74幅（56.1%）已发表图表，其中30幅（22.7%）与目标图达到高保真一致，35幅达到定性一致。一套规模较小的、由人类专家指导的复现基准（涉及物理和化学领域的10个软件包）进一步凸显了专家洞见对提高模拟保真度的重要性。除复现外，一项单盲研究表明，当提供足够详细的研究目标时，FermiLink可在未发表的极化激元物理问题上产生研究级结果。总体而言，FermiLink提供了可扩展的研究基础设施，可能加速跨不同领域从科学问题到计算结果的进程。

title: AI-Assisted Multimodal Imaging Integration for Individualized Transseptal Puncture Planning During Atrial Fibrillation Ablation.
source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
zh_title: AI 辅助多模态影像用于房颤消融房间隔穿刺规划
summary: 单中心 700 例研究，构建整合术前 CTA 与术中 ICE 的 AI 框架，做自动分割与三维重建以辅助穿刺规划。

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Transseptal puncture (TSP) is a critical step during atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation, and accurate anatomical understanding of the interatrial septum is essential for individualized procedural planning. Intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) provides real-time visualization of septal anatomy but is limited by its two-dimensional representation and operator dependence. This study developed an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted multimodal imaging framework integrating preprocedural computed tomography angiography (CTA) with intraoperative ICE to provide patient-specific three-dimensional (3D) anatomical guidance for TSP planning. This single-center study enrolled 700 patients undergoing AF ablation. An AI framework was developed using data from 500 patients to perform automated segmentation, 3D reconstruction, and CTA-ICE multimodal image integration. The framework was evaluated in an independent temporal validation cohort of 200 patients. The primary outcome was the influence of AI-assisted anatomical information on individualized TSP planning, assessed by changes in puncture strategy following AI-assisted assessment. Secondary outcomes included decision confidence, planning time, interreader agreement, and procedural feasibility. The AI framework achieved an overall Dice similarity coefficient of 0.854 for automated anatomical segmentation and a Dice coefficient of 0.862 for 3D left atrial reconstruction. In the temporal validation cohort, at least one AI-recommended adjustment was incorporated into the final TSP strategy in 68 patients (34.0%). The recommendations addressed involved three key components of TSP planning: puncture site category in 52 patients (26.0%), puncture direction in 61 patients (30.5%), and puncture trajectory or angle in 74 patients (37.0%). AI-assisted assessment increased decision confidence (4.3 ± 0.6 vs. 3.4 ± 0.8, p < 0.001), reduced planning time (28.7 ± 10.3 vs. 42.5 ± 15.2 s, p < 0.001), and improved interreader agreement for anatomical assessment. In the temporal validation cohort, acute successful TSP was achieved in 196 patients (98.0%), with a mean transseptal time of 6.8-2.5 min and an overall complication rate of 3.0%. title: Can LLM Judges Catch Unsafe Clinical Actions? A Fault-Injection Study

abstract: As clinical AI agents begin to interact with electronic health records (EHRs), large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate their actions. But how reliably can these judges recognize clinically dangerous mistakes, especially when an agent appears to have completed its task successfully? We investigate this question using MedAgentBench by introducing controlled clinical errors into verified agent trajectories. The experiments include 416 faulty trajectories, eight error categories, and six open-weight LLM judges. By comparing each faulty trajectory with its correct counterpart, we measure whether judges genuinely recognize errors rather than simply flagging more actions as unsafe. The findings show that access to clinical evidence significantly improves judge reliability. When shown only the final answer, judges cannot distinguish errors that leave it unchanged, while flagging 56% of correct trajectories. With full trajectory information, the ability to distinguish unsafe actions from correct ones reaches a score of 0.75, and providing actual EHR responses improves discrimination by 0.39. Surprisingly, including the agent's reasoning does not improve overall performance and reduces detection of incorrectly reported clinical values by 0.18, which remain the hardest errors to detect. MedGemma performed worse than the general-purpose model and was the only judge to miss potentially dangerous medication overdoses. We also find that the benchmark's original grader accepts all 38 trajectories with an intentionally skipped laboratory check, while combining LLM judges with a rule-based checker informed by the full EHR record detects 97% of injected faults.
zh_abstract: 随着临床人工智能代理开始与电子健康记录（EHR）交互，大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于评估其行为。但这些评判者识别临床危险错误的可靠性如何，尤其是当代理似乎已成功完成任务时？我们利用 MedAgentBench，通过将受控临床错误引入已验证的代理轨迹来研究这一问题。实验包括416条错误轨迹、八个错误类别和六个开放权重 LLM 评判者。通过将每条错误轨迹与其正确对应轨迹进行比较，我们衡量评判者是否真正识别错误，而不是仅仅将更多行为标记为不安全。研究结果表明，获取临床证据可显著提高评判者可靠性。仅向评判者展示最终答案时，它们无法区分不改变最终答案的错误，同时会将56%的正确轨迹标记为有问题。在提供完整轨迹信息时，区分不安全行为与正确行为的能力达到0.75分，而提供实际 EHR 响应可使区分能力提高0.39。令人意外的是，纳入代理的推理并未改善总体表现，反而使对错误报告的临床数值的检出率降低0.18，而这些仍是最难检测的错误。MedGemma 的表现劣于通用模型，并且是唯一漏掉可能危险的药物过量的评判者。我们还发现，该基准的原始评分器接受了全部38条故意跳过实验室检查的轨迹，而将 LLM 评判者与基于完整 EHR 记录的规则检查器结合，可检出97%的注入故障。

title: A Scoping Review on Large Language Model Clinical Decision Support in Acute and Critical Care.

abstract: [Journal of medical systems] Decision-making in acute and critical care relies on interpretation of heterogeneous information sources under substantial time pressure. Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as clinical decision support systems (CDSS) to aid in triage, diagnosis generation, and treatment planning. This scoping review maps the current landscape of LLM-based CDSS in acute and critical care and assesses their readiness for clinical implementation. A PRISMA-ScR-guided search of four databases (January 2026) yielded 62 studies, including 15 medical domain-adapted LLMs. Technology Readiness Levels were assigned across all 62 studies; none has progressed to clinical deployment. Within the medical LLM subgroup, medical LLMs generally outperformed their foundation model counterparts, although the evidence was heterogeneous. An exploratory PROBAST + AI-informed appraisal identified recurring methodological concerns, and thematic synthesis of implementation determinants identified regulatory constraints, workflow integration, and insufficient understanding of human-AI interaction as key barriers. This review highlights priorities for prospective validation using real-world institutional data.
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical systems] 急危重症医疗决策依赖于在巨大时间压力下对异质性信息来源的解读。大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）已被提出作为临床决策支持系统（clinical decision support systems, CDSS），用于辅助分诊、生成诊断和治疗计划。本范围综述描绘了急危重症监护中基于LLM的CDSS当前图景，并评估其临床实施准备度。遵循PRISMA-ScR指南检索四个数据库（2026年1月）共纳入62项研究，其中包含15个医学领域适配的LLM。对所有62项研究均分配了技术成熟度等级（Technology Readiness Levels）；尚无一项进展至临床部署。在医学LLM亚组中，医学LLM通常优于其基础模型对应版本，尽管证据异质性较大。一项探索性的PROBAST + AI知情评价发现了反复出现的方法学问题，而对实施决定因素的主题综合识别出监管限制、工作流程整合以及对人类与AI交互理解不足是关键障碍。本综述强调了使用真实世界机构数据进行前瞻性验证的优先事项。

title: An AI agent guides a pipeline for selective protein interaction inhibitors from discovery across targets to preclinical evaluation

summary: bioRxiv预印本介绍Bivexia智能体，规则预先固定并做密码学承诺，产出分子在两种小鼠模型中降低病理负荷。

abstract: A protein can engage multiple partners, making it challenging to disrupt disease-associated interactions while preserving others. We developed Bivexia, an AI agent that guides a multistage pipeline from discovery and de novo design through preclinical evaluation. Its decision rules are fixed in advance, and each prospective selection by the agent is cryptographically committed before testing. The objective is to discover small molecules that disrupt specified interactions of a target protein while preserving others. A compound advanced by Bivexia bound LAG-3 with nanomolar affinity and disrupted its interactions with tau and amyloid-{beta} while preserving binding to MHC class II and FGL1. It reduced tau and amyloid-{beta} burden in independent cohorts across two mouse models. The same rules gave three of nine hits on PrP and two of nine on LRP1, none in random controls. Our findings establish a framework for AI agents to pursue defined interaction selectivity across targets.
zh_abstract: 一种蛋白质可与多个伙伴结合，这使得在保留其他相互作用的同时破坏疾病相关相互作用具有挑战性。我们开发了 Bivexia，一种人工智能代理，指导从发现和从头设计到临床前评估的多阶段流程。其决策规则事先固定，并且代理做出的每个前瞻性选择在测试前均以密码学方式承诺。目标是发现小分子，破坏靶蛋白的特定相互作用，同时保留其他相互作用。由 Bivexia 推进的一种化合物以纳摩尔亲和力结合 LAG-3，并破坏其与 tau 和淀粉样蛋白-{beta} 的相互作用，同时保留与 MHC II 类分子和 FGL1 的结合。它在两个小鼠模型的独立队列中减少了 tau 和淀粉样蛋白-{beta} 负荷。相同规则在 PrP 上获得九次命中中的三次，在 LRP1 上获得九次命中中的两次，在随机对照中无命中。我们的发现为人工智能代理跨靶点追求明确的相互作用选择性建立了一个框架。

title: Can AI Design a Better nnU-Net? A Hypothesis-Driven Architecture Discovery Loop from Failures to Design Rules
zh_title: AI能否设计更好的nnU-Net？假设驱动架构发现
summary: 提出由LLM智能体诊断错误、提出可检验假设并提炼规则的架构发现循环，用于3D医学图像分割。

abstract: Neural architecture search and LLM-driven evolution often reduce evaluation to a scalar fitness score, discarding failures that could explain why designs succeed or fail. We present a hypothesis-driven architecture discovery loop in which LLM agents diagnose structured error patterns, formulate falsifiable hypotheses, test counterfactual controls under a frozen nnU-Net pipeline, and distill validated mechanisms into executable trigger-to-action rules. Across eight search waves, the loop identifies two principles for 3D medical image segmentation. First, reallocating computation from high-resolution decoders to the mid-encoder preserves thin-anatomy boundaries while reducing cost. Second, support-confined region contrast addresses errors between nested anatomical compartments, with anatomy-dependent triggers selecting when the rule applies. These principles produce LeanNeXt (0.78 MACs and 0.92 training-step time relative to nnU-Net; +1.63 Dice points on four-fold KiTS23 cross-validation) and trigger-routed LeanNeXt+. The latter improves all 15 evaluated CT/MRI settings over nnU-Net and exceeds the 3.3 larger ResEnc-M on 12 of 15 benchmarks at 0.30 its parameter count. Relative to random sampling, one-shot LLM generation, and score-selected agent search, the loop shows how failure analysis can yield reusable design rules across modalities.
zh_abstract: 神经架构搜索和 LLM 驱动的演化常常将评估简化为一个标量适应度分数，丢弃了本可解释设计为何成功或失败的失败信息。我们提出一种假设驱动的架构发现循环，其中 LLM 智能体诊断结构化错误模式，提出可证伪的假设，在冻结的 nnU-Net 流程下测试反事实对照，并将经过验证的机制提炼为可执行的“触发到动作”规则。在八轮搜索波次中，该循环识别出用于 3D 医学图像分割的两条原则。第一，将计算从高分辨率解码器重新分配到中层编码器，可在降低成本的同时保留薄解剖结构的边界。第二，支持受限区域对比（support-confined region contrast）可处理嵌套解剖分区之间的错误，并由依赖解剖结构的触发器选择该规则何时适用。这些原则产生了 LeanNeXt（相对于 nnU-Net 为 0.78 MACs 和 0.92 训练步时间；在四折 KiTS23 交叉验证上 +1.63 Dice 点）以及触发器路由的 LeanNeXt+。后者在全部 15 个评估的 CT/MRI 设置上优于 nnU-Net，并在 15 个基准中的 12 个上超过参数量大 3.3 倍的 ResEnc-M，而其参数量为后者的 0.30。相对于随机采样、一次性 LLM 生成和按分数选择的智能体搜索，该循环展示了失败分析如何产生跨模态可复用的设计规则。

title: Tabular Foundation AI Models in Healthcare: A WHO-Inspired Benchmark for Responsible AI and Trustworthiness

abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly used for structured prediction, yet their suitability for healthcare applications remains uncertain because predictive performance alone does not establish fairness, probabilistic reliability, or robustness. We developed a multidimensional benchmark to compare four TFMs: TabFM, TabPFN, TabDPT, and TabICL, against Logistic Regression and XGBoost across a curated, standardized suite of ten WHO-aligned healthcare classification datasets across diverse disease domains. Additionally, we harmonized clinical schemas, standardized protected sex attributes and outcome targets, and released both balanced-scale and natural-prevalence variants of the datasets to establish a benchmarking resource in healthcare machine learning. All models were evaluated using identical five-fold stratified cross-validation partitions and standardized preprocessing. Performance was assessed using 20 metrics spanning predictive discrimination, sex-based fairness, probability calibration, and robustness to Gaussian feature perturbations. A composite Clinical Model Evaluation Score (CMES) was used to summarize performance across these dimensions. Google TabFM achieved the highest mean CMES (0.8811), followed closely by TabDPT (0.8796), TabICL (0.8775), TabPFN (0.8756), XGBoost (0.8650), and Logistic Regression (0.8549). The Friedman test indicated significant differences among models ({chi}2F (5) = 24.914, p = 1.45 x 10^-4; Kendalls W = 0.498). However, post-hoc comparisons revealed no statistically significant differences among the four TFMs after Holm correction. TFMs generally demonstrated stronger discrimination and probabilistic calibration than conventional baselines, with TabFM achieving the highest mean Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic (0.9327) and the lowest expected calibration error (0.0674). Conversely, Logistic Regression exhibited the greatest stability under feature perturbations, while fairness performance varied substantially across datasets and models. These findings highlight the potential of TFMs for small-data healthcare prediction while demonstrating that their advantages are dimension-dependent. Multidimensional, dataset-specific evaluation and external validation remain essential before clinical implementation. All analysis codes, original datasets, and multiple variants of benchmark datasets are publicly available in a GitHub repository to ensure reproducibility and future research.
zh_abstract: 表格基础模型（TFMs）正越来越多地用于结构化预测，但其对医疗保健应用的适用性仍不确定，因为仅凭预测性能并不能确立公平性、概率可靠性或稳健性。我们开发了一个多维基准，在涵盖不同疾病领域的十个经整理、标准化的与世界卫生组织（WHO）对齐的医疗保健分类数据集套件上，将四种 TFM：TabFM、TabPFN、TabDPT 和 TabICL，与 Logistic Regression 和 XGBoost 进行比较。此外，我们统一了临床模式，标准化了受保护的性别属性和结局目标，并发布了数据集的平衡比例和自然患病率变体，以建立一个医疗保健机器学习基准资源。所有模型均使用相同的五折分层交叉验证划分和标准化预处理进行评估。性能使用 20 项指标评估，涵盖预测区分度、基于性别的公平性、概率校准和对高斯特征扰动的稳健性。使用复合临床模型评估分数（CMES）总结这些维度的性能。Google TabFM 获得最高平均 CMES（0.8811），紧随其后的是 TabDPT（0.8796）、TabICL（0.8775）、TabPFN（0.8756）、XGBoost（0.8650）和 Logistic Regression（0.8549）。Friedman 检验表明模型间存在显著差异（χ²_F(5)=24.914，p=1.45×10^-4；Kendall's W=0.498）。然而，事后比较显示，经 Holm 校正后，四种 TFM 之间无统计学显著差异。TFM 通常表现出比传统基线更强的区分度和概率校准，其中 TabFM 获得最高平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积（Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic，0.9327）和最低期望校准误差（0.0674）。相反，Logistic Regression 在特征扰动下表现出最大稳定性，而公平性性能在不同数据集和模型间差异很大。这些发现突显了 TFM 在小数据医疗保健预测中的潜力，同时表明其优势依赖于维度。在临床实施之前，多维、数据集特异性评估和外部验证仍然至关重要。所有分析代码、原始数据集和基准数据集的多个变体均已在 GitHub 仓库中公开，以确保可重复性和未来研究。

title: CheekAI: An explainable, deep learning epigenetic aging clock based on lifestyle and health epigenetic biomarker proxies

与实龄相关系数0.969，MAE 2.49年

abstract: The human methylome is poorly understood and, as such, the vast majority of epigenetic aging clocks are unexplainable black boxes. To address this, we created CheekAI, a robust deep learning model that uses lifestyle and health epigenetic biomarker proxies (EBPs) to predict age. Trained using a longitudinal dataset of 25,400 adult buccal DNA methylation samples derived from 14,716 distinct adults, we used principal components and multi-objective optimization to produce a clock that is explainable, reproducible, responsive, and accurate. The Pearson correlation with chronological age is 0.969, the mean absolute error is 2.49 years, and the intraclass correlation coefficient across 679 replicate pairs is 0.990. CheekAI was significantly associated with a plethora of lifestyle and health variables, including resting heart rate, omega-3 intake, ultra-processed food intake, daily step count, resistance training, and time spent in nature. When applied to external saliva and buccal datasets, CheekAI significantly captured a variety of signals, including smoking and oesophageal cancer. CheekAI was also significantly reduced by a multifactorial lifestyle intervention and this reduction was driven by improvements in dietary and metabolic EBPs. This novel artificial intelligence model represents the first instance of a buccal epigenetic aging clock that utilizes EBPs to offer interpretability and actionability.
zh_abstract: 人类甲基化组仍知之甚少，因此，绝大多数表观遗传衰老时钟是无法解释的黑箱。为解决这一问题，我们创建了 CheekAI，这是一个稳健的深度学习模型，使用生活方式和健康表观遗传生物标志物代理指标（EBPs）来预测年龄。我们使用来自 14,716 名不同成年人的 25,400 份成年颊部 DNA 甲基化样本的纵向数据集进行训练，并使用主成分和多目标优化，产生了一个可解释、可重复、响应性好且准确的时钟。与实足年龄的 Pearson 相关系数为 0.969，平均绝对误差为 2.49 年，679 对重复样本的组内相关系数为 0.990。CheekAI 与大量生活方式和健康变量显著相关，包括静息心率、omega-3 摄入、超加工食品摄入、每日步数、抗阻训练和接触自然时间。当应用于外部唾液和颊部数据集时，CheekAI 显著捕获了多种信号，包括吸烟和食管癌。CheekAI 还被多因素生活方式干预显著降低，而这种降低由饮食和代谢 EBPs 的改善驱动。这一新型人工智能模型代表了首个利用 EBPs 提供可解释性和可操作性的颊部表观遗传衰老时钟。

title: A multimodal foundation model for tissue proteomics and morphology in cancer
zh_title: 整合组织蛋白组与形态学的多模态基础模型
summary: 预印本提出VirTues-M2，用视觉Transformer联合学习H&E形态与空间蛋白组，可容忍模态缺失与配准不完美。
key_points: 联合H&E组织形态与多重空间蛋白组数据
预训练中编码标记身份以应对模态缺失
针对队列间标记面板不一致的转化瓶颈
reason: 新方法多模态病理基础模型预印本，但未述外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment decisions increasingly rely on integrating tissue morphology with specific molecular readouts of the tumor and its microenvironment. H&E histopathology provides scalable morphology, whereas multiplex spatial proteomics quantifies dozens of proteins in situ with spatial context, but remains selectively deployed, often with different marker panels across cohorts. This creates a translational bottleneck: most patients lack high-depth molecular profiling, and existing models rarely integrate morphology and spatial molecular data in a single framework. We present VirTues-M2, a multimodal foundation model that jointly learns from H&E and spatial proteomics using a novel vision transformer-based architecture. By encoding marker identity during pretraining, VirTues-M2 is robust to missing modalities, imperfect modality pairing or registration, and variable marker panels, enabling unified inference for tissue phenotyping, panoptic cell segmentation, virtual staining, annotation-free biomarker discovery, and reinforcement learning-based adaptive marker panel selection to reduce assay burden. As a concrete demonstration of translational utility, in a newly collected cohort of 1,053 treatment-naive non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients with paired spatial proteomics and H&E, VirTues-M2 discovers high-risk and low-risk tissue signatures that stratify overall survival in both the discovery cohort and an independent validation cohort, outperforming current state-of-the-art stratification schemes; all enabled by VirTues-M2's ability to jointly analyze both modalities within a single model.
zh_abstract: 癌症诊断、预后和治疗决策日益依赖于将组织形态学与肿瘤及其微环境的特定分子读数相整合。H&E 组织病理学提供可扩展的形态学信息，而多重空间蛋白质组学可在原位量化数十种蛋白质并保留空间背景，但其应用仍具选择性，且不同队列常使用不同的标志物 panel。这造成了转化瓶颈：大多数患者缺乏高深度分子谱分析，且现有模型很少在单一框架中整合形态学和空间分子数据。我们提出 VirTues-M2，一种多模态基础模型，采用新颖的基于视觉 transformer 的架构，从 H&E 和空间蛋白质组学中联合学习。通过在预训练期间编码标志物身份，VirTues-M2 对缺失模态、不完美的模态配对或配准以及可变标志物 panel 具有稳健性，从而能够统一推断组织表型分析、全景细胞分割、虚拟染色、无注释生物标志物发现，以及基于强化学习的自适应标志物 panel 选择以减少检测负担。作为转化实用性的具体展示，在一个新收集的由 1,053 例初治非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者组成、具有配对空间蛋白质组学和 H&E 的队列中，VirTues-M2 发现了高风险和低风险组织特征，可在发现队列和独立验证队列中对总生存期进行分层，优于当前最先进的分层方案；这一切均得益于 VirTues-M2 在单一模型中联合分析两种模态的能力。

title: Multi-omics causal deep learning reveals regulatory structure while interventions refine perturbation predictions
zh_title: 多组学因果深度学习推断基因调控网络
summary: 预印本发布CMC-VAE，在潜空间学习基因-蛋白调控网络，并在三个CRISPR筛选上优于相关性与潜变量基线。
key_points: 基于809130个CITE-seq观测图谱训练
恢复共表达、转录因子调控子与免疫信号程序
在三个CRISPR筛选上排序表现优于基线
reason: 大规模单细胞数据训练、有多个扰动筛选基线对比的方法预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Inferring gene regulation from single-cell data is difficult because observational measurements cannot distinguish correlation from causation and access to perturbational data, especially with multiple modalities, remains limited. Here we present the Cross-Modal Causal Variational Autoencoder (CMC-VAE), which learns a network linking genes and proteins (gene-gene, protein-protein and gene-protein) in the latent space and maps each connection back onto measured features. Trained on 809,130 observational CITE-seq profiles, CMC-VAE recovers co-expression, transcription factor regulons and immune signalling programs, and learns a sparse cross-modal map enriched for transcript-protein cognate pairs. On three CRISPR screens used during development, it ranks knockout-responsive genes better than correlation and latent-VAE baselines. Fitted to a screen's unperturbed control cells, without perturbation labels, the model translates measured knockout RNA responses into protein responses better than a correlation map and cognate transcripts. The direction of gene-to-gene regulation, however, is not recovered from observational data. On the CITE-seq screens, fine-tuning only the latent network improves held-out response correlation, mainly by learning a response shared across knockouts. On larger Perturb-seq screens, with about 1,000 training perturbations, fine-tuning the latent network learns gene-specific effects that transfer to held-out genes, more so than a gene-level causal model fine-tuned on the same cells, and in simulation, such interventions also restore edge orientations that observational training leaves unresolved.
zh_abstract: 从单细胞数据推断基因调控很困难，因为观察性测量无法区分相关与因果，而且获取扰动数据——尤其是多模态扰动数据——仍然有限。在此，我们提出跨模态因果变分自编码器（Cross-Modal Causal Variational Autoencoder, CMC-VAE），其在潜空间中学习一个连接基因与蛋白质的网络（基因-基因、蛋白质-蛋白质和基因-蛋白质），并将每个连接映射回测量特征。CMC-VAE 在 809,130 个观察性 CITE-seq 图谱上训练，能够恢复共表达、转录因子调控组和免疫信号程序，并学习到一个稀疏的跨模态图谱，该图谱富集转录本-蛋白质同源配对。在开发过程中使用的三个 CRISPR 筛选上，它对敲除响应基因的排序优于相关性和潜在 VAE 基线。将模型拟合到一个筛选的未扰动对照细胞上（不使用扰动标签），其将测得的敲除 RNA 响应转换为蛋白质响应的能力优于相关性图谱和同源转录本。然而，基因到基因调控的方向无法从观察性数据中恢复。在 CITE-seq 筛选上，仅微调潜在网络可提高留出响应的相关性，主要通过学习一种在敲除之间共享的响应。在更大的 Perturb-seq 筛选上（约有 1,000 个训练扰动），微调潜在网络可学习到可迁移到留出基因的基因特异性效应，且优于在同一细胞上微调的基因水平因果模型；在模拟中，此类干预还恢复了观察性训练未能解决的边方向。

title: Deciphering Molecular Language for Spectral Interpretation with a Foundation Model Pretrained on Repository-Wide Metabolomics Data
zh_title: UltraMS：全库代谢组数据预训练的谱图基础模型
summary: bioRxiv 预印本发布 UltraMS，在逾 1.6 亿张正负离子串联质谱上大规模预训练，用于谱图结构解读。
key_points: 双极性基础模型，面向串联质谱的分子语言解析
预训练语料超过 1.6 亿张谱图，覆盖正负离子模式
目标是从组织与环境样本谱图中提取分子信息
reason: 大规模预训练基础模型，但仅预印本且未见外部评测，值得一看上档
abstract: In-depth, scalable structural interpretation of tandem mass spectra from diverse biological tissues and environmental samples is essential for understanding the molecular diversity of cellular environments and the metabolic architecture of living systems. Although community-driven resources such as GNPS and MassIVE have aggregated massive volumes of tandem mass spectra spanning a wide range of organisms, clinical cohorts and environmental surveys, modeling and interpreting this exponentially expanding spectral corpus to distill molecular information and derive meaningful biological insights poses a fundamental challenge for established computational methods. Furthermore, building on the structure-aware spectral representations learned by UltraMS, we construct UltraAtlas, a chemical-property-resolved map that organizes millions of experimental spectra into a unified coordinate system, enabling millisecond-scale molecular profiling and offering practical guidance for exploratory navigation across vast chemical space. zh_abstract: 对来自多样生物组织和环境样本的串联质谱进行深入、可扩展的结构解析，对于理解细胞环境的分子多样性和生命系统的代谢架构至关重要。尽管 GNPS 和 MassIVE 等社区驱动资源已汇集了涵盖广泛生物体、临床队列和环境调查的海量串联质谱数据，但对这一指数级扩张的谱图语料库进行建模和解释，以提炼分子信息并获得有意义的生物学洞见，仍对现有计算方法构成根本性挑战。在此，我们提出 UltraMS，一种双极性基础模型，通过对涵盖正离子和负离子模式的超过 1.6 亿张谱图进行大规模预训练，专门用于解读串联质谱中潜藏的分子语言。我们的研究结果表明，UltraMS 能够通过自监督学习有效解码质谱背后分子的化学语义，在多种下游任务中取得优越性能，包括元素检测、分子鉴定、分子性质分析和代谢景观表征。值得注意的是，UltraMS 能够以细粒度谱图可解释性进行分子鉴定，同时从非靶向 MS/MS 谱图中阐明分子结构，并通过注释迁移提供逐峰子结构归因。在人类斑块样本临床队列中部署后，UltraMS 在发现有结构依据的碎片离子形成途径支持的、此前未被识别的表型相关代谢物方面展现出显著潜力，同时有效纠正可能错误注释的临床标志物。此外，基于 UltraMS 学习到的结构感知谱图表示，我们构建了 UltraAtlas，一个化学性质解析图谱，将数百万张实验谱图组织到统一坐标系统中，实现毫秒级分子分析，并为跨广阔化学空间的探索性导航提供实用指导。应用于人类头皮代谢组学时，UltraAtlas 有效捕捉个体间不同的代谢变异，突出表型特异性化学特征，同时揭示常驻微生物组的化学生态位。UltraMS 与 UltraAtlas 共同构成一个……

title: MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows
zh_title: MedUIGym：临床GUI智能体评测训练环境
summary: 构建含15739个任务、覆盖六类临床场景的交互环境，用于训练与评测EHR界面智能体。
key_points: 15,739个任务、17个基准来源
智能体从截图感知EHR并执行鼠标键盘操作
十二个视觉语言模型评测显示仍普遍吃力
reason: 大规模新基准且对比充分，但为预印本、未明确开源，属值得一看档
abstract: Automating clinical workflows requires vision-language agents that can navigate dense graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in electronic health records (EHRs) and execute precise actions, yet many medical agents still rely on text or structured tool calls. In this work, we introduce MedUIGym, a scalable interactive environment comprising 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources across six clinical task families for training and evaluating clinical GUI agents. In MedUIGym, agents perceive EHR states from screenshots and execute mouse-and-keyboard actions, as well as a paired native-tool interface over identical clinical data. The environment verifies both final answers and required clinical actions, and supports parallel trajectory collection for training. Benchmarking twelve vision-language models shows that current agents struggle across diverse clinical workflows, and simply increasing reasoning effort fails to yield consistent gains. Furthermore, MedUIGym supports offline learning from GUI trajectories and online reinforcement learning from task rewards. After training, both Qwen3.5 models perform better on in-domain clinical tasks and generalize to tasks from external sources. By unifying tasks from existing benchmarks, dual-interface evaluation, and GUI trajectory collection, MedUIGym provides a testbed for studying how vision-language agents complete clinical tasks through the EHR's graphical interface. Our project page is available at https://github.com/yitong-qiao/MedUIGym.
zh_abstract: 自动化临床工作流程需要视觉-语言智能体（vision-language agents）能够导航电子健康记录（EHRs）中密集的图形用户界面（GUIs）并执行精确操作，然而许多医学智能体仍然依赖文本或结构化工具调用。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 MedUIGym，一个可扩展的交互式环境，包含来自 17 个基准来源、跨越六个临床任务家族的 15,739 个任务，用于训练和评估临床 GUI 智能体。在 MedUIGym 中，智能体从屏幕截图感知 EHR 状态并执行鼠标和键盘操作，以及在相同临床数据上配对的本地工具接口。该环境验证最终答案和所需的临床操作，并支持用于训练的并行轨迹收集。对十二个视觉-语言模型进行基准测试表明，当前智能体在多样化的临床工作流程中表现不佳，仅仅增加推理努力并不能带来一致的收益。此外，MedUIGym 支持从 GUI 轨迹进行离线学习和从任务奖励进行在线强化学习。训练后，两个 Qwen3.5 模型在域内临床任务上表现更好，并泛化到外部来源的任务。通过统一现有基准中的任务、双接口评估和 GUI 轨迹收集，MedUIGym 提供了一个测试平台，用于研究视觉-语言智能体如何通过 EHR 的图形界面完成临床任务。我们的项目页面可在 https://github.com/yitong-qiao/MedUIGym 获取。

title: A dataset of clinically similar image pairs from citation-linked case reports for medical image retrieval
zh_title: 面向医学图像检索的临床相似图像对数据集
summary: 预印本构建PMC-PaIR，从56,013篇开放获取病例报告提取86,144对临床相似图像，供检索系统训练与评测。
key_points: 按引用关系链接相似病例，再用LLM分层问答核对共同点
图像按标题与问答答案匹配，专家认定准确率较高
规模与范围超越现有小而窄的检索数据集
reason: 大规模病例报告来源数据集，有专家核验但为预印本且未明示公开，处值得一看上沿
abstract: Retrieving images of patients clinically similar to a given patient can support diagnosis, teaching and research. Training and evaluating retrieval systems requires knowing which images of different patients show the same finding, and existing datasets are small or narrow in scope. We construct PMC-PaIR, a dataset of 86,144 pairs of clinically similar images from 56,013 open-access PubMed Central case reports, which often document rare or challenging presentations. We develop an approach that follows citations, which often link case reports of similar patients. To determine what two linked cases share clinically, it prompts large language models to generate and answer hierarchical questions, from modality to diagnosis and findings, and to match images by caption using the answers. Experts find the pairs highly accurate, and this question-guided approach finds twice as many correct pairs as direct matching. Fine-tuning BiomedCLIP on PMC-PaIR improves retrieval in all modality, anatomy and diagnosis categories tested, for image-only queries and image queries with a short text naming the finding. We release the dataset and the automated pipeline, which can extend PMC-PaIR as new case reports are published.
zh_abstract: 检索与给定患者临床相似患者的图像可支持诊断、教学和研究。训练和评估检索系统需要知道不同患者的哪些图像显示相同表现，而现有数据集规模小或范围窄。我们构建PMC-PaIR，这是一个包含来自56,013篇开放获取PubMed Central病例报告的86,144对临床相似图像的数据集，这些病例报告常记录罕见或具有挑战性的临床表现。我们开发了一种沿引用关系的方法，这些引用常将相似患者的病例报告关联起来。为确定两个被引用关联的病例在临床上共享什么，它提示大语言模型生成并回答从成像模态到诊断和表现的分层问题，并利用答案按图注匹配图像。专家认为这些配对高度准确，这种问题引导方法找到的正确配对数量是直接匹配的两倍。在PMC-PaIR上微调BiomedCLIP可在所有测试的模态、解剖和诊断类别中改善检索，适用于仅图像查询以及带有命名该表现的简短文本的图像查询。我们发布该数据集和自动化流水线；随着新病例报告发表，该流水线可扩展PMC-PaIR。

title: EnSurv: Deep Generative Survival Modeling with Application to Kidney Graft Outcomes
zh_title: EnSurv：肾移植结局深度生成生存建模
summary: 基于UNOS 243,443例肾移植记录，提出EnSurv深度生成生存框架预测移植失败时间。
key_points: 使用UNOS 243,443例肾移植记录
EnSurv为深度生成生存建模框架
结合能量评分与Kaplan-Meier尾部补全
reason: 大样本注册数据+临床结局，但无外部验证，属6分档
abstract: Kidney transplantation is the optimal treatment for life-threatening end-stage renal disease, providing significant survival advantages over dialysis. Given the severe shortage of donor organs, accurately predicting the time to premature graft failure is an essential clinical task for optimizing organ allocation and tailoring individualized immunosuppressive therapies. This study is motivated by a comprehensive United Network of Organ Sharing (UNOS) dataset containing 243,443 kidney transplant records with complex multi-region structures and high right-censoring rates. We propose EnSurv (survival engression), a deep generative survival framework designed to capture complex, non-linear clinical covariate interactions for modeling time to graft failure. Within a pre-additive noise model (pre-ANM) family, EnSurv optimizes an energy score augmented with pooled Kaplan-Meier tail completion to handle right-censoring. We identify the pooled-completion target of the objective, establish consistency for its best approximation within the pre-ANM family, and give conditions and error bounds for its relation to true conditional graft survival. EnSurv also provides global explainability through summaries of fitted feature weights and incorporates domain constraints through established clinical directions using a soft gradient penalty. Extensive simulation experiments were conducted to evaluate the performance of the proposed method in comparison with existing methods. Application to the UNOS cohort demonstrates that EnSurv effectively models individual and region-level effects, consistently outperforming baselines across evaluation metrics encompassing discrimination, calibration, and accuracy.
zh_abstract: 肾移植是危及生命的终末期肾病的最佳治疗，与透析相比具有显著生存优势。鉴于供体器官严重短缺，准确预测提前移植物衰竭时间是一项重要临床任务，用于优化器官分配和定制个体化免疫抑制治疗。本研究受一个全面的器官共享联合网络（UNOS）数据集驱动，该数据集包含243,443条肾移植记录，具有复杂的多区域结构和高右删失率。我们提出EnSurv（生存engression），一种深度生成生存框架，旨在捕捉复杂的非线性临床协变量交互，以建模移植物衰竭时间。在预加性噪声模型（pre-ANM）族内，EnSurv优化一种能量评分，并用合并Kaplan-Meier尾部补全进行增强，以处理右删失。我们识别目标的合并补全目标，确立其在前ANM族内最佳近似的一致性，并给出其与真实条件移植物生存关系所需的条件和误差界。EnSurv还通过拟合特征权重的汇总提供全局可解释性，并使用软梯度惩罚通过已确立的临床方向纳入领域约束。进行了大量模拟实验，以评估所提方法与现有方法相比的性能。应用于UNOS队列表明，EnSurv有效建模个体和区域水平效应，在涵盖区分度、校准和准确性的评估指标上始终优于基线。

title: Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments
zh_title: Clinical3D-Bench：医院空间智能基准
summary: 发布Clinical3D-Bench，用3,368题评估多模态大模型在医院环境中的空间推理能力。

覆盖373个医院房间布局，医生筛查

abstract: Spatial reasoning in hospitals requires tracking look-alike equipment, interpreting patient-relative directions, and judging passage widths, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of these abilities. We introduce Clinical3D-Bench, a simulated benchmark with 3,368 questions of eight types on egocentric walkthroughs of 373 hospital-room layouts. Layouts follow hospital design guidelines, answers are computed from the 3D scenes, and paired scene states test whether models change their answers when relevant evidence changes. Videos are photorealistic, and ten physicians screened the layouts. Among 35 multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the best open and proprietary models reach 45.7% and 53.6% macro accuracy, against 40.8% for an answer prior and 79.0% for physicians on a subset, and 27 of 32 open models score below 40% on two-way patient-relative directions. Fine-tuning on Clinical3D-45K, our 44,750-question training set, lifts two MLLMs 16-20 points above the best proprietary model. 3D maps given to the fine-tuned MLLM as input go largely unused: replacing them with another video's, even when they are ground truth, barely changes its accuracy. The proposed GeoJeV instead lets the MLLM compute with 3D: it reconstructs a scene memory from each video, selects 3D operations and their arguments from the MLLM's question state, and adds their evidence to its option scores. It achieves the highest accuracy of all evaluated models, narrowing the gap to physicians.
zh_abstract: 医院中的空间推理需要追踪外观相似的设备、解释相对于患者的方向以及判断通道宽度，但现有基准对这些能力的覆盖有限。我们推出Clinical3D-Bench，一个模拟基准，包含3,368个问题、八种类型，基于373个医院房间布局的自我中心漫游。布局遵循医院设计指南，答案由3D场景计算得出，配对的场景状态测试模型在相关证据变化时是否改变答案。视频具有照片级真实感，十名医生筛选了布局。在35个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中，最佳开源和专有模型分别达到45.7%和53.6%的宏平均准确率，而答案先验为40.8%，医生在子集上为79.0%；32个开源模型中有27个在双向患者相对方向上得分低于40%。在我们包含44,750个问题的训练集Clinical3D-45K上微调，使两个MLLM比最佳专有模型高出16-20个百分点。提供给微调后MLLM作为输入的3D地图在很大程度上未被使用：将其替换为另一个视频的3D地图，即使这些地图是真实标注，也几乎不改变其准确率。所提出的GeoJeV则让MLLM利用3D进行计算：它从每个视频重建场景记忆，从MLLM的问题状态中选择3D操作及其参数，并将其证据加入选项得分。它在所有评估模型中取得最高准确率，缩小了与医生的差距。

abstract: Radiology reports describe findings in text only, without visually marking them on the scan, so readers cannot directly see which abnormality each reported finding refers to. We introduce CTLink, a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that segments findings described in a chest CT report. CTLink was trained on 4123 noncontrast chest CT scans with 9547 segmented report findings, including ReXGroundingCTv2, a newly annotated dataset of 1134 scans and 1895 findings with every instance of each finding segmented. On the 200 ReXGroundingCT validation scans, CTLink achieved a hit rate of 0.816, an instance F1 score of 0.456, and a mean Dice score of 0.400, compared with 0.533, 0.175, and 0.234 for VoxTell, a publicly available text-prompted segmentation model (P < .001 for all). On the test set of the MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding challenge, an ensemble of seven CTLink models achieved the highest hit rate (0.782) and instance F1 score (0.386) of all 48 participating teams. On 50 test scans segmented twice by independent radiologists, CTLink matched or exceeded inter-rater agreement. Diffuse non-focal findings remained the main limitation, partly because their extent is outlined inconsistently even between radiologists. The CTLink model weights are available at https://huggingface.co/rajpurkarlab/CTLink, and the dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/rajpurkarlab/ReXGroundingCT.
zh_abstract: 放射学报告仅以文本描述发现，而不在扫描图像上对其进行视觉标记，因此读者无法直接看到每条报告发现所指的异常。我们介绍CTLink，一种文本提示的3D分割模型，可分割胸部CT报告中描述的发现。CTLink在4123例非增强胸部CT扫描上训练，包含9547条分割的报告发现，其中包括ReXGroundingCTv2——一个新标注的数据集，含1134例扫描和1895条发现，每条发现的每个实例均被分割。在200例ReXGroundingCT验证扫描上，CTLink达到0.816的命中率、0.456的实例F1分数和0.400的平均Dice分数，而公开可用的文本提示分割模型VoxTell分别为0.533、0.175和0.234（所有P < .001）。在MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding挑战赛测试集上，由七个CTLink模型组成的集成在全部48支参赛队伍中取得最高命中率（0.782）和实例F1分数（0.386）。在由独立放射科医师两次分割的50例测试扫描上，CTLink达到或超过评分者间一致性。弥漫性非局灶性发现仍是主要局限，部分原因是即使在放射科医师之间其范围勾画也不一致。CTLink模型权重可在https://huggingface.co/rajpurkarlab/CTLink获取，数据集可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/rajpurkarlab/ReXGroundingCT获取。

title: Medical Image Segmentation Is Now Just Another Coding Task
zh_title: 医学图像分割正变成简单的编程任务
summary: 预印本显示，四个现成编程智能体仅凭任务描述与标注数据，在数小时内为四种模态的13个分割任务构建出分割器。
key_points: 仅用CPU、无分割框架和无预训练权重，四个编程智能体完成13个任务
覆盖四种成像模态，其中9个2D任务最佳程序Dice达GPU训练的nnU-Net的99%

abstract: For decades, every new medical image segmentation task has needed an expert, a dedicated architecture, and a framework such as nnU-Net. This is no longer the case: medical image segmentation is now just another coding task. Given only a task description, labeled data, and a CPU (with no segmentation framework, no pretrained weights, and no human in the loop), four off-the-shelf coding agents built segmenters for 13 tasks across four imaging modalities within hours, an ability that has emerged rather than been built. On the nine 2D tasks, their best programs reach 99% of the Dice of a GPU-trained nnU-Net. Like any code, a segmenter improves by being revised and checked, so we ask how far the same agents can improve their own segmentations and what unlocks further gains. On unseen cases there is no reference, so the agents inspect renderings of their own predictions: this alone lifts the worst tenth of cases by 0.09 Dice and cuts boundary error (HD95) by almost a quarter. Far more is within reach. Told the true Dice of each attempt, the same agents improve in all 14 matched pairs, rescue 85% of failed masks instead of 30%, and surpass the GPU-trained nnU-Net on average, by producing better masks rather than by choosing among them. What unlocks these gains is a quality signal, which neither visual inspection, nor more rounds, nor a quality estimator trained by the agents themselves yet supplies: we call this the quality blind spot. The ability to build and to repair is already present; the next advance will come not from another segmentation model, but from reference-free quality estimation that coding agents can call.
zh_abstract: 几十年来，每一个新的医学图像分割任务都需要一位专家、一个专用架构以及诸如 nnU-Net 之类的框架。现在不再如此：医学图像分割如今只是另一项编码任务。仅给定任务描述、标注数据和一块 CPU（没有分割框架、没有预训练权重、无人在环），四个现成编程智能体在数小时内为四种成像模态下的 13 个任务构建了分割器，这是一种涌现而非被构建出来的能力。在九个 2D 任务上，它们最好的程序达到 GPU 训练的 nnU-Net 的 Dice 的 99%。像任何代码一样，分割器通过修订和检查而改进，因此我们追问：同样的智能体能在多大程度上改进自己的分割，以及什么能解锁进一步的增益。对于未见病例没有参考，因此智能体检查其自身预测的渲染图：仅此一项就将最差的十分之一病例提升 0.09 Dice，并将边界误差（HD95）削减近四分之一。可达到的改进远不止于此。在被告知每次尝试的真实 Dice 后，同样的智能体在全部 14 个匹配对中都有改进，将失败掩膜的挽救率从 30% 提高到 85%，并且平均而言超过 GPU 训练的 nnU-Net，靠的是生成更好的掩膜，而不是在其中挑选。解锁这些增益的是一个质量信号，而无论是视觉检查、更多轮次，还是智能体自己训练的质量估计器，目前都尚未提供这一信号：我们称之为质量盲点。构建与修复的能力已经存在；下一步进展不会来自另一个分割模型，而会来自编程智能体可调用的无参考质量估计。

abstract: Laypeople increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for triage advice, but LLMs answer in variable free text, which makes it hard to evaluate them for use in medical devices. Decision models, which assign a probability to each predefined triage category, may be easier to evaluate. To test their triage accuracy, we evaluated 16 decision models (14 open-weight, 2 proprietary) on 233 synthetic and 10,000 real-world cases, yielding 163,728 total assessments. The best models triaged 72.1% of synthetic cases correctly and agreed with an existing algorithm in 56.1% of real-world cases. They were more promising for recognising emergencies early: given only demographics, chief complaints, risk factors and red-flag answers, the best model reached an AUROC of 0.87. At a 5% error margin, it could decide for or against emergencies for about half of users. Decision models should therefore not replace triage engines but could shorten symptom assessments at setting-specific error margins.
zh_abstract: 非专业人士越来越多地使用大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）获取分诊建议，但LLMs以可变的自由文本作答，这使其难以被评估用于医疗器械。决策模型为每个预定义分诊类别赋予一个概率，可能更易于评估。为测试其分诊准确性，我们在233个合成病例和10,000个真实世界病例上评估了16个决策模型（14个开放权重模型、2个专有模型），共产生163,728次评估。最佳模型正确分诊了72.1%的合成病例，并在56.1%的真实世界病例中与现有算法一致。它们在早期识别紧急情况方面更有前景：仅给定人口学信息、主诉、危险因素和危险信号回答，最佳模型达到0.87的AUROC。在5%误差界限下，它可为约一半用户判断是否为紧急情况。因此，决策模型不应取代分诊引擎，但可以在特定场景的误差界限下缩短症状评估。

abstract: [Clinical child psychology and psychiatry] BackgroundChildren and young people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots for mental health support, particularly when barriers limit access to traditional services. Although these systems are often perceived as accessible, immediate and non-judgemental, there is limited understanding of how they function within the complex developmental context of adolescence. Chatbots may simulate empathy and validation without possessing clinical judgement or contextual awareness, raising questions about safety, reliability and their influence on help-seeking behaviours.MethodThis commentary adopts an interdisciplinary perspective, integrating insights from clinical psychology, philosophy and machine learning. It draws on emerging evidence, conceptual analysis and approaches to AI safety evaluation.ResultsChatbot failures are most likely to occur in ambiguous or high-risk situations, where systems may provide misplaced reassurance, inappropriate validation or fail to recognise the need for escalation. Current evaluations often prioritise engagement and acceptability, overlooking clinically important risks. Young people need support to recognise the limitations of AI-generated advice and respond critically when systems operate beyond their competence.ConclusionsRigorous interdisciplinary frameworks are required to evaluate chatbot safety and effectiveness. Researchers should prioritise clinically meaningful outcomes, transparency and accountability, while ensuring responsibility for safe use is addressed as a collective ethical and public health concern.
zh_abstract: [Clinical child psychology and psychiatry] 【背景】儿童和年轻人越来越多地使用人工智能（AI）聊天机器人获取心理健康支持，尤其是在传统服务的可及性受到障碍限制时。尽管这些系统通常被认为易于获取、即时且不带评判，但对其在青春期复杂发展情境中如何发挥作用的理解仍然有限。聊天机器人可能模拟共情和认可，却不具备临床判断或情境意识，这引发了关于安全性、可靠性及其对求助行为影响的问题。【方法】本评论采用跨学科视角，整合临床心理学、哲学和机器学习的见解。它借鉴新兴证据、概念分析以及AI安全性评估方法。【结果】聊天机器人的失败最可能发生在模糊或高风险情境中，此时系统可能提供不恰当的安慰、不适当的认可，或未能认识到需要升级处理。当前评估往往优先考虑参与度和可接受性，忽视了临床重要的风险。年轻人需要支持，以认识AI生成建议的局限性，并在系统超出其能力范围时作出批判性回应。【结论】需要严格的跨学科框架来评估聊天机器人的安全性和有效性。研究人员应优先关注具有临床意义的结果、透明度和问责制，同时确保将安全使用责任作为集体伦理和公共卫生关切加以处理。

abstract: [Journal of chemical theory and computation] Adaptive sampling accelerates the exploration of conformational space in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations by repeatedly analyzing the accumulated trajectories and seeding a new round of simulations from informative configurations. A growing collection of adaptive sampling policies has been proposed, each built around a particular notion of what makes a configuration informative, yet these methods are scattered across separate and often incompatible implementations, which complicates their systematic comparison and their combined use in meta-adaptive sampling schemes. Here, we present AdaptivePy, a compact and extensible Python framework that implements nine seed-selection policies behind a single configuration-driven interface, spanning simple population-based baselines, several established machine-learning and geometry-based methods, and two ensemble or meta-sampling policies introduced in this work. We show that the shared implementation reproduces the characteristic selection behavior of each policy on a series of analytic benchmark landscapes. We also introduce a new adaptive sampling scheme that employs TS-DAR, a deep learning framework originally designed to identify transition states, as an acquisition criterion that drives the discovery of an entire multibasin landscape starting from a single basin. We further demonstrate that the common interface enables meta-adaptive sampling policies, which aggregate the rankings of several policies into a single set of seeds. We apply all nine policies to explicit-solvent simulations of alanine dipeptide and the miniprotein chignolin. The policy that performs best depends on the system, on the performance metric, and on the amount of accumulated sampling, justifying the use of meta-policies that combine different algorithms. AdaptivePy thereby provides a unified testbed for the adoption, benchmarking, and continued development of adaptive sampling methods for biomolecular MD simulations.
zh_abstract: [Journal of chemical theory and computation] 自适应采样通过反复分析已积累的轨迹，并从信息丰富的构象出发启动新一轮模拟，加速分子动力学（MD）模拟中对构象空间的探索。已提出越来越多的自适应采样策略，每种策略都围绕关于何种构象具有信息量的特定概念构建，但这些方法分散于彼此独立且常常不兼容的实现中，这使其系统比较以及在元自适应采样方案中的组合使用变得复杂。在此，我们提出 AdaptivePy，一个紧凑且可扩展的 Python 框架，在单一配置驱动接口后实现九种种子选择策略，涵盖简单的基于总体的基线、若干已有机器学习与基于几何的方法，以及本工作引入的两种集成或元采样策略。我们表明，共享实现在一系列解析基准景观上重现了每种策略的特征选择行为。我们还引入一种新的自适应采样方案，采用 TS-DAR——一个最初设计用于识别过渡态的深度学习框架——作为采集准则，驱动从单个盆地出发发现整个多盆地景观。我们进一步证明，该公共接口使元自适应采样策略成为可能，这些策略将若干策略的排名聚合为单一组种子。我们将全部九种策略应用于丙氨酸二肽和微型蛋白 chignolin 的显式溶剂模拟。表现最佳的策略取决于体系、性能指标以及已积累采样的数量，这证明使用结合不同算法的元策略是合理的。因此，AdaptivePy 为生物分子 MD 模拟中自适应采样方法的采用、基准测试和持续开发提供了统一测试平台。

title: Artificial intelligence and enhanced recovery after surgery: from protocol-driven pathways to adaptive perioperative care systems (cognitive ERAS).
zh_title: AI与加速康复外科：走向适应性围术期照护
summary: 综述提出ERAS从方案驱动转向AI与因果推理支持的自适应围术期照护（认知ERAS）。

abstract: [Minerva anestesiologica] Enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) programs have transformed perioperative care through standardized, evidence-based pathways, improving outcomes across surgical specialties. However, increasing patient complexity and heterogeneity expose important limitations of protocol-driven approaches, which often fail to capture dynamic physiological variability and individualized recovery trajectories. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers a pathway to overcome these constraints by integrating longitudinal perioperative data and generating individualized risk predictions. However, prediction alone is insufficient for clinically meaningful personalization, which requires causal reasoning to estimate which interventions are most likely to improve outcomes for specific patients and at different stages of recovery. In this context, ERAS may evolve toward a data-informed, adaptive care system that integrates prediction, causal inference, and supervised workflow coordination. Emerging agentic AI systems may further extend ERAS beyond passive decision support toward structured care orchestration within defined clinical governance boundaries. This review examines how different AI methodologies, including supervised learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, natural language processing, generative models, and causal inference, can be aligned with ERAS objectives across the perioperative continuum. We also critically evaluate current evidence and key barriers to implementation. Looking forward, the convergence of AI, digital health technologies, and continuous patient monitoring may enable the emergence of cognitive ERAS, a data-driven perioperative care model that integrates prediction, causal estimation, and continuous learning to deliver personalized and dynamically adaptive recovery pathways.
zh_abstract: [Minerva anestesiologica] 加速康复外科（ERAS）项目通过标准化、循证路径改变了围手术期护理，改善了各外科专科的结局。然而，患者复杂性和异质性的增加暴露出方案驱动方法的重要局限性，这些方法往往无法捕捉动态生理变异性和个体化康复轨迹。人工智能（AI）提供了一条通过整合纵向围手术期数据并生成个体化风险预测来克服这些限制的途径。然而，仅有预测不足以实现具有临床意义的个体化，这需要因果推理来估计哪些干预措施最可能改善特定患者以及康复不同阶段的结局。在此背景下，ERAS 可能演变为一个数据知情、自适应的护理系统，整合预测、因果推断和监督式工作流程协调。新兴的代理式 AI 系统可能进一步将 ERAS 从被动决策支持扩展到在既定临床治理边界内进行结构化护理编排。本综述探讨了不同 AI 方法，包括监督学习、深度学习、强化学习、自然语言处理、生成模型和因果推断，如何在围手术期连续过程中与 ERAS 目标保持一致。我们还批判性评估了当前证据和实施的关键障碍。展望未来，AI、数字健康技术和持续患者监测的融合可能促成认知 ERAS 的出现，这是一种数据驱动的围手术期护理模式，整合预测、因果估计和持续学习，以提供个体化且动态自适应的康复路径。
