abstract: Monitoring Activities of Daily Living (ADLs) supports safety and well-being for people living at home, especially older adults, and radar sensing is gaining increasing attention in the field of activity recognition for its ability to ensure privacy in the home while also surpassing technical limitations of other sensing modalities. However, radar-based activity recognition remains constrained by the limited availability of large-scale datasets. We introduce the Radar-based Activities of Daily Living (R-ADL) dataset to addresses the gaps identified in existing work: 1) it expands the scale of available data by providing over eight hours of annotated recordings in which a person performs eight distinct activities; 2) it overcomes room configuration limitations by recording from five different locations in a two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment; and 3) it extends beyond primitive actions to focus on high-level ADLs. In addition to the dataset, this paper introduces practical guidance for future ADL dataset construction. We conducted a detailed analysis of how ADLs are prioritized across academic research, health survey tools, and clinical trials to identify clinically significant ADLs. Furthermore, we provide our experimental design, data collection and annotation strategies, post-processing pipeline for forming the R-ADL dataset from raw data, and baseline results on standard machine learning architectures. The R-ADL dataset serves as a valuable resource for advancing ADL recognition systems as we continue building larger and more diverse datasets.
zh_abstract: 监测日常生活活动（ADLs）有助于支持居家生活者尤其是老年人的安全与福祉，而雷达传感因其在家庭内保障隐私的能力，同时超越其他传感模态的技术局限，在活动识别领域正受到越来越多关注。然而，基于雷达的活动识别仍受限于大规模数据集的可用性有限。我们引入基于雷达的日常生活活动（R-ADL）数据集，以弥补现有工作中的空白：1）它通过提供超过8小时的标注记录扩展了可用数据的规模，其中一个人执行8种不同活动；2）它通过在两室两卫公寓的5个不同位置进行记录，克服了房间配置限制；3）它超越基本动作，聚焦高层级ADLs。除数据集外，本文还为未来ADL数据集构建提供实用指南。我们详细分析了ADLs在学术研究、健康调查工具和临床试验中如何被优先考虑，以识别具有临床意义的ADLs。此外，我们提供实验设计、数据收集与标注策略、从原始数据形成R-ADL数据集的后处理流程，以及标准机器学习架构上的基线结果。随着我们继续构建更大、更多样化的数据集，R-ADL数据集可作为推进ADL识别系统的宝贵资源。

title: Decision-Native Multimodal Clinical Modeling via Anatomical Grounding and Confidence Calibration
zh_title: 解剖定位与置信校准的决策式多模态CT建模
summary: 提出Radev多模态模型，用解剖引导视觉压缩与反事实置信监督，实现单次前向的CT临床决策预测。
key_points: 冻结3D编码器提取可复用器官级特征
按预测解剖边界选取2D切片特征
单次前向估计候选概率，免自回归解码
引入反事实置信监督改善校准
reason: 预印本新方法有明确设计但未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Structured clinical decisions from volumetric computed tomography (CT) require anatomically grounded predictions and calibrated confidence estimates. However, existing 3D medical multimodal models often suffer from uncalibrated autoregressive decoding and shortcut reliance on irrelevant anatomical regions. We introduce Radev, a decision-native multimodal model that integrates anatomy-guided visual compression, direct candidate prediction, and counterfactual confidence supervision. To bridge global context with fine-grained slice details, a frozen 3D encoder extracts reusable organ-level features, which are dynamically selected by the query to attend to 2D slice features within predicted anatomical bounds. The resulting compact visual tokens enable the language backbone to estimate candidate probabilities in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding. We further propose Counterfactual-Calibrated Training (CCT) to compare predictions under intact and intervened organ representations. CCT encourages confidence to decrease when removing target-organ evidence degrades decision quality, while penalizing excessive confidence drops under unrelated-organ removal. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we construct CT-Verdict, a comprehensive benchmark spanning binary finding presence, multiple-choice questions, and ordinal severity assessment across both in-distribution and external cohorts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Radev significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both decision accuracy and confidence calibration, while generalizing robustly under distribution shifts. Project page at https://juntaojianggavin.github.io/projects/Radev/
zh_abstract: 来自容积计算机断层扫描（CT）的结构化临床决策需要具有解剖学依据的预测和校准的置信度估计。然而，现有3D医学多模态模型常受未校准的自回归解码以及对无关解剖区域的捷径依赖影响。我们引入Radev，这是一种决策原生多模态模型，整合了解剖引导的视觉压缩、直接候选预测和反事实置信度监督。为将全局上下文与细粒度切片细节桥接，冻结的3D编码器提取可复用的器官级特征，这些特征由查询动态选择，以在预测的解剖边界内关注2D切片特征。由此产生的紧凑视觉标记使语言主干能够在单次前向传播中估计候选概率，而无需自回归解码。我们进一步提出反事实校准训练（CCT），以比较完整器官表征与干预后器官表征下的预测。CCT鼓励在移除目标器官证据导致决策质量下降时置信度降低，同时惩罚移除无关器官时置信度的过度下降。为便于严格评估，我们构建CT-Verdict，这是一个综合基准，涵盖二分类表现存在、多项选择题和序数严重程度评估，覆盖分布内和外部队列。大量实验表明，Radev在决策准确性和置信度校准方面均显著优于最先进方法，同时在分布偏移下稳健泛化。项目页面：https://juntaojianggavin.github.io/projects/Radev/

title: BioLoom: Scaling Biomedical Vision-Language Models by Learning from the Structure of Scientific Articles
zh_title: BioLoom：用论文结构扩展生物医学视觉语言模型
summary: 把论文图、子图、图注与正文间的结构关系引入对比图文监督，用于生物医学视觉语言模型预训练。
key_points: 保留精确图文匹配作为强正样本
对子图与同篇他图图注引入弱正监督
对同内容跨文章样本提高负样本权重
reason: 有新意的预印本预训练方法，但条目未给出量化结果与外部评测，证据有限。
abstract: The development of biomedical vision-language models (VLMs) with contrastive image-text pretraining has been driven by scaling to increasingly large and diverse image-text datasets. Beyond scaling, further progress can come from learning richer representations from existing data. We hypothesize that the structure of scientific literature itself provides an additional source of supervision: figures, panels, captions, and accompanying article text encode rich relationships across modalities. Yet, treating these as independent image-text pairs overlooks their relationships. To address this limitation, we incorporate these structural relationships into contrastive image-text supervision. We preserve exact image-text matches while introducing weaker positive supervision for related pairs, such as a panel and the caption of a sibling panel. We upweight cross-article negatives of the same content type to encourage finer discrimination. We also enrich panel descriptions using visual content, original figure captions, and mentioning paragraphs. Pairing panels with these descriptions and whole figures with their original captions yields Loom52M, a dataset of 52.4 million image-text pairs spanning scientific charts and biomedical images. Using Loom52M, BioLoom (DFN-2B) achieves 56.82% domain-balanced mean accuracy across 67 zero-shot classification tasks from 43 datasets in 10 domains, compared with 48.77% for MedPMC-CLIP. On BioLoomBench with concise captions and BioMedFlickr, it achieves bidirectional mean Recall@1 of 63.20% and 10.59%, versus 46.37% and 7.55% for the respective strongest evaluated baselines, BiomedCLIP and MedPMC-CLIP. Code, datasets, benchmarks, and models are available at https://bioloom-clip.github.io/.
zh_abstract: 具有对比式图像-文本预训练的生物医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）的发展，一直由扩展到日益庞大且多样的图像-文本数据集所驱动。除扩展规模外，进一步进展还可来自从现有数据中学习更丰富的表征。我们假设，科学文献本身的结构提供了额外的监督来源：图、子图面板、图注以及随附的正文文本编码了跨模态的丰富关系。然而，将这些视为独立的图像-文本对会忽略它们之间的关系。为解决这一局限，我们将这些结构关系纳入对比式图像-文本监督。我们保留精确的图像-文本匹配，同时为相关对（例如某个子图面板与同级面板的图注）引入较弱的正监督。我们提高同一内容类型的跨文章负样本的权重，以促进更精细的区分。我们还利用视觉内容、原始图注和提及段落来丰富面板描述。将面板与这些描述配对、将整图与其原始图注配对，得到Loom52M——一个包含5240万图像-文本对、涵盖科学图表和生物医学图像的数据集。使用Loom52M，BioLoom（DFN-2B）在来自10个领域43个数据集的67项零样本分类任务上取得56.82%的领域平衡平均准确率，而MedPMC-CLIP为48.77%。在采用简洁图注的BioLoomBench和BioMedFlickr上，其双向平均Recall@1分别为63.20%和10.59%，而各自最强的被评估基线BiomedCLIP和MedPMC-CLIP分别为46.37%和7.55%。代码、数据集、基准和模型可在https://bioloom-clip.github.io/获取。

title: Targeting protein degradation strategies in drug discovery: integrating PROTACs, ubiquitination biology, and AI-driven design.
zh_title: 靶向蛋白降解与AI驱动设计综述
summary: 综述整合PROTAC设计、泛素化生物学与AI驱动设计，梳理影响蛋白降解药物转化的关键决定因素。

降解成败取决于可降解性、E3募集、连接子与三元复合物

abstract: [Molecular biomedicine] Targeted protein degradation (TPD) has emerged as a transformative therapeutic strategy for eliminating disease-associated proteins, including targets that remain challenging to modulate using conventional occupancy-driven inhibitors. Among TPD approaches, proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) exploit the ubiquitin-proteasome system (UPS) to induce selective and event-driven degradation of proteins of interest (POIs). Despite rapid advances in PROTAC development, successful translation depends on interconnected determinants, including target degradability, ubiquitin ligase (E3) recruitment, warhead and linker properties, ternary-complex formation, ubiquitination efficiency, intracellular exposure, and pharmacokinetic behavior. This review provides an integrated, mechanism-oriented analysis of these determinants by linking PROTAC design, ubiquitination biology, computational approaches, and clinical development. We examine key principles governing PROTAC-mediated degradation, with emphasis on E3-ligase selection, linker design, ternary-complex geometry and cooperativity, ubiquitin (Ub)-acceptor lysine (Lys) accessibility, ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme (E2)/E3 context, proteasomal engagement, inefficient degradation, and the hook effect. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning for degradation-activity prediction, E3-ligase/POI pairing, ligand and linker optimization, ternary-complex modeling, and absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) assessment are critically evaluated alongside their technical and translational limitations. Preclinical developments, clinical-stage degraders, emerging TPD modalities, and major barriers to translation are also discussed. We propose an integrated framework linking distinct target ubiquitination patterns, degrader design, ternary-complex geometry, AI-enabled prediction, and pharmacokinetic/clinical constraints, providing a mechanism-informed roadmap for the rational development of next-generation protein degraders and identifying mechanistic bottlenecks and translational priorities across therapeutic settings.
zh_abstract: [Molecular biomedicine] 靶向蛋白质降解（TPD）已成为一种变革性治疗策略，用于消除疾病相关蛋白质，包括使用传统占位驱动抑制剂仍难以调节的靶点。在 TPD 方法中，蛋白水解靶向嵌合体（PROTACs）利用泛素-蛋白酶体系统（UPS）诱导感兴趣蛋白质（POIs）的选择性和事件驱动降解。尽管 PROTAC 开发取得了快速进展，但成功的转化取决于相互关联的决定因素，包括靶点可降解性、泛素连接酶（E3）募集、弹头和连接子特性、三元复合物形成、泛素化效率、细胞内暴露和药代动力学行为。本综述通过将 PROTAC 设计、泛素化生物学、计算方法和临床开发联系起来，对这些决定因素进行了综合的、以机制为导向的分析。我们研究了支配 PROTAC 介导降解的关键原则，重点包括 E3 连接酶选择、连接子设计、三元复合物几何结构和协同性、泛素（Ub）受体赖氨酸（Lys）可及性、泛素结合酶（E2）/E3 背景、蛋白酶体参与、低效降解和钩子效应。近期人工智能（AI）和机器学习在降解活性预测、E3 连接酶/POI 配对、配体和连接子优化、三元复合物建模以及吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）评估方面的进展，连同其技术和转化局限性，被批判性评估。还讨论了临床前开发、临床阶段降解剂、新兴 TPD 模式以及转化的主要障碍。我们提出了一个整合框架，将不同的靶点泛素化模式、降解剂设计、三元复合物几何结构、AI 赋能预测和药代动力学/临床约束联系起来，为合理开发下一代蛋白质降解剂提供机制指导的路线图，并确定跨治疗环境的机制瓶颈和转化优先事项。

title: Concerns over spillover, exclusions, and hospital unit differences in an AI early warning system trial (CONCERN-EWS)
zh_title: 对AI早期预警系统试验的溢出效应与排除偏倚质疑
summary: 评论指出该整群随机试验存在ICU床位溢出、高危患者被排除及病房差异等问题，可能影响效应估计。
key_points: 原试验报告干预组住院死亡风险降低36%（HR 0.64）
质疑对照组的ICU床位溢出可能恶化其结局
干预相关决策或导致高危患者被更多排除
reason: 针对AI试验方法学的实质评论，属观点文章档
abstract: Rossetti et al. report that hospitalized patients whose care was informed by an AI-based clinical deterioration early warning system (EWS) were 36% less likely to die during a pragmatic cluster-randomized trial when compared to patients on usual care units without the EWS (adjusted hazard ratio [HR], 0.64; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.53-0.78).1 The authors should be applauded for conducting a trial evaluating the effect of an AI intervention on patient health outcomes; more such trials are needed. Several aspects of the study, however, raise concerns that its findings may not accurately reflect the effect of the EWS. First, spillover effects on availability of scarce intensive care unit (ICU) beds could have led to worse outcomes for patients in the control group. Second, EWS-informed clinical decisions may have led to more frequent exclusion of high-risk patients from the intervention group. Either of these concerns could have led to overestimation of AI benefit. Finally, large pre-trial differences in hospital unit mortality rates suggest that unreported cluster-level imbalance or between-cluster variance could also have affected trial results.
zh_abstract: Rossetti 等报告，在一项实用性整群随机试验中，与未使用 EWS 的常规护理病房患者相比，接受基于人工智能的临床恶化早期预警系统（EWS）信息指导治疗的住院患者死亡可能性低36%（校正风险比[HR]，0.64；95%置信区间[CI]，0.53-0.78）。1 作者开展评估人工智能干预对患者健康结局影响的试验，应受到赞扬；还需要更多此类试验。然而，该研究的若干方面引发担忧，即其发现可能未准确反映 EWS 的效果。第一，对稀缺重症监护病房（ICU）床位可用性的溢出效应可能导致对照组患者结局更差。第二，依据 EWS 信息作出的临床决策可能导致高风险患者更频繁地被排除在干预组之外。上述任一担忧都可能导致对人工智能获益的高估。最后，试验前医院病房死亡率的大幅差异提示，未报告的整群层面不平衡或群间方差也可能影响试验结果。

title: Leveraging HCUP Data to Predict Preventable Admissions in Patients with Chronic Kidney Diseases
zh_title: 基于HCUP数据预测CKD患者可预防住院
summary: 预印本用马里兰州HCUP数据训练机器学习模型预测CKD患者90天可预防住院，并比较不同种族模型表现。
key_points: 纳入28214名CKD患者，14%发生可预防住院
LR与RF、XGBoost相当，优于KNN
模型在黑人群体中表现略好
reason: 回顾性大样本但仅内部验证、指标提升有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Objectives: This study developed machine learning (ML) to predict 90-day preventable admissions in CKD patients while evaluating racial disparities in model performance. Materials and Methods: Study population included CKD patients (above 18 years) with hospital encounters in Maryland (2016-2023). Logistic regression (LR), random forest (RF), XGBoost, and k-nearest neighbors (KNN) models were used to predict 90-day preventable admissions after a CKD outpatient visit. Data used in this study was extracted from Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project (HCUP). Results: 28,214 unique patients were included, of whom 3974 (14%) experienced a subsequent preventable admission. LR achieved comparable performance with RF and XGBoost (AuROC 0.784 - 0.788, AuPRC 0.397 - 0.416), outperforming KNN (AuROC 0.753, AuPRC 0.342). All models performed marginally better in the Black population (AuROC 0.773 - 0.807, AuPRC 0.369 - 0.467) than in the white population (AuROC 0.738 - 0.776, AuPRC 0.329 - 0.394). The false negative rates (FNR) in the white population were higher across different models (Black: 0.236 - 0.33, white: 0.297 - 0.377). Discussion: Our results suggest that LR can achieve comparable prediction performances than tree-based ML algorithms. Hospital utilization and congestive heart failure are among the most important predictors across models. Further analyses on prediction bias revealed that FNRs are more significant in white patients, which can be due to their overall lower utilization. Conclusions: This study demonstrated a pipeline to develop ML models predicting preventable admissions while revealing existing racial biases. These findings can inform ambulatory settings on how to reduce preventable admissions among CKD patients.
zh_abstract: 【目的】本研究开发机器学习（ML）以预测 CKD 患者 90 天可预防入院，同时评估模型性能中的种族差异。【材料与方法】研究人群包括在马里兰州（2016-2023 年）有医院就诊记录的 CKD 患者（18 岁以上）。使用逻辑回归（LR）、随机森林（RF）、XGBoost 和 k 近邻（KNN）模型预测 CKD 门诊就诊后 90 天可预防入院。本研究使用的数据提取自医疗成本与利用项目（Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project, HCUP）。【结果】共纳入 28,214 名唯一患者，其中 3974 名（14%）经历了随后的一次可预防入院。LR 与 RF 和 XGBoost 达到相当的性能（AuROC 0.784 - 0.788，AuPRC 0.397 - 0.416），优于 KNN（AuROC 0.753，AuPRC 0.342）。所有模型在黑人人群中的表现略好（AuROC 0.773 - 0.807，AuPRC 0.369 - 0.467）于白人人群（AuROC 0.738 - 0.776，AuPRC 0.329 - 0.394）。白人人群中的假阴性率（FNR）在不同模型中均更高（黑人：0.236 - 0.33，白人：0.297 - 0.377）。【讨论】我们的结果提示，LR 可以达到与基于树的 ML 算法相当的预测性能。医院利用情况和充血性心力衰竭是各模型中最重要的预测因素之一。对预测偏倚的进一步分析显示，FNR 在白人患者中更显著，这可能是由于其总体利用率较低。【结论】本研究展示了一条开发预测可预防入院的 ML 模型并揭示现有种族偏倚的流程。这些发现可为门诊环境提供信息，说明如何减少 CKD 患者的可预防入院。

title: JECT: Addressing the Context Shortcut in Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for Chest CT
zh_title: JECT：缓解胸部CT联合嵌入预测中的上下文捷径
summary: arXiv 预印本提出 JECT，让放射报告同时充当预测器条件与编码器预测目标，以缓解胸部 CT 自监督预训练中的上下文捷径。
key_points: 指出小结节等关键征象难以由周边解剖预测，致使编码器欠拟合关键征象
以放射报告作为预测器条件，并通过掩码章节文本预测让编码器学习解剖章节
采用分层三维编码器进行胸部 CT 自监督预训练
reason: 方法有新意但仅预印本、未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn by predicting features of masked regions from visible context. In chest computed tomography, the findings that decide a diagnosis, such as a small nodule, are often not predictable from the surrounding anatomy. A hidden finding is then best predicted toward normal anatomy, and the prediction loss stops rewarding the encoder for representing it. We call this the context shortcut. Conditioning the predictor on the radiology report repairs the prediction, but in our setup the encoder gains little over image-only pretraining: the report supplies what the encoder never had to learn. JECT therefore gives the report two roles: a condition for the predictor and, through masked section-text prediction, a target for the encoder, which must predict the report's anatomical sections from the unmasked scan. A hierarchical three-dimensional encoder that predicts at every stage keeps this clinical content at every scale. In ablations, the text target improves classification and localization, while conditioning adds little to the encoder. Trained from scratch on 173k volumes, the recipe reaches the level of current computed tomography foundation models in classification, retrieval and nodule malignancy, and of task-specific models in lung-cancer risk prediction after fine-tuning. Conditioning still matters: its predictor can be reused, with no extra training, to show where a report sentence acts, changing most at the finding the sentence describes. Code and pretrained weights are available.
zh_abstract: 联合嵌入预测架构通过从可见上下文预测被掩蔽区域的特征来学习。在胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）中，决定诊断的征象（如小结节）往往无法从周围解剖结构预测。此时，隐藏征象最容易被预测为正常解剖结构，预测损失便不再奖励编码器对其进行表征。我们将此称为上下文捷径（context shortcut）。以放射学报告作为预测器的条件可修复预测，但在我们的设置中，编码器相较于仅图像预训练获益甚微：报告提供了编码器本无需学习的内容。因此，JECT 赋予报告两种角色：作为预测器的条件，并通过掩蔽章节文本预测，作为编码器的目标——编码器必须从未掩蔽扫描（unmasked scan）预测报告的解剖章节。一个在每个阶段都进行预测的分层三维编码器将这一临床内容保留在每个尺度上。在消融实验中，文本目标改善了分类和定位，而条件作用对编码器的增益很小。在 17.3 万（173k）个体积上从头训练，该方案在分类、检索和结节恶性程度方面达到当前 CT 基础模型的水平，并在微调后于肺癌风险预测方面达到任务专用模型的水平。条件作用仍然重要：其预测器可在无需额外训练的情况下重复使用，以显示报告句子在何处起作用，并在该句子所描述的征象处变化最大。代码和预训练权重已公开。

title: Evaluating Prominent Machine Translation Models for Kinyarwanda to English for Patient-Provider Conversations
zh_title: 卢旺达语至英语医患对话机器翻译系统评测
summary: 预印本用 600 段卢旺达语医患对话与专业译员评分，评测 GPT-5、GPT-4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Azure、Google 翻译与 NLLB-200。
key_points: 600 段对话按三个疫情时期分层，来自卢旺达 WelTel 平台
使用语义相似度、BLEU、chrF、TER 及三名专业译员 0-100 评分
关注低资源语言在临床沟通中的翻译质量缺口
reason: 有专业参考语料与人工评分，但无下游临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Background Linguistic barriers between patients and providers cause diagnostic error, poor adherence, and adverse events, and disproportionately affect speakers of low-resource languages. Kinyarwanda, spoken by more than 20 million people, has a small digital footprint, and the quality of off-the-shelf machine translation (MT) for its clinical dialogue is poorly documented. Methods We evaluated six MT systems (GPT-5, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Azure Translate, Google Translate, and NLLB-200) for Kinyarwanda-to-English patient-provider conversations. Using a professional reference corpus of 600 conversations, stratified across three pandemic periods and collected in Rwanda via the WelTel platform, we assessed automated metrics (semantic similarity, BLEU, chrF, and translation edit rate [TER]) and 0-100 quality ratings from three professional Kinyarwanda-English translators, with reliability quantified by intraclass correlation (ICC). De-identified secondary data were approved by UBC (H20-01031) and the Rwanda National Ethics Committee (100/RNEC/2020). Findings On the full 600-conversation cohort, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-5, and Gemini 2.5 Flash had closely clustered semantic similarity (0.877, 0.874, 0.873), well above Azure Translate (0.809) and NLLB-200 (0.754); Gemini 2.5 Flash led on BLEU (43.13) and the lowest TER (68.15). Translators ranked GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Flash highest (means 81.55 and 81.51), then GPT-4o-mini (72.67), Azure Translate (55.16), and NLLB-200 (39.05); average-rater reliability was moderate (ICC 0.594, rising to 0.701 on a balanced 85-conversation subset). Automated n-gram metrics understated the quality gap human raters perceived between large language models and conventional systems. Interpretation GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Flash are the strongest off-the-shelf systems for Kinyarwanda-English clinical translation and primary choices for human-in-the-loop use, with GPT-4o-mini a cost-efficient alternative. NLLB-200 underperformed, showing that models built for low-resource languages are not automatically suited to specialised clinical domains without fine-tuning. Human evaluation should be prioritised over automated metrics alone when comparing LLM-based translation.
zh_abstract: 【背景】患者与医疗服务提供者之间的语言障碍会导致诊断错误、依从性差和不良事件，并对低资源语言使用者造成不成比例的影响。卢旺达语（Kinyarwanda）有超过 2000 万人使用，但其数字足迹很小，且现成机器翻译（MT）在其临床对话中的质量鲜有记录。【方法】我们评估了六种 MT 系统（GPT-5、GPT-4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Azure Translate、Google Translate 和 NLLB-200）在卢旺达语到英语的患者-提供者对话中的表现。使用包含 600 段对话的专业参考语料库（按三个大流行时期分层，并通过 WelTel 平台在卢旺达收集），我们评估了自动化指标（语义相似度、BLEU、chrF 和翻译编辑率 [TER]）以及三名专业卢旺达语-英语译员给出的 0–100 质量评分，信度通过组内相关系数（ICC）量化。去标识化二次数据的使用经 UBC（H20-01031）和卢旺达国家伦理委员会（100/RNEC/2020）批准。【结果】在完整的 600 段对话队列中，GPT-4o-mini、GPT-5 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash 的语义相似度紧密聚集（0.877、0.874、0.873），远高于 Azure Translate（0.809）和 NLLB-200（0.754）；Gemini 2.5 Flash 在 BLEU（43.13）和最低 TER（68.15）上领先。译员对 GPT-5 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash 评分最高（均值 81.55 和 81.51），其次是 GPT-4o-mini（72.67）、Azure Translate（55.16）和 NLLB-200（39.05）；平均评分者信度为中等（ICC 0.594，在平衡的 85 段对话子集上升至 0.701）。自动化 n-gram 指标低估了人类评分者在大型语言模型与传统系统之间感知到的质量差距。【结论】GPT-5 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash 是卢旺达语-英语临床翻译最强的现成系统，也是人在回路（human-in-the-loop）使用的主要选择，GPT-4o-mini 则是具有成本效益的替代方案。NLLB-200 表现不佳，表明为低资源语言构建的模型在未经微调的情况下并不自动适用于专业临床领域。在比较基于 LLM 的翻译时，应优先进行人工评估，而非仅依赖自动化指标。

title: Genome-to-Image Translation: Reconstructing Escherichia coli Morphology from Genomic Sequences
zh_title: 基因组到图像：从基因序列重建大肠杆菌形态
summary: arXiv预印本用基因组语言模型嵌入加条件WGAN，由菌株基因组合成菌落图像，探索耐药状态的可视化预测。
key_points: 将耐药表型预测表述为条件图像生成问题
冻结基因组语言模型聚合为768维向量
基于167,356张单细胞图像训练
reason: 有新意的预印本方法且数据规模可观，但未经同行评审、缺乏外部验证
abstract: Antimicrobial resistance in Escherichia coli is established in routine practice by culture-based susceptibility testing, which is slow relative to the clinical need for an early treatment decision. Resistance status also leaves a measurable trace in cell morphology, and whole-genome sequencing of clinical isolates is increasingly available, which raises the question of whether colony appearance can be predicted directly from an isolate's genome. We formulate this as a conditional image-generation problem. The assembled contigs of each isolate are encoded into a single 768-dimensional vector by a frozen genomic language model through a segment-contig-isolate aggregation hierarchy, and a conditional Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty synthesizes colony images from this embedding together with the applied antibiotic and the resistance label. We train on 167,356 single-cell images from 22 clinical blood isolates imaged under azithromycin, ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, and a no-drug control, compare seven pretrained convolutional backbones inside the generator, and select ConvNeXt-Tiny on distributional image-quality metrics. The synthetic images are then assessed extrinsically: added to a reduced real training set, they improve per-antibiotic resistance classification, with a significant gain in resistant-class recall.
zh_abstract: 在大肠埃希菌（Escherichia coli）中，抗菌药物耐药性在常规实践中通过基于培养的药敏试验确定，这相对于早期治疗决策的临床需求而言较为缓慢。耐药状态也在细胞形态中留下可测量的痕迹，而临床分离株的全基因组测序日益可得，这引出了一个问题：菌落外观能否直接根据分离株的基因组预测。我们将此表述为一个条件图像生成问题。每个分离株组装后的重叠群（contigs）通过“片段—重叠群—分离株”聚合层级，由冻结的基因组语言模型编码为单个768维向量，而带梯度惩罚的条件Wasserstein GAN利用该嵌入连同所用抗菌药物和耐药标签合成菌落图像。我们在来自22株临床血液分离株的167,356张单细胞图像上训练，这些图像是在阿奇霉素、环丙沙星、四环素以及无药对照条件下成像获得；在生成器内比较了七种预训练卷积主干，并基于分布性图像质量指标选择ConvNeXt-Tiny。随后对合成图像进行外部评估：将其加入缩减后的真实训练集后，可改善按抗菌药物区分的耐药性分类，并在耐药类召回率上取得显著提升。

title: Effect of a feedback loop on clinical prediction model performance
zh_title: 反馈回路对临床预测模型性能影响的模拟研究
summary: medRxiv模拟研究量化模型影响治疗决策后数据回流的反馈回路效应，并检验纳入治疗变量能否缓解性能退化。
key_points: 以心血管病预测与干预参数设定模拟场景
模型更新数据包含其自身影响治疗的患者
比较是否将治疗作为预测变量及未测混杂情形
reason: 方法学问题重要但为纯模拟预印本，无真实队列验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Clinical prediction models (CPMs) that guide treatment-initiation, and therefore affect patient outcomes, may create feedback loops when updated using data from patients whose care they influenced. Treatment can alter predictor-outcome relationships and outcome prevalence, potentially reducing model performance. This simulation study aims to quantify this effect using setting parameters based on cardiovascular disease prediction and intervention and assess if including a treatment variable in the model mitigates any performance degradation. In the simulation, models were developed to predict the probability of a binary adverse outcome, guide treatment allocation, and then updated using data containing patients in whom the model was applied. Scenarios varied treatment inclusion as a predictor in the model and the presence of unmeasured confounding. Performance was assessed with calibration-in-the-large, calibration slope, c-statistic, and correct risk assignment relative to treatment threshold. Without unmeasured confounding, excluding treatment as a predictor resulted in miscalibration, but including treatment solves this problem completely. With unmeasured confounding, performance deteriorated even when treatment was included. These results agree with previous findings and illustrate the likelihood that models that guide interventions may experience performance deterioration due to the difficulty of recording treatment and avoiding unmeasured confounders. Causal inference methods combined with risk prediction may help address this problem. Further research is needed on monitoring techniques to allow detection of this issue post-model implementation.
zh_abstract: 指导治疗启动并因此影响患者结局的临床预测模型（clinical prediction models, CPMs），在使用其所影响患者的照护数据更新时，可能产生反馈回路。治疗可改变预测因素—结局关系以及结局患病率，从而可能降低模型性能。本模拟研究旨在使用基于心血管疾病预测和干预的场景参数来量化这一效应，并评估在模型中纳入治疗变量是否能减轻任何性能退化。在模拟中，开发模型以预测二分类不良结局的概率、指导治疗分配，然后使用包含模型所应用患者的数据进行更新。场景变化包括是否将治疗作为模型中的预测因素，以及是否存在未测量混杂。性能通过大尺度校准（calibration-in-the-large）、校准斜率、c统计量（c-statistic）以及相对于治疗阈值的正确风险分配进行评估。在无未测量混杂时，将治疗排除作为预测因素会导致校准不良，但纳入治疗可完全解决该问题。在存在未测量混杂时，即使纳入治疗，性能也会下降。这些结果与既往发现一致，并说明指导干预的模型可能因记录治疗和避免未测量混杂因素困难而出现性能下降。因果推断方法结合风险预测可能有助于解决该问题。仍需进一步研究监测技术，以便在模型实施后检测该问题。

title: The AMPEL Platform: An Open-Source Project for Developing Hospital-Wide Clinical Decision Support Systems under EU-Regulation
zh_title: AMPEL：符合欧盟MDR的开源院级CDSS平台
summary: 预印本介绍开源AMPEL平台，以Kafka事件驱动架构支持符合欧盟MDR要求的临床决策支持系统开发。
key_points: 基于Kafka的事件驱动分布式架构
面向欧盟MDR文档与风险管理义务
开源平台，摘要未报告临床评估结果
reason: 开源工程与合规框架有新意，但为预印本且无部署效果数据
abstract: As incentives to digitize more and more aspects of medical healthcare are gaining traction, additional medical data is becoming available. A major goal is to use this data to gain further insights, support medical staff, and ultimately improve patient care. This demands sophisticated solutions that can handle current and future vast amounts of data, all without disrupting well-established workflows of care takers. Additionally, the solution must fulfill the documentation and risk-management obligations of the Medical Device Regulation (MDR), which governs whether a device may be used in patient care in Europe. In this context, we introduce the AMPEL platform, an open-source solution for creating clinical decision support systems (CDSS) that fulfil the requirements of the MDR. Centered around a message broker (Kafka), it adopts an event-driven, distributed architecture, allowing for scaling and efficient processing of medical data as it gets generated. Relying on platform-specific events to implicitly describe the platform's interfaces makes it both extensible and agnostic to the hospital information system in use. With these events being defined in the Protocol Buffers format, medically evaluated algorithms can be independently implemented in a variety of programming languages and easily linked to the platform, extending its analytic capabilities as desired. The platform features a basic UI and alert functionality that can be used to gain medical staff's attention and present analysis results in a traceable and explainable fashion. We further show in a use case how the platform was used to build LAMPE, a CDSS developed and operated at University of Leipzig Medical Center. It demonstrates how the platform solution can be used in a complex and already established environment, while acknowledging current limitations and outlining planned developments to overcome these.
zh_abstract: 随着将医学医疗更多方面数字化的激励日益增强，额外的医疗数据正变得可用。一个主要目标是利用这些数据获得进一步洞见、支持医务人员，并最终改善患者照护。这需要复杂解决方案，能够处理当前和未来海量数据，同时不扰乱照护者已确立的工作流程。此外，该解决方案必须履行《医疗器械法规》（MDR）的文件和风险管理义务，该法规决定器械是否可在欧洲用于患者照护。在此背景下，我们介绍AMPEL平台，这是一个开源解决方案，用于创建满足MDR要求的临床决策支持系统（CDSS）。它以消息代理（Kafka）为中心，采用事件驱动的分布式架构，允许在医疗数据生成时进行扩展和高效处理。依靠平台特定事件来隐式描述平台接口，使其既具有可扩展性，又独立于所使用的医院信息系统。由于这些事件以Protocol Buffers格式定义，经医学评估的算法可在多种编程语言中独立实现，并轻松链接到平台，按需扩展其分析能力。该平台具有基本UI和警报功能，可用于引起医务人员注意，并以可追溯和可解释的方式呈现分析结果。我们进一步在一个用例中展示该平台如何用于构建LAMPE，这是一个在莱比锡大学医学中心开发和运行的CDSS。它展示了该平台解决方案如何在复杂且已建立的环境中应用，同时承认当前局限并概述为克服这些局限而计划的发展。

title: Optimizing Sepsis Treatment via Latent Protocol Inference
zh_title: 潜方案推断优化脓毒症治疗
summary: 预印本提出生成式潜方案模型GLPM，以潜变量解耦治疗轨迹生成与生存结局预测，用于脓毒症治疗优化。
key_points: 以入院状态锚定的潜方案变量作信息瓶颈
用最大似然估计建模治疗轨迹与结局联合分布
推断时将治疗优化视为概率反问题
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，但摘要未提外部验证或临床结局改善
abstract: Sepsis is a life-threatening medical emergency characterized by high mortality and variable treatment practices. Optimizing treatment from retrospective data is challenging due to sparse, delayed outcomes and complex physiological dynamics. We introduce the Generative Latent Protocol Model (GLPM), a probabilistic framework that structures clinical decision-making through a latent protocol variable anchored on the patient's admission state. This latent variable acts as an information bottleneck, decoupling the generation of treatment trajectories from the prediction of survival outcomes. Unlike methods that rely on value estimation or noisy return-to-go conditioning, our model is trained via maximum likelihood estimation to capture the joint distribution of treatment trajectories and outcomes. At inference time, we treat treatment optimization as a probabilistic inverse problem: we sample latent protocols from a posterior distribution conditioned on a target survival probability. On the ICU-Sepsis benchmark derived from MIMIC-III, our best variant matches or exceeds eight offline baselines on all five datasets, with gains that are statistically significant against every baseline on the most heterogeneous dataset, and offers interpretability through patient-specific counterfactual analysis.
zh_abstract: 脓毒症是一种以高死亡率和多变治疗实践为特征的危及生命的医疗急症。从回顾性数据优化治疗具有挑战性，因为结局稀疏、延迟且生理动力学复杂。我们引入生成潜在方案模型（GLPM），这是一个概率框架，通过锚定于患者入院状态的潜在方案变量来结构化临床决策。该潜在变量充当信息瓶颈，将治疗轨迹的生成与生存结局的预测解耦。不同于依赖价值估计或含噪的return-to-go条件化的方法，我们的模型通过最大似然估计训练，以捕捉治疗轨迹和结局的联合分布。在推断时，我们将治疗优化视为概率逆问题：我们从以目标生存概率为条件的后验分布中采样潜在方案。在源自MIMIC-III的ICU-Sepsis基准上，我们最佳变体在所有五个数据集上匹配或超过八个离线基线，在最异质的数据集上相对于每个基线的增益均具有统计学显著性，并通过患者特异性反事实分析提供可解释性。

title: GlycanPUG: WURCS-Based Heterogeneous Graph Pretraining for Structurally Ambiguous Glycans
zh_title: GlycanPUG：基于WURCS的糖链图预训练
summary: 预印本提出保留结构不确定性的异构图预训练模型GlycanPUG，用于糖链表征学习。
key_points: 基于WURCS 2.0保留候选连接与不确定属性
加权边异构图表征，含节点预增强模块
确定性IUPAC流程仅处理本队列43.1%
reason: 预印本方法有基线对比，但属小众基础研究方向，证据有限
abstract: Background: Glycans orchestrate diverse biological processes, yet they remain underrepresented in computational biology compared to proteins and nucleic acids. Although WURCS 2.0 provides a machine-readable structural representation that preserves uncertainty, the evaluated IUPAC-based deterministic workflow processes 43.1% of the GlyCosmos-derived cohort examined here, motivating approaches that retain structural ambiguity. Methods: To overcome this limitation, GlycanPUG (Probabilistic Uncertainty-aware Graph) was introduced as a pretrained graph model for glycan representation learning. By leveraging WURCS 2.0, GlycanPUG represents candidate linkages and substituent attachments using weighted edges and uncertainty attributes within a heterogeneous graph framework. A 4-layer Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network with a dedicated node pre-enhancement module aggregates edge features weighted by the assigned edge weights, enabling representation of supported structurally ambiguous glycans without selecting a single resolved structure. The model is pretrained on a preprocessed subset of the GlyTouCan1 repository, which contained 253,596 entries before filtering. After excluding entries linked to downstream tasks and applying sequential structural filtering, 167,020 samples remained and were used for pretraining. Pretraining comprised nine self-supervised tasks. Results: Benchmarking on the GlycanML dataset demonstrates that GlycanPUG shows competitive performance relative to GlycanGT across multi-label taxonomy classification and binary immunogenicity prediction. Crucially, on datasets natively containing structural uncertainties (GlyCosmos, GlyConnect), GlycanPUG effectively processes additional structurally ambiguous entries, achieving 83.5% processable coverage across all glycans from all biological sources in GlyCosmos, with taxonomic classification performance (e.g., mean macro F1 of 0.7376 for Domain). Ablation of the node pre-enhancement module reduces macro F1, and post-hoc analysis identifies rank-dependent associations between structural uncertainty and prediction errors. All results reported above are averaged over ten independent random seeds (1-10). Conclusions: GlycanPUG broadens the set of glycans that can be represented while retaining supported structural ambiguities.
zh_abstract: 【背景】聚糖协调多种生物过程，但与蛋白质和核酸相比，它们在计算生物学中仍代表性不足。尽管WURCS 2.0提供了一种保留不确定性的机器可读结构表示，但所评估的基于IUPAC的确定性工作流仅处理了此处检查的GlyCosmos衍生队列的43.1%，这促使采用保留结构歧义的方法。【方法】为克服这一局限，引入了GlycanPUG（Probabilistic Uncertainty-aware Graph，概率不确定性感知图），作为用于聚糖表示学习的预训练图模型。通过利用WURCS 2.0，GlycanPUG在异质图框架内使用加权边和不确定性属性表示候选连接和取代基连接。一个带有专用节点预增强模块的4层异质图神经网络聚合由所分配边权重加权的边特征，从而能够表示受支持的结构歧义聚糖，而无需选择单一已解析结构。该模型在GlyTouCan1存储库的预处理子集上预训练，该存储库在过滤前包含253,596条条目。在排除与下游任务相关的条目并应用顺序结构过滤后，剩余167,020个样本并用于预训练。预训练包括九个自监督任务。【结果】在GlycanML数据集上的基准测试表明，GlycanPUG在多标签分类学分类和二元免疫原性预测方面相对于GlycanGT表现出有竞争力的性能。关键的是，在原生包含结构不确定性的数据集（GlyCosmos、GlyConnect）上，GlycanPUG有效处理额外的结构歧义条目，在GlyCosmos中所有生物来源的所有聚糖上达到83.5%的可处理覆盖率，并具有分类学分类性能（例如，Domain的平均宏F1为0.7376）。消融节点预增强模块会降低宏F1，事后分析识别出结构不确定性与预测误差之间的秩依赖关联。上述报告的所有结果均在十个独立随机种子（1-10）上平均。【结论】GlycanPUG拓宽了可表示的聚糖集合，同时保留受支持的结构歧义。

title: A Two-Stage YOLO-Swin Transformer Pipeline for Cross-Dataset White Blood Cell Classification
zh_title: YOLO-Swin两阶段跨数据集白细胞分类
summary: 先用YOLO11检测并保留背景裁剪，再用Swin-B分九类白细胞，并用公开基准做外部评测。
key_points: 两阶段检测加分类流水线
五套公开数据集训练，保留形态的颜色增强
WBCBench2026未参与训练，用于外部评估
reason: 有跨数据集外部评测但为预印本、方法属常规改进，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: White blood cell (WBC) classification across datasets is challenged by differences in staining, image context, and class distributions. Methods: We developed a two-stage YOLO11-Swin Transformer pipeline. In the first stage, WBC detection and context-preserving cropping, a YOLO11 detector finds the leukocyte in each uncropped image and produces a cell-focused crop that retains the surrounding background. In the second stage, WBC classification, a Swin Transformer (Swin-B) assigns the crop to one of nine cell types. The classifier was trained on detector-cropped cells from five public datasets, so the first stage supplies the same kind of input at test time; morphology-preserving color augmentation addressed staining variation, and class-weighted cross-entropy addressed class imbalance. WBCBench2026, a public benchmark not used for training, served for external evaluation in seven harmonized classes, scored by macro-F1 (the mean of per-class F1). Further analyses removed the first stage or masked the background, compared classifier backbones, held out each training dataset (leave-one-dataset-out, LODO), and tested a second split (Phase-2) with about 60% synthetically degraded images. Results: The full pipeline reached an external macro-F1 of 0.879{+/-}0.006 on 8,080 benchmark images. With uncropped images as input, the same crop-trained classifier reached 0.627{+/-}0.039, and crops that kept the surrounding background outperformed background-masked crops (0.867 versus 0.760). With identical detector-cropped input, Swin-B outperformed convolutional baselines (0.863 versus 0.718-0.813), and its advantage over ResNet50 persisted across three training configurations. In LODO, macro-F1 on the held-out dataset ranged from 0.59 to 0.91, revealing source-specific variation not fully covered by the remaining datasets. On Phase-2, macro-F1 was 0.769{+/-}0.002. Two hematologists independently reviewed all 205 blast- or promyelocyte-related model-benchmark disagreements and gave the same verdict on 73 crops (35.6%): 21 model right, 43 model wrong, 9 ambiguous. Conclusions: The proposed two-stage pipeline achieved strong cross-dataset WBC classification performance. Context-preserving cropping was essential for the crop-trained classifier, and the LODO findings support representing the same classes across diverse sources when developing robust WBC classifiers.
zh_abstract: 【背景】跨数据集的白色血细胞（WBC）分类受到染色、图像背景和类别分布差异的挑战。【方法】我们开发了一个两阶段 YOLO11-Swin Transformer 流水线。在第一阶段，WBC 检测和保留背景的裁剪中，YOLO11 检测器在每张未裁剪图像中找到白细胞，并生成一个保留周围背景的以细胞为中心的裁剪图。在第二阶段，WBC 分类中，Swin Transformer（Swin-B）将裁剪图分配给九种细胞类型之一。分类器在来自五个公共数据集的检测器裁剪细胞上训练，因此第一阶段在测试时提供相同类型的输入；保持形态的颜色增强解决了染色变异，类别加权交叉熵解决了类别不平衡。WBCBench2026 是一个未用于训练的公共基准，用于七个协调类别的外部评估，以 macro-F1（各类别 F1 的平均值）评分。进一步分析移除了第一阶段或掩蔽背景，比较了分类器骨干网络，留出每个训练数据集（留一数据集法，LODO），并测试了第二个划分（Phase-2），其中约 60% 的图像为合成退化图像。【结果】完整流水线在 8,080 张基准图像上达到外部 macro-F1 为 0.879{+/-}0.006。以未裁剪图像作为输入，同一个经裁剪图训练的分类器达到 0.627{+/-}0.039，而保留周围背景的裁剪图优于背景掩蔽的裁剪图（0.867 对 0.760）。在相同的检测器裁剪输入下，Swin-B 优于卷积基线（0.863 对 0.718-0.813），并且其相对于 ResNet50 的优势在三种训练配置中持续存在。在 LODO 中，留出数据集上的 macro-F1 范围为 0.59 至 0.91，揭示了剩余数据集未完全覆盖的来源特异性变异。在 Phase-2 上，macro-F1 为 0.769{+/-}0.002。两名血液学家独立审查了所有 205 个与原始细胞或早幼粒细胞相关的模型-基准不一致，并对 73 个裁剪图（35.6%）给出相同判定：21 个模型正确，43 个模型错误，9 个模糊。【结论】所提出的两阶段流水线实现了强大的跨数据集 WBC 分类性能。保留背景的裁剪对于经裁剪图训练的分类器至关重要，LODO 发现支持在开发稳健的 WBC 分类器时在不同来源中表示相同的类别。

title: GeoSurge: Geometry-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning for Auditable Liver Resection Planning
zh_title: GeoSurge：可审计肝切除规划的几何多模态推理
summary: 预印本提出解剖学接地的框架，结合掩膜指标与点云结构 token，生成可执行、可编辑的肝切除面。
key_points: 用表面-动作文法把切除动作映射为参数化几何
解剖与肿瘤模板生成候选，硬约束与语义去重筛选
以候选与专家几何一致性作为训练监督
reason: 方法有新意的手术规划预印本，有基线对比但证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Surgical resection planning centers on generating executable resection surfaces from anatomical evidence and operative constraints. Medical multimodal foundation models enable anatomical understanding, and segmentation models predict resection regions, but neither translates these capabilities into explicitly constrained, executable resection surfaces. We present GeoSurge, an anatomy-grounded framework that combines mask-derived metrics with structure-aware point-cloud tokens to generate executable, editable resection surfaces. To make resection geometry learnable and editable, GeoSurge maps actions to parametric geometry through a surface-action grammar. Using this grammar, anatomy-oriented and tumor-centered templates generate candidates, which are filtered by hard constraints and semantic deduplication. Training supervision is then derived from candidate-expert geometric agreement and independently recomputed feasibility metrics. At inference, the reasoner uses patient evidence and surgical requirements to select or revise an action, which an independent geometry engine subsequently materializes and verifies. GeoSurge achieves the best overall scores on DeepTumour Liver and CRLM-QA, improving the constraint satisfaction rate from 73% to 100% on CRLM and from 56% to 99% on GeoSurge-Bench.
zh_abstract: 手术切除规划的核心是基于解剖证据和手术约束生成可执行的切除表面。医学多模态基础模型可实现解剖理解，分割模型可预测切除区域，但二者均未将这些能力转化为具有明确约束、可执行的切除表面。我们提出GeoSurge，一种以解剖为基础的框架，它将掩膜导出的度量与结构感知点云标记相结合，以生成可执行、可编辑的切除表面。为使切除几何可学习且可编辑，GeoSurge通过表面-动作语法将动作映射到参数化几何。使用该语法，面向解剖的模板和以肿瘤为中心的模板生成候选，再通过硬约束和语义去重进行过滤。训练监督则来自候选-专家几何一致性和独立重新计算的可行性指标。在推理时，推理器使用患者证据和手术需求来选择或修改动作，随后由独立的几何引擎将该动作具体化并验证。GeoSurge在DeepTumour Liver和CRLM-QA上取得最佳总体得分，将CRLM上的约束满足率从73%提高到100%，在GeoSurge-Bench上从56%提高到99%。

title: DiCT: Teaching X-ray Vision-Language Models to Reason via Imagining CT
zh_title: DiCT：让 X 线视觉语言模型通过想象 CT 进行推理
summary: 预印本提出三阶段 CT 到 X 线推理迁移框架，用 CT 视觉语言模型引导学生模型从 2D X 线获得三维推理能力。
key_points: 三阶段渐进式 CT 到 X 线推理迁移
区分 X 线观察与 CT 想象的接口设计
推理时无需显式 CT 重建
reason: 思路新颖的影像预印本方法，证据限于预印本阶段，属值得一看档
abstract: Diagnosing with X-rays often requires reasoning about the 3D locations of abnormalities and their spatial relationships to surrounding anatomical structures, yet such reasoning remains challenging due to the loss of spatial information in 2D projections. To address this challenge, we propose Dreaming in CT (DiCT), a three-stage progressive CT-to-X-ray reasoning transfer framework that leverages a CT vision-language model (VLM) to guide an X-ray VLM. Through this CT-guided transfer, the student acquires CT-informed 3D reasoning capabilities, enabling it to reason directly from 2D X-rays without explicit CT reconstruction at inference time. The framework begins with instruct the dreamer, which equips the X-ray student with initial CT-oriented reasoning capabilities and establishes a structured interface that distinguishes X-ray observations from CT imagination. Building on this structure, visualize the dream introduces CT-guided on-policy distillation (OPD), where the CT teacher selectively guides the X-ray student's reasoning trajectories to transfer 3D anatomical knowledge. Finally, manifest the dream adapts the acquired reasoning capabilities from digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) to real clinical X-rays. Experiments across two VLM backbones on 3D-RAD and ReXVQA demonstrate DiCT's effectiveness across radiological reasoning tasks, achieving a 1.66 percentage point improvement over a CT reconstruction-based baseline on 3D-RAD Abnormality Identification with 12.77$\times$ lower inference computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/HongYep/DiCT.
zh_abstract: 使用X射线进行诊断通常需要推理异常的三维位置及其与周围解剖结构的空间关系，然而由于二维投影中空间信息的丢失，这种推理仍然具有挑战性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出Dreaming in CT（DiCT），一种三阶段渐进式CT到X射线推理迁移框架，利用CT视觉-语言模型（VLM）指导X射线VLM。通过这种CT引导的迁移，学生模型获得具有CT信息的3D推理能力，使其无需在推理时进行显式CT重建即可直接根据2D X射线进行推理。该框架从“instruct the dreamer”（指导梦想者）开始，为X射线学生模型配备初始的面向CT的推理能力，并建立一个结构化接口，用于区分X射线观察与CT想象。在此结构基础上，“visualize the dream”（可视化梦想）引入CT引导的在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation, OPD），其中CT教师选择性地指导X射线学生模型的推理轨迹，以迁移3D解剖知识。最后，“manifest the dream”（显现梦想）将获得的推理能力从数字重建放射照片（DRRs）适配到真实临床X射线。在3D-RAD和ReXVQA上跨两个VLM骨干网络的实验证明了DiCT在放射学推理任务中的有效性，在3D-RAD异常识别上相比基于CT重建的基线提高1.66个百分点，同时推理计算量降低12.77×。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/HongYep/DiCT 获取。

title: SwarmLeak: Does Coordination Improve Privacy Attacks on LLM Agents?
zh_title: SwarmLeak：多智能体协同能否提升对LLM智能体的隐私攻击
summary: 预印本构建24个群聊场景红队数据集（含医疗场景），比较单个与四个协同攻击者对受害智能体的敏感信息套取效果。
key_points: 24个合成群聊场景，覆盖医疗、法律、金融、软件工程
GLM 5.2攻击五个受害模型、七种对话策略，预算20万token
协同群体未显示优势，单个攻击者在每个受害模型上持平或更好
reason: 合成场景红队预印本，有对照但非真实临床数据，属值得一看档
abstract: LLM agents increasingly collaborate in group chats while holding tool access to confidential records, which makes the shared chat an attack surface. It remains unclear whether several colluding attackers extract such information more effectively than one. We introduce SwarmLeak, a red-teaming dataset of 24 synthetic group-chat scenarios across healthcare, law, finance, and software engineering, where attackers pose as colleagues to make a victim agent post protected fields despite an explicit confidentiality policy. With GLM 5.2 attacking five victim models through seven conversational strategies, we compare one attacker with a swarm of four sharing a private channel, matching scenarios, strategies, and a 200,000-token budget that also covers swarm coordination. Swarms show no advantage: a single attacker matches or exceeds them on every victim, and the share of runs leaking any field differs between conditions by at most 14.3 percentage points, whereas changing the victim shifts it from 0% to 99.4%. On the two most vulnerable models, nearly every run leaks under both conditions, but single attackers expose more of the record at first disclosure (85.4% vs. 68.1% of protected fields on Nemotron 3.5 Lightning). Four of the five victims leaked despite the policy. GLM 5.2 retrieved protected data in 64.3% of individual-attack runs and leaked in 0.6%: retrieval does not imply disclosure, but in high-stakes settings even one leaked field can identify a patient or client. At equal budgets, a larger red team is not automatically a stronger one; the victim model matters far more.
zh_abstract: LLM智能体越来越多地在群聊中协作，同时拥有对机密记录的工具访问权限，这使得共享聊天成为攻击面。目前尚不清楚多个合谋攻击者是否比单个攻击者更有效地提取此类信息。我们推出SwarmLeak，这是一个红队测试数据集，包含医疗、法律、金融和软件工程领域的24个合成群聊场景；在这些场景中，攻击者伪装成同事，使受害智能体在存在明确保密政策的情况下仍发布受保护字段。使用GLM 5.2通过七种对话策略攻击五个受害模型，我们比较单个攻击者与四个共享私有信道的攻击者组成的群体，二者匹配场景、策略以及同样覆盖群体协调的200,000 token预算。群体并未显示优势：单个攻击者在每个受害模型上均达到或超过群体；任一场运行泄露任一字段的比例在两种条件之间最多相差14.3个百分点，而更换受害模型则使其从0%变为99.4%。在两个最脆弱的模型上，两种条件下几乎每次运行都会泄露，但单个攻击者在首次披露时暴露更多记录（在Nemotron 3.5 Lightning上，受保护字段分别为85.4%与68.1%）。五个受害模型中有四个尽管存在该政策仍发生了泄露。GLM 5.2在64.3%的单个攻击运行中检索到受保护数据，并在0.6%中发生泄露：检索并不意味着披露，但在高风险场景中，即使一个泄露字段也可能识别患者或客户。在相同预算下，更大的红队并不自动更强；受害模型的影响要大得多。

title: CLAIMGATE: Cautious On-Device Checking of Spoken Legal and Clinical Claims
zh_title: CLAIMGATE：端侧核查口语法律与临床陈述
summary: 预印本提出端侧助手，用4位量化7B模型检索官方规则并给出支持、反驳或未覆盖判定及引用，倾向沉默而非误导。
key_points: 仅允许引用检索到的规则，判定由代码逻辑导出
评测覆盖交通执法与门诊，使用真实法条与CDC/FDA/MedlinePlus文本
使用真实转录与实时语音，配有作者标注金标准
reason: 预印本，方法有巧思并含实时语音评测，但无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: In law and medicine, a misstated rule can shape a decision before anyone has time to check it. Checking such claims in real time helps only if the checker keeps pace with conversation, keeps sensitive audio on the device, and stays silent rather than mislead. We present CLAIMGATE, an on- device assistant that listens to a conversation, detects checkable claims, retrieves the relevant official rule, and labels each claim as supported, contradicted or not covered, with a citation. CLAIMGATE is designed to fail towards silence: its 4-bit 7B- parameter language model may cite only retrieved rules, and the verdict is derived in code from the claim and rule the model quotes. We evaluate it on traffic stops and medical visits using real official rule text (5,742 Florida and Texas statute subsections; CDC, FDA and MedlinePlus guidance), real transcripts, live speech and author-written gold-labelled claims. On 141 held-out traffic-stop claims, CLAIMGATE reaches 80.1% accuracy and cuts serious errors (a true claim called false, or the reverse) from 20 to 5 compared with the same model without retrieval; deriving the verdict in code alone reduces them from 13 to 5 at no cost to accuracy. The claim gate passes 95.7% of held-out claims and rejects all 30 everyday sentences, and feedback arrives a median 1.86 s after a speech window closes on an 8 GB consumer GPU. On 148 allergy claims, with only the claim gate to rebuild, CLAIMGATE reaches 87.8% accuracy with 5 serious errors, against 20 without retrieval.
zh_abstract: 在法律和医学中，一个被错误陈述的规则可能在任何人来得及核查之前就影响决策。实时核查此类主张只有在核查器跟得上对话、将敏感音频保留在设备上，并保持沉默而不是误导时才有帮助。我们提出CLAIMGATE，一种设备端助手，它聆听对话、检测可核查的主张、检索相关官方规则，并将每条主张标记为有支持、被反驳或未覆盖，并附引用。CLAIMGATE的设计是以沉默方式失败：其4-bit 7B参数语言模型只能引用检索到的规则，裁决由代码根据模型引用的主张和规则推导。我们在交通拦截和医疗就诊场景中，使用真实官方规则文本（5,742条佛罗里达州和得克萨斯州法规小节；CDC、FDA和MedlinePlus指南）、真实转录文本、实时语音以及作者编写的金标准标注主张对其进行评估。在141条留出的交通拦截主张上，CLAIMGATE达到80.1%的准确率，与同一模型不进行检索相比，将严重错误（将真实主张判为虚假，或反之）从20降至5；仅通过在代码中推导裁决即可将其从13降至5，且不损失准确率。主张门控通过95.7%的留出主张，并拒绝全部30条日常句子；在8 GB消费级GPU上，反馈在语音窗口关闭后中位1.86秒到达。在148条过敏相关主张上，仅重建主张门控，CLAIMGATE达到87.8%的准确率，有5个严重错误，而不进行检索时为20个。

title: Refining and Aligning Clinical Reasoning with Health Guidelines via Formal Constraints
zh_title: 用形式化约束对齐临床推理与健康指南
summary: 提出VerClin可解释框架，将指南条件与排除规则转为可执行知识，并用多专科智能体筛选适用建议。
key_points: 抽取指南条件、排除、推荐与优先级为可执行知识
确定性四值推理器保留不确定性并执行排除
多专科智能体筛查案例适用性并合成建议
reason: 预印本新方法有框架创新，但未见定量对比与外部验证
abstract: Clinical reasoning from incomplete or conflicting patient evidence must account for low-probability but high-risk concerns while remaining grounded in health guidelines. We introduce VerClin, an explainable framework that extracts guideline conditions, exclusions, recommendations, and priorities into executable knowledge and represents patient conversations as scoped cases. A deterministic four-valued reasoner produces traceable guideline matches while preserving uncertainty and enforcing exclusions. Multiple specialty agents then screen matched guidelines for case applicability, and a consultation model synthesizes accepted guidance through specialty recommendations and a sentence-preserving formal-constraint channel. We present accepted guidance in ascending order of the sum of its priority and trigger-strength ranks, which can surface high-risk guidance with weaker triggers. VerClin outperforms direct generation and Top-5 RAG on HealthBench Hard and HealthBench Professional. On the LLMEval-Med subset, it outperforms direct generation and ties Top-5 RAG. Component analyses further examine semantic closure, example-guided refinement, specialty screening, and constraint-conditioned delivery.
zh_abstract: 从不完整或冲突的患者证据中进行临床推理，必须考虑低概率但高风险的关切，同时仍以健康指南为依据。我们提出 VerClin，一个可解释框架，它将指南中的条件、排除项、推荐和优先级抽取为可执行知识，并将患者对话表示为带作用域的病例。一个确定性四值推理器产生可追溯的指南匹配，同时保留不确定性并强制执行排除项。多个专科智能体随后筛查匹配指南对病例的适用性，而一个会诊模型通过专科推荐和保句形式约束通道合成被接受的指导。我们按优先级排名与触发强度排名之和的升序呈现被接受的指导，这可使触发因素较弱的高风险指导浮现出来。VerClin 在 HealthBench Hard 和 HealthBench Professional 上优于直接生成和 Top-5 RAG。在 LLMEval-Med 子集上，它优于直接生成并与 Top-5 RAG 持平。组件分析进一步考察语义闭合、示例引导细化、专科筛查和约束条件化交付。

title: ReCAP: Sequential Concept Acquisition with Guarantees under Imperfect Concept Predictors
zh_title: 容忍概念预测误差的序贯概念采集
summary: 提出ReCAP方法，在概念预测存在错误与弃权时仍保证可解释诊断的采集质量。
key_points: 推理时纳入概念预测的错误与弃权信息
证明目标具自适应单调与子模性，贪心有近似保证
结合诊断保持剪枝使解释更短更可靠
reason: 有理论保证的新方法预印本，但缺乏真实临床数据验证
abstract: Sequential concept acquisition enables interpretable diagnosis from a compact set of human-understandable findings. Such explanations are useful only if clinicians can trust them, yet most existing methods treat predicted concepts as correct, so a correct diagnosis can rest on incorrectly predicted evidence. We propose Reliable Concept Acquisition with Pruning (ReCAP), which reasons over what the concept predictor reports, including errors and abstentions, and replaces conditional information gain with a label-discriminating objective that separates cases requiring different diagnoses. We prove this objective adaptively monotone and adaptively submodular, yielding a (1-1/e) guarantee for greedy fixed-budget acquisition that degrades boundedly under learned estimates, and combine it with abstention-aware acquisition and diagnosis-preserving pruning to keep explanations short and reliable. Across five medical imaging datasets, ReCAP reduces the share of correct diagnoses supported by at least one incorrectly predicted concept from 27.1% to 9.6% relative to the strongest baseline, while using fewer than half as many concepts and achieving higher diagnostic accuracy.
zh_abstract: 序贯概念获取使得能够基于一小组紧凑的、人类可理解的发现进行可解释诊断。此类解释只有在临床医生能够信任它们时才有用，然而大多数现有方法将预测概念视为正确，因此正确诊断可能建立在错误预测的证据上。我们提出带剪枝的可靠概念获取（Reliable Concept Acquisition with Pruning，ReCAP），它对概念预测器所报告的内容（包括错误和弃权）进行推理，并用一个标签判别目标替代条件信息增益，该目标将需要不同诊断的病例区分开。我们证明该目标具有自适应单调性和自适应子模性，从而为贪心固定预算获取提供 (1-1/e) 保证，并在学习估计下该保证有界退化；并将其与弃权感知获取和诊断保持剪枝相结合，以保持解释简短且可靠。在五个医学影像数据集上，相对于最强基线，ReCAP 将至少由一个错误预测概念支持的正确诊断占比从 27.1% 降至 9.6%，同时使用的概念数量不到其一半，并实现了更高的诊断准确率。

title: Right Destination, Wrong Journey: Synthetic Counseling Dialogues Miss Human Interactional Dynamics
zh_title: 合成心理咨询对话缺失人际互动动态
summary: 对十个人类与合成心理咨询数据集做轨迹评估，发现合成对话结局合理但互动响应保真度偏低。
key_points: 以过程保真度而非仅回复质量评估合成对话
合成数据恢复轨迹与逐轮响应性偏离人类
针对性生成干预可缩小部分轨迹层面差距
reason: 多数据集评估有新意，但为预印本且缺下游临床效果验证
abstract: LLM-generated counseling dialogues are increasingly used for training and evaluating mental-health systems, yet existing evaluations focus largely on response quality and final outcomes rather than how support unfolds over time. We conduct a trajectory-centered evaluation of process fidelity across ten human, reconstructed, and synthetic counseling datasets. Our results show that synthetic dialogues often reach plausible endpoints but differ from human support in recovery dynamics and turn-by-turn responsiveness. While generation design can shift global properties such as recovery timing and trajectory structure, contingent patient--counselor responsiveness remains consistently lower in fidelity across models and generation paradigms. Our experiments on controlled synthetic datasets show that targeted generation interventions can narrow the gap with real data on several trajectory-level measures, but do not fully recover interactional fidelity, with turn-level responsiveness remaining limited. We release three controlled synthetic datasets comprising 2,050 dialogues, together with annotations and the evaluation framework.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）生成的咨询对话越来越多地用于训练和评估心理健康系统，但现有评估主要关注回复质量和最终结果，而非支持如何随时间展开。我们开展了一项以轨迹为中心的过程保真度评估，涵盖十个真实、重建和合成咨询数据集。我们的结果表明，合成对话通常能达到看似合理的终点，但在恢复动态和逐轮响应性方面与人类支持不同。虽然生成设计可以改变恢复时机和轨迹结构等全局属性，但条件性患者—咨询师响应性在跨模型和生成范式中保真度始终较低。我们在受控合成数据集上的实验表明，有针对性的生成干预可以在若干轨迹层面指标上缩小与真实数据的差距，但不能完全恢复互动保真度，轮级响应性仍然有限。我们发布三个受控合成数据集，包含2,050段对话，以及标注和评估框架。

title: PatientFlowSynth: Evaluating FHIR Agents with Matched Patient Charts
zh_title: PatientFlowSynth：FHIR 智能体配对病历评测
summary: 构建含 18,000 项任务、225 名合成患者的 FHIR 图表评测集，用四种证据状态变体检验智能体检索与标注是否正确。
key_points: 225 名合成患者、18 个模板生成 1.8 万项任务
四种证据状态变体，重执行程序核验参考答案
严格成功需标签与引文精确匹配证据集
reason: 新评测基准但基于合成患者、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Agents that search patient charts must classify claims from retrieved records, including cases with missing or conflicting evidence. In Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR), status fields can change how those records should be interpreted. PatientFlowSynth provides 18,000 tasks from 225 synthetic patients and 18 templates that hold the patient, question, and retrieval program fixed across chart variants representing four evidence states. Re-executing the program verifies each variant's reference answer, evidence sets, and search requirements. Strict success requires a completed response with correct labels and citations exactly matching an accepted evidence set retrieved during the episode. Where required, a tool response must also show a complete search at the specified scope. In a study using GPT-5.6 Luna and 225 synthetic patients (3,600 matched pairs), explicit Encounter-status guidance increased strict success from 40.7% to 51.3% (+10.6 percentage points; 95% patient-bootstrap confidence interval, 8.4 to 12.8). Among cases whose primary reference label was insufficient evidence, label agreement fell from 49.2% to 29.3%. A prespecified two-model replication reproduced both changes. Failed retrieval can mask interpretation errors by producing a correct insufficient-evidence label without examining the relevant records. Additional model comparisons showed that the benefit of guidance was model-dependent. Retrieval, citation, and classification should be evaluated separately.
zh_abstract: 搜索患者病历的智能体必须对检索记录中的断言进行分类，包括证据缺失或相互冲突的病例。在快速医疗互操作性资源（FHIR）中，状态字段可以改变这些记录应如何被解释。PatientFlowSynth提供了来自225名合成患者和18个模板的18,000项任务，这些模板在代表四种证据状态的病历变体中保持患者、问题和检索程序固定。重新执行该程序可验证每个变体的参考回答、证据集和检索要求。严格成功要求完成的回答具有正确标签和引用，且引用与回合中检索到的可接受证据集完全匹配。在需要时，工具响应还必须显示在指定范围内的完整检索。在一项使用GPT-5.6 Luna和225名合成患者（3,600个匹配对）的研究中，明确的Encounter状态指导将严格成功率从40.7%提高到51.3%（+10.6个百分点；95%患者自助法置信区间，8.4至12.8）。在主要参考标签为证据不足的病例中，标签一致率从49.2%降至29.3%。一项预先设定的双模型重复实验再现了这两项变化。检索失败可通过在未检查相关记录的情况下产生正确的证据不足标签，从而掩盖解释错误。额外的模型比较显示，指导的益处取决于模型。检索、引用和分类应分别评估。

title: Demographic Encoding is Not Exposure: Fairness and Privacy in Chest X-ray Foundation Models
zh_title: 胸片基础模型：人口学编码不等于成员泄漏
summary: 在 BiomedCLIP、DINOv2、RAD-DINO 上同时测量人口学编码、诊断公平差距与成员推断脆弱性，发现三者并不一致。
key_points: 200 个线性/MLP 头，在 CheXpert 与 NIH 胸片集审计
72 项 CheXpert 关联统计上等价于零
泄漏主要取决于头容量与训练时长
reason: 多模型多数据集审计、方法规范，但为预印本回顾性分析
abstract: Medical foundation models encode patient demographics and can reveal whether a patient was in the training set, and these properties are often treated as one problem. We tested whether they are aligned by measuring demographic encoding, diagnostic fairness gaps and membership-inference vulnerability on the same models. We trained 200 linear or multilayer-perceptron (MLP) heads on frozen BiomedCLIP, DINOv2 and RAD-DINO embeddings, with three seeds, and audited them on CheXpert and NIH ChestX-ray14. Demographic encoding explained almost no variance in patient vulnerability, and all 72 CheXpert associations were statistically equivalent to zero. Erasing linearly decodable demographics left leakage unchanged but reduced age-related underdiagnosis gaps. Leakage depended instead on head capacity and training length. On RAD-DINO, a linear head reached a membership-inference area under the curve (AUC) of 0.694, compared with 0.907 for a 30-epoch MLP, at similar test performance. Fairness and privacy should therefore be audited separately, and linear heads or shorter training reduce leakage with little or no loss of utility. The code is available on GitHub for public use.
zh_abstract: 医学基础模型编码患者人口学特征，并能揭示患者是否在训练集中，而这些属性常被视为同一个问题。我们通过在同一批模型上测量人口学编码、诊断公平性差距和成员推断脆弱性，检验它们是否一致。我们在冻结的 BiomedCLIP、DINOv2 和 RAD-DINO 嵌入上训练了 200 个线性或多层感知机（MLP）头，使用三个随机种子，并在 CheXpert 和 NIH ChestX-ray14 上审计它们。人口学编码几乎不能解释患者脆弱性的方差，所有 72 项 CheXpert 关联在统计上等同于零。擦除线性可解码的人口学特征后，泄漏保持不变，但年龄相关诊断不足差距减小。泄漏反而取决于头容量和训练时长。在 RAD-DINO 上，线性头达到成员推断曲线下面积（AUC）0.694，而 30 个 epoch 的 MLP 为 0.907，测试性能相似。因此，公平性和隐私应分别审计，线性头或更短训练可在效用损失很小或没有损失的情况下减少泄漏。代码已在 GitHub 上公开供使用。

title: Evaluable Language-Model Treatment Policies for Sepsis Resuscitation via Offline Value-Guided Selection
zh_title: 离线价值引导的脓毒症复苏语言模型策略
summary: 提出 R-LLMC：行为监督 LLM 给出 25 种升压药-补液动作候选，再由离线 critic 按估计长期价值挑选。
key_points: 在 25 种动作上解码为精确分布
策略具闭式 off-policy 评估形式
解释在选择后生成，不反向引导治疗
reason: 有新意的离线策略方法，但仅回顾性数据、无前瞻验证
abstract: Offline treatment learning must balance imitation, which stays close to logged evidence but ignores outcomes, against value maximisation, which uses outcomes but drifts toward treatments the records cannot verify. Numerical reinforcement learning strikes this balance during training. For large language models (LLMs), directly using sparse retrospective outcomes for fine-tuning raises challenges of delayed credit assignment and limited evidence for alternative treatments. We present R-LLMC, which strikes the balance at inference for sepsis resuscitation. A behaviour-supervised LLM, decoded into an exact distribution over 25 vasopressor-fluid actions, proposes clinician-anchored candidates; an offline critic selects among them by estimated long-term value. The policy has a closed form for off-policy evaluation, and its rationale is written after selection, so explanation cannot steer treatment. In experiments on held-out MIMIC-III patients, R-LLMC exceeded the clinician reference in doubly robust value by +0.214 (95\% CI 0.091-0.300), with fitted Q evaluation agreeing.
zh_abstract: 离线治疗学习必须在模仿与价值最大化之间取得平衡：模仿贴近记录证据但忽略结局，价值最大化利用结局但会漂向记录无法验证的治疗。数值强化学习在训练期间实现这一平衡。对于大语言模型（LLM），直接使用稀疏的回顾性结局进行微调会带来延迟信用分配和替代治疗证据有限等挑战。我们提出 R-LLMC，在脓毒症复苏的推断阶段实现这一平衡。一个行为监督的 LLM 被解码为关于 25 种血管升压药-液体动作的精确分布，提出以临床医生为锚点的候选方案；离线评论器根据估计的长期价值从中选择。该策略具有用于离策略评估的闭式形式，其理由在选择之后生成，因此解释不能引导治疗。在留出的 MIMIC-III 患者实验中，R-LLMC 的双稳健价值超过临床医生参考 +0.214（95% CI 0.091-0.300），拟合 Q 评估结果一致。

title: A Description-Derived Drug-Drug Interaction Benchmark Reveals Split-Dependent Molecular Representation Rankings
zh_title: 描述衍生的药物相互作用基准与表示比较
summary: 从 DrugBank 描述文本映射六类标签构建 DDI 基准，设四种划分制度比较指纹、序列与图表示。
key_points: 将策划描述映射为六类文本衍生类别
四种 holdout，从随机到骨架不重叠
分子指纹在高重叠划分中领先
reason: 新基准与多表示对比，但结论限于预印本实验，属值得一看档
abstract: Drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction is clinically important and poses a distinct challenge for molecular representation learning. Unlike single-molecule property prediction, DDI requires a predictor to compose two molecular representations into a relational outcome. DrugBank provides curator-authored DDI descriptions rather than ready-made categorical labels, so a categorical prediction target must first be derived from the text. We construct a dataset of DDI pairs by mapping processed descriptions to six text-derived categories and define a benchmark with four holdout regimes that restrict train-test chemical overlap from random pairs to scaffold-disjoint evaluation. We then use this benchmark to compare molecular fingerprints, pretrained sequence representations, and graph-derived features across five seeds and multiple classifier heads. Molecular fingerprints lead the high- overlap random split, whereas graph-derived representations lead the drug- and scaffold-holdout regimes, with the gap increasing as molecular overlap is restricted. Changing the classifier head affects absolute performance but not the relative representation ranking. These results show that representation rankings change with test-set novelty under a fixed description-derived label space.
zh_abstract: 药物-药物相互作用（DDI）预测在临床上很重要，并对分子表征学习提出了独特挑战。与单分子性质预测不同，DDI 要求预测器将两个分子表征组合成一个关系性结局。DrugBank 提供由策展人撰写的 DDI 描述，而非现成的分类标签，因此必须首先从文本中推导出分类预测目标。我们通过将处理后的描述映射到六个文本衍生类别来构建 DDI 对数据集，并定义一个包含四种留出机制的基准，将训练-测试化学重叠从随机对限制到骨架不相交评估。然后，我们使用该基准在五个随机种子和多个分类器头下比较分子指纹、预训练序列表征和由图衍生的特征。分子指纹在高重叠随机划分中领先，而图衍生表征在药物留出和骨架留出设置中领先，且随着分子重叠受到限制，差距增大。改变分类器头会影响绝对性能，但不影响表征的相对排名。这些结果表明，在固定的描述衍生标签空间下，表征排名会随测试集新颖性而变化。

title: Interpretable Orthogonal Latent Diffusion with Scale-Selective Uncertainty for Medical Image Super-Resolution
zh_title: 可解释正交潜扩散与尺度选择不确定性
summary: 提出Med-PODiff，用POD扩散框架做脑MRI超分辨率，并给出像素级幻觉风险评分。
key_points: 提出基于POD的脑MRI超分辨率扩散框架
不确定性分解为总体、粗结构和细粒度
定义像素级幻觉风险评分H_p
reason: 预印本方法有新意，含不确定性但证据有限，值得一看
abstract: Diffusion models are increasingly used for medical image reconstruction and super-resolution, but their samples may contain plausible fine-scale hallucinations that are difficult to identify from the reconstructed image alone. We propose Med-PODiff, a patch-wise proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) diffusion framework for brain MRI super-resolution that performs generative reconstruction in compact and interpretable local coefficient spaces. Unlike pixel-space or learned-latent diffusion models, Med-PODiff uses the POD structure to separate low-rank anatomical variation from fine-detail residual variation, enabling predictive uncertainty to be decomposed into total, coarse, and fine components. Building on this decomposition, we define a pixel-wise hallucination-risk score, $H_p$, that emphasizes regions where fine-detail uncertainty dominates coarse structural uncertainty. On brain MRI, Med-PODiff outperforms representative diffusion baselines in reconstruction quality while producing well-calibrated predictive intervals, with total uncertainty detecting high-error regions at AUROC 0.954. More importantly, the decomposed uncertainty is scale-selective: coarse and fine uncertainty preferentially predict errors at the corresponding scales, with $H_p$ localizing fine error at AUROC $0.906$. Controlled injections and retrospective Cartesian $k$-space undersampling further support fine-detail localization and degradation robustness. The discarded POD tail is only $3.8\%$ of the retained fine-error magnitude, and Med-PODiff improves downstream segmentation consistency while requiring substantially less inference time than pixel-space diffusion.
zh_abstract: 扩散模型越来越多地用于医学图像重建和超分辨率，但其样本可能包含看似合理的细尺度幻觉，仅从重建图像中难以识别。我们提出Med-PODiff，一种用于脑MRI超分辨率的逐块本征正交分解（POD）扩散框架，其在紧凑且可解释的局部系数空间中执行生成式重建。与像素空间或学习潜空间扩散模型不同，Med-PODiff利用POD结构将低秩解剖变异与细细节残差变异分离，使预测不确定性能够分解为总、粗和细分量。在此分解基础上，我们定义逐像素幻觉风险评分 $H_p$，其强调细细节不确定性主导粗结构不确定性的区域。在脑MRI上，Med-PODiff在重建质量上优于代表性扩散基线，同时产生良好校准的预测区间，总不确定性以AUROC 0.954检测高误差区域。更重要的是，分解后的不确定性具有尺度选择性：粗和细不确定性优先预测相应尺度上的误差，$H_p$以AUROC $0.906$定位细误差。受控注入和回顾性笛卡尔 $k$ 空间欠采样进一步支持细细节定位和退化鲁棒性。被丢弃的POD尾部仅占保留的细误差幅度的 3.8%，并且Med-PODiff改善了下游分割一致性，同时所需推理时间显著少于像素空间扩散。

title: SurgGenesis: A Generative Surgical World Model for Future-Aware Surgical Understanding
zh_title: SurgGenesis：生成式手术世界模型
summary: 提出SurgGenesis生成式手术世界模型，从视觉与文本学习未来手术状态转移。
key_points: 学习未来手术状态转移的生成式世界模型
三阶段渐进LoRA适配视频扩散模型
从未来预测与生成质量两轴验证
reason: 生成式手术世界模型预印本，方法新但证据有限
abstract: Surgical scene understanding is constrained by data scarcity and long-tail class imbalance, as annotating surgical videos demands scarce clinical expertise while rare procedural events remain underrepresented. We tackle this through data generation and propose SurgGenesis, a generative surgical world model that learns future surgical state transitions in a latent space from visual observations and textual procedural descriptions, serving as a scalable surgical data engine. To adapt a large-scale video diffusion model to the data-scarce surgical domain without catastrophic forgetting, we introduce a three-stage progressive LoRA strategy that incrementally injects endoscopic visual priors, procedural semantics, and spatial motion cues. Rather than judging generation by visual fidelity alone, we validate SurgGenesis along two axes that separate a world model from a generic generator: (i) future-awareness, by comparing predicted futures against the real future through a GT-latent prediction gap and temporal-horizon analysis, and (ii) action-faithful usefulness, by checking that generated clips contain the commanded surgical triplet and that using them to rebalance long-tail events and drive downstream understanding (segmentation, triplet recognition, 3D reconstruction) yields action-specific gains. Conditioned futures therefore complement conventional long-tail sampling. Code: https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis
zh_abstract: 手术场景理解受数据稀缺和长尾类别不平衡制约，因为标注手术视频需要稀缺的临床专业知识，而罕见操作事件仍代表性不足。我们通过数据生成应对这一问题，并提出 SurgGenesis，一种生成式手术世界模型，它从视觉观察和文本操作描述中在潜在空间学习未来手术状态转移，作为可扩展的手术数据引擎。为使大规模视频扩散模型适应数据稀缺的手术领域而不发生灾难性遗忘，我们引入三阶段渐进式 LoRA 策略，逐步注入内窥镜视觉先验、操作语义和空间运动线索。我们并非仅凭视觉保真度判断生成，而是沿两个轴验证 SurgGenesis，以区分世界模型与通用生成器：(i) 未来感知，通过真实标签潜在预测差距（GT-latent prediction gap）和时间跨度分析，将预测未来与真实未来进行比较；(ii) 动作忠实的有用性，通过检查生成片段是否包含所命令的手术三元组，以及使用它们重新平衡长尾事件并驱动下游理解（分割、三元组识别、3D 重建）是否能产生动作特定增益。因此，条件化未来补充了传统长尾采样。代码：https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis

title: HuluOPD: Unifying Heterogeneous Medical Specialists into One Lightweight Model with Unlabeled Prompts
zh_title: HuluOPD：异构专科模型蒸馏为轻量VLM
summary: 提出HuluOPD，仅用无标注提示将五个异构专科视觉语言模型蒸馏为一个轻量模型。
key_points: 用无标注提示蒸馏异构专科VLM
覆盖超声、病理、OCT、眼底、牙科
跨tokenizer损失统一不同架构模型
reason: 跨五专科蒸馏方法预印本，证据有限，值得一看
abstract: Specialist medical vision-language models (VLMs) are strong within their specialties but hard to unify: their training data are often private, and independently developed specialists cannot be assumed to share an architecture. Deploying these large models separately is costly. We present HuluOPD, an on-policy distillation recipe that unifies heterogeneous specialists into one lightweight VLM using only unlabeled prompts, without requiring reference answers or the specialists' training data. The lightweight model answers each prompt, and the specialist of the prompt's modality supervises its response; a continuation-aligned cross-tokenizer loss makes this possible even when they differ in architecture and tokenizer. We apply HuluOPD to five specialists, for ultrasound, pathology, optical coherence tomography, fundus photography, and dental imaging. To distill and evaluate them, we build HuluOPDCorpus, 914k unlabeled prompts, and HuluOPDBench, 47k held-out test items, from over 90 public datasets, and score all models under one protocol on 132k test items, including third-party benchmarks. A single model with 10% of the five specialists' combined parameters retains 94% of their question-answering performance, and one with 2% retains 89%. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of unifying heterogeneous medical specialist VLMs without requiring their training data or a shared architecture.
zh_abstract: 专科医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）在其专科内表现强大，但难以统一：它们的训练数据通常为私有，且不能假定独立开发的专科模型共享同一架构。分别部署这些大型模型成本高昂。我们提出 HuluOPD，一种同策略蒸馏方案，仅使用无标签提示将异构专科模型统一为一个轻量级 VLM，无需参考答案或专科模型的训练数据。轻量级模型回答每个提示，而该提示模态对应的专科模型监督其回答；一种续写对齐的跨分词器损失使其在架构和分词器不同时也能实现。我们将 HuluOPD 应用于五个专科模型，分别用于超声、病理、光学相干断层扫描、眼底摄影和牙科成像。为蒸馏和评估它们，我们从 90 多个公开数据集构建了 HuluOPDCorpus（914k 条无标签提示）和 HuluOPDBench（47k 个留出测试项），并在 132k 个测试项上按统一协议对所有模型评分，包括第三方基准。一个参数规模为五个专科模型合并参数 10% 的单一模型保留了其问答性能的 94%，而参数规模为 2% 的模型保留了 89%。据我们所知，这是首次在不需要专科模型训练数据或共享架构的情况下统一异构医学专科 VLM 的演示。

title: CrownFusion: 3D Dental Crown Generation Using Geometry Images and Latent Diffusion
zh_title: CrownFusion：几何图像与潜在扩散生成3D牙冠
summary: 预印本提出基于几何图像表示的潜在扩散模型，根据患者牙列条件生成解剖合理的3D牙冠设计。
key_points: 用CrownImage二维网格编码替代点云，以更高空间分辨率保留几何细节
以周边牙列联合学习嵌入为条件，生成具个体形态变异的牙冠
提出基于对颌牙邻近度的咬合适合度指标，纳入定量与定性评估
评估细节在摘要中被截断，未说明外部验证情况
reason: 方法有新意的牙科生成预印本，有定量对比但证据范围有限，属值得一看档
abstract: We introduce CrownFusion, a latent diffusion model to generate 3D dental crown designs from geometry images, a 2D-grid encoding of surface coordinates. Departing from traditional approaches that use point clouds, our "CrownImage" representation not only unlocks the full power of image-based generative architectures, but also preserves fine geometric detail by operating at far higher spatial resolutions than point clouds to alleviate smoothing artifacts in the 3D generation. Conditioned on jointly learned embeddings of the surrounding dentition, our probabilistic diffusion model produces anatomically plausible crowns with morphological variations tailored to individual patient cases. To accommodate multiple valid designs, we propose an occlusal fit metric based on proximity to the antagonist teeth. We evaluate our method through quantitative experiments and qualitative studies involving expert testimonials. We also release the FDI 16 Crown Dataset, comprising 11,513 annotated intra-oral scans, to support future research in dental CAD.
zh_abstract: 我们提出 CrownFusion，一种从几何图像（表面坐标的二维网格编码）生成 3D 牙冠设计的潜在扩散模型。与使用点云的传统方法不同，我们的“CrownImage”表示不仅释放了基于图像的生成架构的全部能力，而且通过以远高于点云的空间分辨率运行来保留精细几何细节，从而缓解 3D 生成中的平滑伪影。以周围牙列的联合学习嵌入为条件，我们的概率扩散模型生成解剖上合理、且形态变化针对个体患者病例定制的牙冠。为容纳多种有效设计，我们提出一种基于与对颌牙邻近度的咬合适合度指标。我们通过定量实验和涉及专家评价的定性研究来评估我们的方法。我们还发布 FDI 16 Crown Dataset，包含 11,513 个带标注的口内扫描，以支持牙科 CAD 的未来研究。

title: FedTumor-IoMT: Federated Learning-Aided Brain Tumor Diagnosis on Resource-Constrained Edge IoMT Devices
zh_title: 联邦学习在边缘设备上的脑肿瘤诊断
summary: 预印本提出轻量多任务联邦学习框架，在资源受限边缘设备上联合进行脑肿瘤分割与分类。
key_points: 共享LiteMedSAM编码器，共用分割与分类分支
