abstract: Joint brain tumor segmentation and classification models are computationally intensive, limiting their training on resource-constrained edge platforms and restricting privacy-preserving Federated Learning FL in the Internet of Medical Things IoMT. Existing approaches either perform both tasks on GPU-equipped workstations or support only classification on edge devices. To address this gap, this work proposes a lightweight multitask FL framework for joint segmentation and classification through local edge training. A shared pretrained LiteMedSAM encoder with TinyViT extracts features for a coordinate-attention-based segmentation decoder and a segmentation-guided classification head, eliminating a separate feature extractor. Selective encoder freezing retains 95\% trainable parameters while reducing on-device training costs. The proposed framework is experimentally validated on a laboratory testbed of five resource-constrained edge clients using 1,200 T1-weighted MRI samples. It achieves 94.20\% classification accuracy, 88.53\% DSC, 83.68\% IoU, and 99.87\% ROC-AUC. Its classification accuracy remains within 0.6\% of the GPU-trained baseline of 95.21\% across five FL rounds. The attention and feature refinement modules improve DSC and IoU by 3.82\% and 4.60\%, respectively, with 0.74 GFLOPs of additional computation. On edge hardware, the framework achieves 46.54 s inference latency, 52.8\% CPU utilization, and a peak temperature of 65$^\circ$C without thermal throttling. Its inference latency is observed to be 6.4--10.5 times lower than that of existing frameworks. These results demonstrate the feasibility of privacy-preserving joint brain tumor segmentation and classification on resource-constrained edge platforms.
zh_abstract: 联合脑肿瘤分割与分类模型计算密集，限制了其在资源受限边缘平台上的训练，并限制了医学物联网（Internet of Medical Things, IoMT）中隐私保护的联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）。现有方法要么在配备GPU的工作站上执行两项任务，要么仅支持边缘设备上的分类。为弥补这一空白，本研究提出一种轻量级多任务联邦学习框架，通过本地边缘训练实现联合分割与分类。一个共享的、预训练的、带TinyViT的LiteMedSAM编码器为基于坐标注意力的分割解码器和分割引导的分类头提取特征，从而省去单独的特征提取器。选择性编码器冻结保留95%的可训练参数，同时降低设备端训练成本。所提框架在由五个资源受限边缘客户端组成的实验室测试床上使用1,200个T1加权MRI样本进行了实验验证。其达到94.20%的分类准确率、88.53%的DSC、83.68%的IoU和99.87%的ROC-AUC。在五轮FL中，其分类准确率与GPU训练的基线95.21%相比保持在0.6%以内。注意力与特征细化模块分别将DSC和IoU提高3.82%和4.60%，额外计算量为0.74 GFLOPs。在边缘硬件上，该框架实现46.54 s推理延迟、52.8% CPU利用率和65°C峰值温度，且无热降频。其推理延迟被观察到比现有框架低6.4--10.5倍。这些结果证明了在资源受限边缘平台上进行隐私保护的联合脑肿瘤分割与分类的可行性。

title: Online V-Learning with Adaptive Longitudinal Data
zh_title: 在线V学习：自适应纵向数据的统计理论
summary: 针对移动健康中按批次在线更新的动态治疗方案学习，建立自适应收集数据下的V学习统计理论。
key_points: 面向mHealth动态治疗方案策略估计
批次更新使数据自适应收集且患者相关
给出不同确定性批次大小下的理论结果
reason: 纯方法学理论预印本，无真实数据或临床验证，属增量档
abstract: Reinforcement learning methods for estimating optimal dynamic treatment regimes are increasingly applied in mobile health (mHealth), where treatment decisions are made continually. Luckett et al. (2020) proposed V-learning, which estimates an optimal policy from offline trajectories. In practice, mHealth policies are updated online. Batch updating, in which the policy is re-estimated after each block of new data, is a tractable middle ground between offline learning and updating after every observation. However, because each batch's treatment policy is estimated from data pooled across patients in earlier batches, the resulting data are adaptively collected and patient trajectories are dependent, a setting that offline theory does not address. We develop statistical theory for V-learning in this setting with varying, deterministic batch sizes. For each fixed batch, as the number of patients grows, we establish uniform consistency of the estimated value function, consistency of the estimated policy, a functional central limit theorem over the policy class, asymptotic normality of the estimated value of the learned policy, and a consistent variance estimator. To first order, the online procedure performs as well as an oracle that deploys the optimal policy after the first batch. With the number of patients fixed and the number of batches growing, the estimated value function and policy remain consistent under a persistent identifiability condition. In simulations, as the number of patients grows with the number of batches fixed, confidence intervals attain near-nominal coverage under adaptive assignment and the online procedure closely matches the oracle. With a small cohort followed over many batches, the learned policies improve steadily.
zh_abstract: 用于估计最优动态治疗方案（optimal dynamic treatment regimes）的强化学习方法正越来越多地应用于移动健康（mHealth），其中治疗决策是持续做出的。Luckett 等（2020）提出了 V-learning，它从离线轨迹中估计最优策略。在实践中，mHealth 策略是在线更新的。批更新（batch updating）——即在每一批新数据后重新估计策略——是离线学习与每次观测后更新之间一种可处理的折中方案。然而，由于每一批的治疗策略都是基于先前各批患者汇总的数据估计的，所产生的数据是适应性收集的，且患者轨迹相互依赖，这一情形离线理论并未涉及。我们针对该情形下具有变化且确定批大小的 V-learning 建立统计理论。对于每个固定批次，随着患者数量增长，我们建立估计值函数的一致相合性、估计策略的相合性、策略类上的泛函中心极限定理、所学策略估计值的渐近正态性，以及相合方差估计量。在一阶意义上，该在线程序的表现与在第一批后部署最优策略的 oracle 一样好。在患者数量固定、批次数增长时，在持续可识别条件下，估计值函数和策略仍保持相合。在模拟中，当批次数固定而患者数量增长时，置信区间在适应性分配下达到接近名义覆盖，且在线程序与 oracle 十分接近。当小队列在多个批次中随访时，所学策略稳步改善。

title: ProX-MAD: Aggregating Spatial Context into Representative Proxies for Few-shot Medical Anomaly Detection
zh_title: ProX-MAD：聚合空间上下文的少样本医学异常检测
summary: 提出基于代理的框架，把空间上下文聚合为可学习的状态特异代理，统一处理多数据集的少样本医学异常检测。
key_points: 针对「一对多」统一建模而非逐数据集建模
掩码代理注入注意力保留高置信对应
缓解代理塌缩、提升像素级检测
reason: 预印本方法研究，条目未给出量化对比与外部验证信息，属增量档。
abstract: Few-shot medical anomaly detection (MAD) has largely followed a dataset-specific "one-for-one" paradigm, leaving unified "one-for-many" modeling underexplored. Naively extending existing methods to this setting causes substantial performance degradation, especially at the pixel level. We attribute this to their detection mechanisms: a shared decision boundary becomes unreliable across heterogeneous lesion definitions, whereas a normal-only memory bank cannot adequately cover diverse normal distributions with few references. We propose ProX-MAD, a proxy-based framework that aggregates spatial context into compact, learnable, state-specific proxies for unified few-shot MAD. Its Masked Proxy Infusion Attention (MPIA) module cross-attends proxy tokens to reference patch features and applies proxy-wise masking to retain high-confidence correspondences, mitigating proxy collapse and encouraging diverse proxies that summarize both normal and abnormal references. Across six medical datasets, ProX-MAD exhibits only a marginal performance drop from one-for-one to one-for-many training. Despite being trained only once as a unified model, it also outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods on average even when they use their more favorable one-for-one protocol, demonstrating the practicality of unified multi-dataset MAD.
zh_abstract: 少样本医学异常检测（MAD）在很大程度上遵循特定于数据集的“一对一”范式，使统一的“一对多”建模未得到充分探索。将现有方法朴素地扩展到该设置会导致显著性能下降，尤其是在像素级别。我们将此归因于它们的检测机制：共享决策边界在异构病变定义之间变得不可靠，而仅正常样本的记忆库在参考样本很少时无法充分覆盖多样的正常分布。我们提出ProX-MAD，一个基于代理（proxy）的框架，它将空间上下文聚合为紧凑、可学习、状态特定的代理，用于统一的少样本MAD。其掩码代理注入注意力（MPIA）模块将代理令牌与参考图像块特征进行交叉注意力，并施加代理级掩码以保留高置信度对应关系，从而缓解代理塌缩并鼓励能够同时概括正常与异常参考样本的多样代理。在六个医学数据集上，ProX-MAD从一对一训练到一对多训练仅表现出边际性能下降。尽管仅作为统一模型训练一次，它平均而言仍优于先前的先进方法，即使这些方法使用了对其更有利的一对一协议，这证明了统一多数据集MAD的实用性。

title: Quantum kernels on breast data: concentration, surrogates, and two ways an advantage gets manufactured
zh_title: 乳腺数据上的量子核方法：集中性、替代模型与优势的制造方式
summary: 预印本用三个乳腺数据基准（WDBC、模拟钼靶、BreastMNIST）检验量子核优势宣称，指出其依赖单一对照与选择历史。
key_points: 均为8量子比特经典态矢量模拟，推理路径无量子成分
WDBC样本效率扫描与1200例模拟钼靶原始/处理后对照
BreastMNIST 30种子测量选择膨胀，CMMD临床组因标签泄漏撤出
reason: 预印本方法学基准，无外部验证与临床结局，属增量档
abstract: Quantum-kernel advantage claims on breast data are usually a single number: one quantum arm, one comparator, one test split. We asked what that number measures once the full comparator set and selection history are visible. We report three active benchmarks, all exact classical statevector simulations of 8-qubit fidelity kernels with no quantum component in the inference path: a sample-efficiency sweep on Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer at ten training-set sizes; raw-versus-processed arms on 1,200 M-SYNTH simulated mammograms with a matched closed-form dequantisation surrogate, five classical methods at the same input and eleven kernel families; and a 30-seed selection-inflation measurement on BreastMNIST. A CMMD D1 clinical arm is withdrawn as a result arm because its frozen splits leak the label through patient serial order, a defect reported in a separate study; it is retained only as a worked example. All three active arms are negative. On M-SYNTH raw an apparent +0.1736 (p = 5.2e-06) against a tuned RBF-SVM falls to +0.0019 (p = 0.937) against a random forest at the same input, and a Laplacian kernel wins on validation. On WDBC, with model selection confined to training data, the quantum kernel is below the selected classical arm at every training-set size, with 2 of 200 paired subsamples ahead. Best-of-30 seed selection adds +0.0210 on BreastMNIST. One result does not fit: at bandwidth 2pi the matched closed-form Gaussian surrogate failed to reproduce the M-SYNTH raw kernel (0.5410 against 0.7045, p = 6.3e-06). Comparator choice and selection each produce effects larger than any quantum-classical difference we measured; we give a reporting standard that removes both.
zh_abstract: 关于乳腺数据的量子核优势主张通常只是一个单一数字：一个量子实验组、一个对照方法、一个测试划分。我们追问：一旦完整的对照集合和选择历史可见，该数字衡量的是什么。我们报告三项有效基准，全部是8量子比特保真度核的精确经典态矢量模拟，推理路径中不含任何量子成分：在威斯康星诊断乳腺癌（Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer）数据集上、十个训练集规模下的样本效率扫描；在1,200幅M-SYNTH模拟乳腺X线摄影图像上的原始数据对处理后数据实验组，配备匹配的闭式去量子化替代模型、同一输入下的五种经典方法和十一个核函数族；以及在BreastMNIST上的30个随机种子选择膨胀测量。一个CMMD D1临床实验组不再作为结果实验组，因为其冻结的数据划分通过患者序号顺序泄露标签，该缺陷已在另一项研究中报告；它仅作为示例保留。三个活跃实验组均为负结果。在M-SYNTH原始数据上，相对于调优的RBF-SVM的表观+0.1736（p = 5.2e-06）在相同输入下相对于随机森林降至+0.0019（p = 0.937），而拉普拉斯核在验证集上胜出。在WDBC上，模型选择仅限于训练数据，量子核在每个训练集规模下都低于所选经典实验组，仅在200个配对子样本中有2个领先。30个种子中取最佳的选择在BreastMNIST上增加+0.0210。有一个结果不符合：在带宽2pi下，匹配的闭式高斯替代模型未能复现M-SYNTH原始核（0.5410对0.7045，p = 6.3e-06）。对照方法的选择和选择过程各自产生的影响都大于我们所测得的任何量子-经典差异；我们给出一个可消除这两者的报告标准。

title: Leakage-Safe Auditing of Attribution-Driven Data Curation in Medical Imaging
zh_title: 医学影像归因数据清洗的防泄漏审计
summary: 对 CT 血管造影动脉瘤 3D 分类器做患者不重叠审计，分别检验归因异常检测与干预有效性两类主张。
key_points: 1,201 个阳性 patch 中 232 个为零值数组
推翻历史 321-patch 注意力失效亚组
GradCAM++ 与 Integrated Gradients 阳性排序不一致
reason: 单数据集审计研究、样本有限，属增量档
abstract: When can an attribution-derived anomaly justify changing a medical-imaging training set? We formulate attribution-driven curation as three separately testable claims: anomaly detection, harmfulness estimation, and intervention utility. We test the first and third using a patient-disjoint, identifier-preserving audit of a 3D convolutional classifier for computed tomography angiography aneurysm candidates. We identify 232 exactly zero-valued arrays among 1,201 positive patches, including 170 training positives, and invalidate a historical 321-patch attention-failure subgroup whose identifier-free records were joined to files by position. On the held-out test set, GradCAM++ spatial concentration is central for every candidate class, reversing the historical pattern. GradCAM++ and Integrated Gradients show negative rank-order agreement for positives, limiting method-independent anatomical interpretation. Across five paired training seeds, removing the 170 corrupted training positives yields AUC 0.9617 +/- 0.0044 versus 0.9652 +/- 0.0039 for full-data training (difference -0.0035; 95% CI -0.0082 to 0.0007). Excluding 34 raw-zero test positives widens rather than closes the gap, countering a blank-memorization explanation. Budget-matched random-removal controls suggest the result is not simply an effect of reducing training size. Input corruption does not necessarily imply that deletion improves generalization. Our framework makes leakage control, sample identity, and intervention testing explicit in attribution-driven medical-imaging data curation.
zh_abstract: 归因衍生的异常何时能证明改变医学影像训练集是合理的？我们将归因驱动的数据整理表述为三个可分别检验的主张：异常检测、危害性估计和干预效用。我们使用针对计算机断层扫描血管造影动脉瘤候选者的三维卷积分类器，通过患者不重叠、保留标识符的审计来检验第一和第三个主张。我们在1,201个阳性图块中识别出232个完全为零值的数组，其中包括170个训练阳性样本，并使一个历史性的321图块注意力失败亚组失效，该亚组的无标识符记录按位置与文件连接。在留出测试集上，GradCAM++的空间集中区域对每个候选类别均位于中心，逆转了历史模式。GradCAM++与Integrated Gradients在阳性样本上呈负的秩序一致性，限制了不依赖方法的解剖学解释。在五个配对训练随机种子中，移除170个损坏的训练阳性样本得到的AUC为0.9617 +/- 0.0044，而全数据训练为0.9652 +/- 0.0039（差异 -0.0035；95% CI -0.0082至0.0007）。排除34个原始零值测试阳性会扩大而非缩小差距，反驳了空白记忆解释。预算匹配的随机移除对照表明，该结果并非仅仅是减少训练规模的效果。输入损坏并不必然意味着删除会改善泛化。我们的框架在归因驱动的医学影像数据整理中明确纳入了泄漏控制、样本身份和干预检验。

title: CSC-Mamba: Bridging multimodal convolutional sparse coding and state space models for multi-contrast MRI super-resolution
zh_title: CSC-Mamba：多对比度MRI超分辨率新方法
summary: 提出CSC-Mamba，将深度展开多模态卷积稀疏编码与视觉Mamba结合，用于多对比度MRI超分辨率。
key_points: 结合深度展开稀疏编码与视觉Mamba
利用参考对比度结构先验做MRI超分
摘要未报告外部验证或临床评估
reason: 方法类预印本，有新意但无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Multi-contrast MRI super-resolution accelerates clinical protocols by reconstructing high-resolution (HR) target modalities from low-resolution (LR) inputs, guided by easily acquired reference contrasts. While purely data-driven deep neural networks achieve strong performance via rich representation capacity, they rely on heuristic fusion mechanisms (e.g., naive concatenation or black-box cross-attention) that lack theoretical grounding. Alternatively, model-based deep unfolding networks enforce principled cross-contrast fusion through explicit priors, yet their unrolled steps remain constrained to shallow convolutions, lacking modern deep blocks to capture global context. To bridge this gap, we propose CSC-MAMBA, unifying deep-unfolded multimodal convolutional sparse coding with the Vision Mamba state-space backbone. By fusing common structural priors from the guidance modality via unfolded sparse coding and globally refining contrast-specific representations with a Mamba back- bone, our approach benefits from interpretable, model-guided fusion and long-range spatial context. Experiments on the IXI dataset demonstrate that CSC-MAMBA outperforms state-of-the-art methods in reconstruction quality, achieving up to a 0.62 dB gain in PSNR while remaining computationally efficient.
zh_abstract: 多对比度MRI超分辨率通过从低分辨率（LR）输入重建高分辨率（HR）目标模态，并在易于获取的参考对比度引导下，加速临床协议。纯数据驱动的深度神经网络凭借丰富的表示能力取得强性能，但它们依赖缺乏理论基础的启发式融合机制（如简单拼接或黑箱交叉注意力）。另一方面，基于模型的深度展开网络通过显式先验实现有原则的跨对比度融合，但其展开步骤仍局限于浅层卷积，缺乏现代深度模块来捕捉全局上下文。为弥合这一差距，我们提出CSC-MAMBA，将深度展开的多模态卷积稀疏编码与Vision Mamba状态空间骨干统一起来。通过展开稀疏编码融合来自引导模态的共有结构先验，并利用Mamba骨干全局细化对比度特异性表示，我们的方法受益于可解释的、模型引导的融合和长程空间上下文。在IXI数据集上的实验表明，CSC-MAMBA在重建质量上优于最先进方法，PSNR最高提升0.62 dB，同时保持计算高效。

title: Do Clinician-Scored Examples Help LLMs Code ADOS-2 from Hour-Long Transcripts?
zh_title: 医生评分示例能帮LLM编码ADOS-2吗
summary: 测试临床医生评分示例能否提升LLM对小时级ADOS-2访谈转录的编码一致性。
key_points: 测试医生评分示例对LLM编码的影响
48名儿童、8个言语条目，预注册对照
40名留出儿童中κ仅0.22–0.30
reason: 预注册对照但样本小且一致性低，属增量档
abstract: Large language models can apply a written rubric to a transcript, making automated coding of the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS-2) look within reach. A common way to align such a rater with clinicians is to show it expert-scored examples, but whether correct labels improve agreement is rarely tested. We test this for eight speech-based items of hour-long ADOS-2 Module 3 sessions from 48 children, with one local model and a pre-registered, placebo-controlled design. We compare few-shot scoring, an anchored comparison in which the model only judges a child better, similar or worse than scored anchors and a fixed rule gives the score, post-hoc calibration, protocol-based evidence routing and direct scoring of the full transcript. On 40 held-out children, agreement with clinicians was modest, with quadratic weighted kappa between 0.22 and 0.30. Replacing every example's label with a wrong one changed about a third of the few-shot predictions, more often towards the corrupted labels than chance, but did not lower agreement, 0.25 with correct and 0.23 with wrong labels. A larger second model did the same. The anchored comparison did not improve on few-shot scoring, its cross-child judgements were no more accurate than those implied by absolute scores, and routing did not help. Among the registered, uncalibrated arms, direct scoring of the full transcript agreed best at 0.30. Exploratory follow-up analyses found that the model's graded judgements ranked children better than its final scores, that existing batch calibration raised agreement to 0.46 on the same children, and that in controlled synthetic sessions scoring episodes separately did not beat calibrated whole-transcript scoring. Expert-scored examples do not by themselves calibrate model-based clinical raters, and claims of calibration or added pipeline complexity need corrupted-label controls and strong baselines.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型可以将书面评分标准应用于转录文本，使自闭症诊断观察量表（ADOS-2）的自动编码看起来触手可及。使此类评分者与临床医生对齐的一种常见方法是向其展示专家评分的示例，但正确标签是否提高一致性很少被检验。我们在来自 48 名儿童的时长一小时的 ADOS-2 模块 3 会话的八个基于言语的条目上测试这一点，使用一个本地模型和预注册、安慰剂对照的设计。我们比较少样本评分、锚定比较（其中模型仅判断儿童比已评分锚点更好、相似或更差，并由固定规则给出分数）、事后校准、基于方案证据路由以及对完整转录文本的直接评分。在 40 名留出儿童中，与临床医生的一致性有限，二次加权 kappa 在 0.22 至 0.30 之间。将每个示例的标签替换为错误标签，改变了约三分之一的少样本预测，且比随机更常转向被破坏的标签，但并未降低一致性：正确标签时为 0.25，错误标签时为 0.23。更大的第二个模型也是如此。锚定比较未优于少样本评分，其跨儿童判断并不比绝对分数所隐含的判断更准确，且证据路由没有帮助。在注册的、未校准的各组中，对完整转录文本的直接评分一致性最佳，为 0.30。探索性后续分析发现，模型的等级判断对儿童的排序优于其最终分数；现有批量校准在同一批儿童上将一致性提高到 0.46；在受控合成会话中，分别对片段评分并未胜过经过校准的全转录评分。专家评分示例本身不能校准基于模型的临床评分者，关于校准或增加流程复杂度的主张需要损坏标签对照和强基线。

title: CROSS-Calib: Selective Channel Calibration for Ultrasound Reconstruction
zh_title: CROSS-Calib：超声通道选择性校准重建
summary: 提出以其他通道预测作幅相参考、并用上下文门控选择性融合的通道修复方法，在在体数据与体模上优于基线。
key_points: 用其他通道预测做幅度与相位校准
门控机制选择性保留可用回波、修复不可靠样本
在体数据在增益误差与瞬态干扰下优于全部基线
reason: 预印本方法类，有基线对比与体模/在体测试，但无临床结局与外部多中心验证，属增量档偏上。
abstract: Ultrasound imaging provides views of internal tissue in real time for medical diagnosis. However, ultrasound signals may be affected by interference, and correcting errors and removing transient interference while preserving valid echoes remains challenging. We propose CROSS-Calib, a channel recovery method that uses predictions from other channels as references for amplitude and phase calibration, while a gate using context selectively combines calibrated measurements with predicted echoes to retain usable samples and repair unreliable ones. On the in vivo test set, CROSS-Calib outperforms all baseline models under gain errors and transient interference, while phantom tests show that the model restores cyst contrast with echo widths of wire targets close to the clean reference. CROSS-Calib can perform channel calibration and selective repair before beamforming to improve echo usability and image quality.
zh_abstract: 超声成像可实时提供内部组织视图以用于医学诊断。然而，超声信号可能受到干扰，在保留有效回波的同时校正误差并去除瞬态干扰仍然具有挑战性。我们提出 CROSS-Calib，一种通道恢复方法，它使用其他通道的预测作为幅度和相位校准的参考，同时使用上下文的门控选择性地将校准后的测量与预测回波结合，以保留可用样本并修复不可靠样本。在在体测试集上，CROSS-Calib 在增益误差和瞬态干扰下优于所有基线模型，而体模测试表明该模型恢复了囊肿对比度，线靶的回波宽度接近干净参考。CROSS-Calib 可在波束形成之前执行通道校准和选择性修复，以提高回波可用性和图像质量。

title: XRL4T1D: A Post-hoc Explainability Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Type 1 Diabetes Management
zh_title: XRL4T1D：1型糖尿病强化学习事后解释
summary: 提出无需重训的事后解释框架，用 SHAP 比较胰岛素给药策略对 CGM 与胰岛素史的依赖，评估仅在 UVA/Padova 模拟器完成。
key_points: 用 SHAP 比较 CGM 与胰岛素史输入重要性
按三个20分钟窗口汇总胰岛素史归因
以输入替换检验归因与策略输出敏感性

abstract: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) requires lifelong insulin therapy, and reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for automated dosing in the UVA/Padova simulator. However, the decisions of RL controllers remain difficult to interpret. We present XRL4T1D, a post-hoc explainability framework for evaluating pretrained insulin-dosing policies without retraining. Each policy uses 60 minutes of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) and administered-insulin history, sampled every 5 minutes, to recommend insulin. We use SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to compare the importance of CGM and insulin-history inputs and summarize insulin-history attributions over three 20-minute windows motivated by insulin-on-board. We assess whether these attributions correspond to policy-output sensitivity through targeted input replacement and compare temporal rankings with TimeSHAP. In all 80 patient-policy-mask-size cases, replacing the highest-attribution inputs changes the normalized insulin recommendation more than replacing the lowest-attribution or random inputs. The highest-attribution insulin-history window is also the most output-sensitive in 115 of 120 patient-policy-scenario configurations, and KernelSHAP and TimeSHAP select the same top window in 111 of 120. Applying XRL4T1D to PPO and G2P2C across 20 virtual patients, we find that both controllers rely predominantly on CGM history, especially G2P2C. However, the distribution of insulin-history importance across recent, middle, and older windows varies by cohort, explainer, and analysis settings, without a consistent separation between controllers. Global feature-attribution rankings remain stable under the tested observation corruptions. These results show why attribution fidelity, temporal reproducibility, and controller-comparison robustness should be assessed separately.
zh_abstract: 1型糖尿病（T1D）需要终身胰岛素治疗，强化学习（RL）在UVA/Padova模拟器中已显示出用于自动给药的潜力。然而，RL控制器的决策仍然难以解释。我们提出XRL4T1D，一个用于评估预训练胰岛素给药策略的事后可解释性框架，无需重新训练。每个策略使用每5分钟采样的60分钟连续葡萄糖监测（CGM）和已给药胰岛素历史来推荐胰岛素。我们使用SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）比较CGM与胰岛素历史输入的重要性，并在受胰岛素在体内（insulin-on-board）启发而设定的三个20分钟窗口上汇总胰岛素历史归因。我们通过有针对性的输入替换评估这些归因是否与策略输出敏感性相对应，并将时间排序与TimeSHAP进行比较。在所有80个患者-策略-掩码尺寸案例中，替换最高归因输入比替换最低归因输入或随机输入更能改变归一化胰岛素推荐。在120个患者-策略-场景配置中有115个，最高归因的胰岛素历史窗口也是对输出最敏感的窗口，且KernelSHAP与TimeSHAP在120个中有111个选择相同的最高窗口。将XRL4T1D应用于20名虚拟患者上的PPO和G2P2C，我们发现两个控制器都主要依赖CGM历史，G2P2C尤其如此。然而，胰岛素历史重要性在近期、中期和较早期窗口上的分布随队列、解释器和分析设置而变化，控制器之间没有一致的分离。在测试的观测扰动下，全局特征归因排序保持稳定。这些结果表明为什么归因保真度、时间可重复性和控制器比较稳健性应分别评估。

title: Contrastive Proxy Forests: Completeness-Preserving Proxy Learning from Multimodal Records
zh_title: 对比代理森林：多模态记录的完整性保留代理学习
summary: 利用近端因果推断条件，从治疗侧与结局侧多模态记录中学习共享表示以捕捉混杂因素，替代人工挑选代理变量。
key_points: 以临床文本与生理波形等多模态记录构建代理
学习跨模态共享部分以过滤模态特异风格
目标是保持代理完整性而非通用降维
reason: 方法学预印本，条目未提供实验规模与外部验证结果，属增量档。
abstract: Proximal causal inference removes unmeasured confounding using two proxies of the confounder, an outcome-side W and a treatment-side Z. The proxies must satisfy exclusion restrictions and be complete, meaning that they reflect every aspect of the confounder. In practice, they are a few variables hand-picked from a structured table, even though clinical notes and physiological waveforms carry rich information about the confounder. Such records are too high-dimensional for a proximal estimator, and generic compression such as PCA may keep modality-specific variation (style) instead of the confounder, destroying completeness. Our key observation is that, under the proximal condition, the confounder is the only link between a treatment-side and an outcome-side modality beyond the covariates. Learning what they share therefore captures the confounder and filters out modality-specific style. Contrastive Proxy Forests (CPF) learns both proxies by contrasting the two modalities, given the covariates, on a separate unlabeled sample, and passes them to a proximal causal forest. This contrastive objective has an exact closed-form solution, ridge canonical correlation analysis. We prove that CPF preserves the exclusion restrictions exactly and that its proxies inherit the completeness of the raw records under conditions we characterize. Where style is strong, CPF lowers the error of conditional effects by 10-22% relative to PCA proxies, and on MIMIC-IV it is the only method whose point estimate of warfarin's effect on stroke falls inside the range of randomized trials.
zh_abstract: 近端因果推断利用混杂因素的两个代理变量——结局侧 W 和治疗侧 Z——来消除未测量混杂。这些代理变量必须满足排除限制并且是完备的，这意味着它们反映混杂因素的每一个方面。在实践中，它们是从结构化表格中手工挑选的少数变量，尽管临床笔记和生理波形携带关于混杂因素的丰富信息。此类记录对于近端估计器而言维度过高，而 PCA 等通用压缩可能保留模态特异变异（风格）而不是混杂因素，从而破坏完备性。我们的关键观察是，在近端条件下，混杂因素是治疗侧模态与结局侧模态之间除协变量之外的唯一联系。因此，学习二者共享的内容可以捕获混杂因素并过滤掉模态特异风格。对比代理森林（Contrastive Proxy Forests, CPF）在给定协变量的情况下，在单独的无标签样本上通过对比两个模态来学习两个代理变量，并将它们传递给近端因果森林。该对比目标具有精确的闭式解，即岭典型相关分析（ridge canonical correlation analysis）。我们证明 CPF 精确保持排除限制，并且在我们刻画的条件卜，其代理变量继承原始记录的完备性。在风格较强时，CPF 相对于 PCA 代理变量将条件效应误差降低 10-22%；在 MIMIC-IV 上，它是唯一一种对华法林影响卒中的点估计落在随机试验范围内的方法。

title: Latent Class Mixed Model Variational Autoencoders for Scalable Phenotyping of Health Trajectories
zh_title: LCMM-VAE：健康轨迹的可扩展表型聚类
summary: 提出潜类混合模型变分自编码器，潜先验为类特异线性混合模型，兼顾可解释表型结构与高维、不规则随访数据的可扩展性。
key_points: 潜轨迹分解为类均值轨迹与个体偏差
推导变分 EM 算法更新类别责任与混合参数
面向不规则访视与高维测量场景
reason: 预印本方法研究，条目未给出真实队列规模与验证结果，属增量档。
abstract: Clustering longitudinal health trajectories requires handling high-dimensional measurements, irregular visit times, and subject-level heterogeneity while retaining clinically interpretable structure. Existing methods address this only partially: latent-class mixed models yield an interpretable, covariate-driven partition but do not scale past a handful of markers, while deep time-series clustering scales at the cost of that structure and generally requires a common time grid. We introduce the Latent Class Mixed Model Variational Autoencoder (LCMM-VAE), a deep generative model whose latent prior is a mixture of class-specific linear mixed models, so that each subject's latent trajectory decomposes into its class mean trajectory and a subject-specific deviation. We derive a variational EM algorithm whose class responsibilities, random effects and mixed-model parameters are updated in closed form, and provide identifiability guarantees under stated conditions. Experiments on simulated and real longitudinal cohorts show that LCMM-VAE returns a partition, a reconstruction of incomplete trajectories and interpretable class-level dynamics at once, while remaining competitive with classical and deep baselines.
zh_abstract: 对纵向健康轨迹进行聚类需要处理高维测量、不规则随访时间和个体水平异质性，同时保留临床可解释的结构。现有方法只能部分解决这一问题：潜在类别混合模型可给出可解释、由协变量驱动的划分，但无法扩展到超过少量标志物的情形；深度时间序列聚类虽可扩展，却以牺牲这种结构为代价，并且通常要求共同的时间网格。我们提出潜在类别混合模型变分自编码器（Latent Class Mixed Model Variational Autoencoder, LCMM-VAE），这是一种深度生成模型，其潜在先验是类别特定线性混合模型的混合，因此每个受试者的潜在轨迹可分解为其类别平均轨迹和受试者特异偏差。我们推导出一种变分 EM 算法，其类别责任度、随机效应和混合模型参数均以闭式更新，并在所述条件下提供可识别性保证。在模拟和真实纵向队列上的实验表明，LCMM-VAE 能同时返回一个划分、对不完整轨迹的重建以及可解释的类别水平动态，同时与经典和深度基线相比仍具竞争力。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University of Pennsylvania; conditions: Population Health Management, Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS), Chronic Lung Diseases, Artificial Intelligence (AI); type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 45; status: RECRUITING] Patients living with chronic lung diseases (CLD) are at high risk of frailty, malnutrition, and depression. However, many of the interventions targeting these conditions are underutilized. Thus, artificial intelligence-based clinical decision support systems (AI-CDSS) offer a promising approach to guide targeted interventions for this population and reduce risk of hospitalization. The purpose of this study is to assess the acceptability and feasibility of a new AI-CDSS for community-dwelling patients with CLD. The goal of this AI-CDSS is to predict the probability that patients would benefit from 5 frailty- and depression-focused interventions (pulmonary rehabilitation, physical therapy, fall-risk assessment, nutrition consultation, and depression consultation). In this study, pulmonologists will review the AI-CDSS's predictions and have the option to recommend referrals for their patients. If a referral is recommended, the study team will contact the patient to discuss the referral and start the referral process. All participants will then complete a semi-structured interview and feedback survey asking their opinions about the AI-CDSS and the study referral process.

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University of Waterloo; conditions: Safety, Feasibility Studies, Pilot Study, Mental Health, Mood; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 20; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The goal of this Pilot study is to examine the possibility and safety of using Artificial Intelligence (AI) conversational tools (chatbots) to help improve individuals' mental well-being. The main questions it aims to answer are: * How safe is an AI chatbot in use for a study about mental wellness? * How usable is the platform for this study? * How willing are participants to remain and complete the study? * What was the user experience like? * Do they show any signs of dependancy on the chatbot?
